dab brgyad pa' dkar chag :rgyud/ 〈li (15)0286 dbang mdor bstan pa'i brjed byang / 3dpal dus kyi 'khor lo pa paṇ+ḍi ta rnam par rgyal ba dbang po'i zhabs kyis mdzad—/lo tsā ba dpang dpal ldan blo gros brtan pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(47) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(50)0287 rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 51paṇ+ḍi ta gnas brtan dpe med kyis srungs pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(53) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(53)0288 rdo rje'i tshig gi snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ 541

kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrīs mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid kyi drung du dbe+el lo tsā bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(61) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(61)0289 rdo rje'i tshig gi snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel/ 62kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrīs mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid kyi drung du dpyal lo tsā bas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(66) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(67)0290 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 68slob dpon dus 'khor zhabs kyis mdzad—/paṇ+ḍi ta wā shī shwa ra dang lo tsā ba chos rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(80) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(81)0291 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga zhes bya ba/ 82slob dpon dus 'khor zhabs kyis mdzad—/paṇ+ḍi ta wā gi shwa ra dang lo tsā ba chos rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(89) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(90) 0292 dpa' dus spyo/ la 11za mtholnga( :gan sresag ci/ ཿdza ga che/sa (1 ba/ 91slob dpon dus 'khor zhabs kyis mdzad—/paṇ+ḍi ta wā gī shwa ra dang lo tsā ba chos rab kyis bsgyur/2

bsdur mchan/(101) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(102)0293 'phags pa mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i mdor bshad bdud rtsi'i /byesgyun/ma /ba /sgo/ma /bya/ /ba 103dang po/ tshigs su bcad pa bcu drug gis gsol ba btab pa gsungs pa/ 103gnyis pa/ tshigs su bcad pa drug gis lan gsungs pa/ 116gsum pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis rigs drug la gzigs pa ཿna/thuḥb/ma /ba 119bzhi pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyis sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i rim pa gsungs pa/ 121lnga pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bcu bzhis byang sems rdo rje'i rnam par bkaponab/ ngas pe ༄sapa theg ngas 128drug pa/ rkang pas dman pa'i tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lngas shin tu rnam par dag pa chos dbyings ye shes kyi bshad pa gsungs pa/ 139bdun pa/ rkang pa dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bcus me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi bshad pa gsungs pa/ 168brgyad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi bshad pa gsungs pa/ 175dgu pa/ tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa bzhis mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi thab44tshod ngas tha /sapa thag nga 208bcu pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bco lngas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi bshad tshob ཿna/thuḥb/ma /ba rtenarten3bcu gcig pa/ tshigs su bcad pa lngas de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ye shes kyi bstod pa gsungs pa/ 238bcu gnyis pa/ phan yon gyi tshig rkang rnams cung zad bshad pa/ 2423

bcu gsum pa/ sngags brjod pa/ 247bcu bzhi pa/ rjes su yi rang ba brjod pa/ 247dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gnas brtan nyi ma'i dpal ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nor bu dpal ye shes dang / bla ma rje btsun rdo rje 'chang r+ṣa po dpal nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer gyi zhal snga nas—/ lo tsā ba chag dge slong chos rje dpal gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(2go) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(260)0294 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa bdud rtsi'i thigs pa sgon ma gsal ba zhes bya ba/ 261le'u dang po/ tshigs su bcad pa bcu drug gis zhus pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa bstan pa/ rten(31le'u gnyis pa/ tshigs su bcad pa drug gis slar gsungs pa'i rgya cher paraXpe(ba ngas thab/gcad tshob/ 269le'u gsum pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis rigs drug la gzigs pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa bstan pa/ ༷ 272le'u bzhi pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyis sngags kyi rgya cher 'grel pa bstan pa/ rten7rtenale'u lnga pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bcu bzhis rdo rje dbyings kyi rgya cher 'aX//la /pa /ba/stacad /ba/ 240ga le'u drug pa/ tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lngas rnam par snang mdzad chos kyi 4

dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rgya cher 'grel pa bstan pa/ 279le'u bdun pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bcu dang tshig rkang gcig gis rdo rje rigs gyi rgya cher 'grel pa bstan pa/ 292le'u brgyad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rgya cher 'grel pa bstan pa/ 294le'u dgu pa/ tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa bzhis mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rgya cher 'grel pa bstan pa/ 308le'u bcu pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bco lngas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rgya cesazang sharagre15 pa bstan pa/ 315le'u bcu gcig pa/ tshigs su bcad pa lngas 'dud kyi rgya cher 'grel /ba /bstan pa/ rtenartenarjo le'u bcu gnyis pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gsum gyis sngags kyi rgya cher paraXs(ba nga / /ba/gcad ngas/ 322le'u bcu gsum pa/ tshigs su bcad pa lngas rjes su yi rang gi rgya cher pa ༷sa(5 ngas jub/gcad ngas/ ༷ 323paṇ+ḍi ta a nu pa ma rak+ṣi tas mdzad/kha che' mkhas pa su ga ta shrī dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dharma tīrti dang dge slong rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(326) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(331)0295 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rnam par bshad pa/ rtenartenartenadang po/ brjod bya'i khyad par ji ltar zhu ba gleng ba bstan pa/ 233gnyis pa/ rjod byed gang gi don du zhu ba gleng bslang ba bstan pa/ 360 5

gsum pa/ rgyud kyi dngos po yongs su shes par bya ba'i phyir lan gnang ba bstan pa/ zhe 6 bzhi pa/ rigs drug la gzigs pa bstan pa/ 370lnga pa/ sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon par byang chub pa bshad pa/ 372drug pa/ byang chub sems kyi rdo rje bshad pa/ na76bdun pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes bshad pa/ 88brgyad pa/ me long lta bu'i ye shes bshad pa/ 4 6dgu pa/ so sor kun du rtog pa'i ye shes bshad pa/ 412bcu pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes bshad pa/ 440bcu gcig pa/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes bshad pa/ ༷460bcu gnyis pa/ rigs lnga la bstod pa bshad pa/ gre1bcu gsum pa/ chos thams cad rnam par dag pa'i sngags bstan par bya /ba /bshad /pa/ gre3bcu bzhi pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' la rjes su yi rang ba bstan pa bshad pa/ gye/ 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa mi'i dbang po grags pas mdzad/byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi bka' brgyud/rgya gar gyi mkhan po a bha ya badz+ra dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba sbal rdo rje rgyal pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(gre9) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(go0)0296 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba/ 4916

le'u dang po/ zhus pas bshad pa/ 5༷5/ba(1 bkanyis pa/ sloban bsdonatshod pa/ 51 le'u gsum pa/ rigs kyi dbye ba brjod pa/ 516le'u bzhi pa/ sgyu 'phrul dra bas mngon par byang chub pa brjod pa/ 517le'u lnga pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po brjod pa/ 524le'u drug pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bstod pa brjod pa/ 546le'u bdun pa/ le long lta bu'i ye shes la bstod pa brjod pa/ 561le'u brgyad pa/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes la bstod pa brjod pa/ 564le'u dgu pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa brjod pa/ 581le'u bcu pa/ bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa brjod pa/ 591le'u bcu gcig pa/ ye shes lnga las bsdus nas bstod pa brjod pa/ 6༷2le'u bcu gnyis pa/ phan yon brjod pa/ 604le'u bcu gsum pa/ sngags kyi le'u brjod pa/ ༷ 604le'u bcu bzhi pa/ rjes su yi rang ba brjod pa/ 605rgyal po pad+ma dkar pos mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta r+sā po dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal bsod snyoms pa chen pos bsgyur—/bsdur mchan/(608) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(617)0297 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang par brjod pa'i phan yon kyi 'grel pa/ / 1ma 'khor lo dang po'i phan yon tshig bcu gcig tu bgrang ba'i rnam par bshad pa— 6/18'khor lo gnyis pa'i phan yon tshig gi rnam grangs lnga bcu rtsa gnyis kyis ngab/byethag ngas:re badzadatshod ngas/ 6537

'khor lo gsum pa'i phan yon tshig gi rnam grangs lnga bcu rtsa gnyis su ba/kupa theg ngas:re ba44tshod pa/ 668'khor lo bzhi pa'i phan yon tshig gi rnam grangs bcu dgus bshad pa/ 686'khor lo lnga pa'i phan yon tshig gi rnam grangs lnga bcu rtsa gcig tu brtsis /ba'i/bshatshod /ba/ rte /rtenag dpal mkhas pa ches po dus kyi 'khor lo pa grags pas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ā tsār+ya a bha ya badz+ra dang / dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab—/bsdur mchan/(743) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(755)0298 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i mngon par rtocan/ma /pa/ 40ga /tshodang po/ sgrub pa po'i mtshan nyid dang gnas kyi nges pa/ 756gnyis pa/ gdong la sogs pa dag pa'i nges pa 757gsum pa/ bsod nams kyi tshogs la 'jug pa'i nges pa 758bzhi pa/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa'i nges pa 759lnga pa/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dbyings la 'jug pa'i nges pa 761drug pa/ byang chub kyi sems bar chad sel ba zhes pa srung ba dam po bya ba'i nges pa rten// rtenabadun pa/ snod kyi 'jig rten la mi skyo bar bya ba'i nges pa 764brgyad pa/ dpe byad brgyad cu'i nyi ma'i cha dang ma la lan pa dang rdul du nges pa dang / phung po la sogs pa'i lha'i chos shes pa/ 767dgu pa/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus la de bzhin gshegs pa lngas byin gyis 8

thabacesatshob tshos/re (pe25 tshob ba// zadabacu pa/ tshig gi mtshan nyid de de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyi nges pa/ 769bcu gcig pa/ sa bon spros nas bkod pa'i nges pa 772bcu gnyis pa/ gdan rnams kyi nges pa/ ༷ 775bcu gsum pa/ lha rnams kyi sku mdog dang mtshan ma dang bzhugs sa dang /phyocan25 /) (pe/ma thab ba/ba/( bcu bzhi pa/ glus bskul ba'i nges pa 785bco lnga pa/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhengs pa'i nges pa 787bcu drug pa/ skye gnas bstan pa'i nges pa 788bcu bdun pa/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang dam tshig gi 'khor lo mnyam par (1 thab/re (pethab thab 789bco brgyad pa/ dbang bskur ba dang phyag rgya'i nges pa 790bcu dgu pa/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i nges pa 794nyi shu pa/ skye mched byin gyis brlab pa'i nges pa 795nyer gcig pa/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi nges pa/ 796nyer gnyis pa/ 'khor lo drug la rnam par dag pa'i nges pa/ 797nyer gsum pa/ lha dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa dag pa'i nges pa/ 798nyer bzhi pa/ mchod pa'i yan lag gi nges pa/ 800nyer lnga pa/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa bstod pa'i nges pa/ 801nyer drug pa/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i nges pa 803nyer bdun pa/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gyis gsungs pa'i nges pa 803nyer brgyad pa/ sngags kyi bzlas brjod bya ba'i nges pa 805nyer dgu pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gtor ma'i nges pa 8129
