dang —/ /khengs pa la ni rtag tu dga'/ /rtag tu gdug sems ldan kun gyis/ /gsang ba'i spyod yul 'di mi shes/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sems can kun la nyi khri dang —/ /chig stong drug brgya 'gas/sa kyepas na/ /sman pa bde chen dbyer rnged pa'o—/ /bla med 'bras bu lhan skyes bde/ /de thob bya phyir dga' bzhi bsgom/ /rab tu gsal ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes pa rab gsal rang bzhin bye /la/ /chos dang gzugs su gsal ba'o/ /de nyid sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /bcom ldan zag med ye shes la/ /ston pa thig le bde chen po/ /'byung gnas spyi bo'i haṃ yig la/ /'gro ba'i rlung gi las rnams so/ /bla ma thabs mchog me rlung sbor//gnyis med 'dres pa bde ba che/ /dam tshig chen po'i bde ba ༄ bzhi/ /de nyid mkhyen pa ye shes so/ /dbang po bsam pa sgo lnga yi/ /yul dang yul can snang ba'o / /so sor sdud pas rtags thob pa/ /mkhyen mchog ces ni de la bya/ /bcom ldan 'das ni rtogs pa'i don/ /ye shes sku ni bzhi pa'i sku/ /nyams pa bzhi pa'i sku ma yin/ /gtsug tor bde chen dpral ba'i haṃ/ /chen po e yi rnam pa can/ /waṃ las kā li'i phreng ba la/ /tshig gi bdag po zhes bshad do/ /ye shes gtsug tor thig le che/ /rang 'byung ba ni rgyu mi ltos/ /byas pa med cing rnam par spangs/ /rang nyid kyis rig byebasod nams mchog /dā ri ka pa'i zhal snga nas/ /skye ba med pa'i ye shes dephye/ /rdul med nam mkha'i dkyil lta burakhye/ /lus gnas bde bas rgyas pa las/ /dā ri ka pas da lta rnyed/ /ces gsungs so//'jam dpal nor rtse'i thig le las mu/ /ye shes gnyis med bde ba'i rten/ /sems dpa' liṅgā rgyas pa'o/ /ming ni bde chen lhan skyes te/ /yang dag brjod pa'i rgyud mang las/ /mchog gi bsgrub pa 8dam par gsungs/ /don zab rtogs 8—267

dka' mi 'gyur te/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bsgrub bya'ang de'o/ /don ni rgya chen zhing zhes pa/ /lhan skyes dngos rnams khyab pa'o/ /don chen mtshungs med bzhi pa yi//dbang gis thob pa'i cig shos des/ ༄/rab zhi ba ni phyag rgya che/ /nyan rang rnams ni skrag 'gyur ba'o/ /thog ma dga' bas dpa' ba ste/ /bar dang mchog dga' tha mar ni/ /dga' bral dge ba lhan cig skyes/ /'das pa thos pa'i dus dag tu/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa ni/ /bla mas gsungs pa thos nyams myong / /ma 'ongs sgom pa'i dus dag tu/ /rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la ba pa—/ /sgom pa nyams su myong ba'o/ /da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pas de don rtogs pa'o/ /yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang / /rdo rje theg pa nyams su myong / /rang la rang gis bstan pa'o/ /rgyud chen bde chen rgyun 1 chags pa/ /spas khyapa de kho na nyid do/ /sgyu 'phrul mngon par rtogs pa ste/ /dra ba rtsa dang thig ler 'byel/ /rdo rje 'chang chen ye shes sku/ /gsang sngags 'dzin ni bde chen gyi/ /ye shes lnga po ⑪gsal bar 'dzin/ /dpag med rnams ni lam bye brag /bka' bzhin du ni kun du 'od/ /ma mthong bar du rlung 'gog mchog /glur blangs gang lags bshad du gsol/ /zhes ni glu yis ④yid tshim byed—/ /de ltar rang nyid rtogs shing bde/ /mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyis⑤/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur ye shes la/ /thig le bzhi pa'i mtha' can no/ /sdogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /sbyor ba'i yan lag drug yin no/ /'dzin pa thig le 'dzin pa ste/ /dga' bzhi ye shes rgyas par byas/ /nges par 'byung ni haṃ las skyes/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor bar du ni/ /rab tu gsal bar sems can la/ /ji lta bar ni bstan par bya/ /bdag gi rlung gnyis spyor ba 8—268

yis—/ /bsam pa brtan pos thig le bzung /phya/ /de las phyag rgya chen po thob/ /nyon mongs nyams pa'i sdug bsngal la/ /ma lus bsal bar 1gcod pa dang / /mi shes rnam par rtog pa'i gzugs/ /ma lus spang phyir dngos po brtenazhu/ /bsam mi khyab par ji bzhin du/ /nyon mongs byang chub yan lag lam/ /de yang sangs rgyas thod pa las/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdeg med pas/ /de bas 'dod la nan tan du/ /bu khyod kyis ni rtag tu gyis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sems can thig ler gnas pa'o/ /de yang saṃ pu ṭa las kyang ④/ /'di la bsal ba ci yang med/ /bsnan par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rnams la bshad par 'tshal bar ston/ /gsang dbang nor bu'i yan lag na/ /rdo rje yis ni mi bskyod par⑤/ /de skad e waṃ thabs shes rab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gyen gshegs pa'o/ /bde chen sems la gsol mdzad nas/ /thabs shes thal mo sbyar byas te/ /lus btud skar ma'i sbyor ba las/ /spyan sngar 'dug ni rtogs pa'o—/ /de ltar dhū tī la brten nas/ /dga' ba bcu drug rnam dag pas/ /zhus pa'i tshigs bcad bcu drug dag /zhus pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //le'u gnyis pa slar gsungs pa/ /byis pa'i skye bo gdul be+ed du/ /ston pa la sogs mi 'ga' la/ /'dir ni nyachen po'i don bshad pa/ /de nas bcom ldan shākya thub/ /ces pas stishākya thub pa ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rnam snang che/ /a ra li las zas gtsang thabs/ /sgyu ma chen mo shes rab la/ /don grub rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /mchog tu dga' ba bde ba che/ /bcom ldan 'das ni phyag 8—269

rgya che/ /rdzogs pa gtsug tor thig le rdzogs/ /sangs rgyas 'khor drug dag ye shes / /rkang gnyis mchog ni bden pa gnyis/ /yang na gtsug tor nor bu gnyis/ /nyid kyi zhal nas ljags bzang ba/ /zhes pa yi ni don bshad pa/ /'jig rten kun du khyab pa yi/ /ye shes skyes pas ye shes kyi/ /dhū tī mthong rtags mthar thug pa/ /re khā nag po phra ba'i phra/ /longs sku 'phro ba mthong ba'o /de yang dang por stisangs rgyas las/ /du ba smig rgyu srin bu me/ /zhes pa rtags bcu bstan pa'o/ /ring zhing rnam par rtog pa las/ /mtshan rtags /gethob pas blo yangs pa/ /nyin mtshan rab tu brkyang mdzad de/ /de yang 'khor lo sdom pa las—/ /gang tshe goms pa brtan gyur pa/ /gsal snang dngos su mthong bar 'gyur/ /lce rtser phyin pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /ji srid 'dod pa de srid du/ /lce 'phel bar ni 'gyur ba yis/ /de tshe khams gsum po yang blta/ /zhes gsungs so / /'jig rten gsum po lus ngag yid/ /snang byed kyi zhuni rtsa gsum nyid/ /bdud bzhi phung nyon 'chi lha bu/ /dgra rnams bdud sogs nyon mongs rnams/ /'dul byed bde rlung thig le khams/ /ma thul sems can rnams kyi lam/ /'og bltas ④rtsa gsum ngan song gsum/ /zag pa rgyas pas 'khor bar 'khor/ / de nas 7bhemi 'dzag ye shes gsum/ /sbyong bar byed pa'i lhan cig skyes/ /'dzum bstan nas ni dga' ba bzhi/ /tshangs pa dbu ma'i lam yin te/ /gsung ni gyen rgyu'i lam yin te/ /snyan ⑪pa bde rlung sil ④sgra 'byung / /'jig rten gsum po kun bkang nas/ /zhes pa bcu drug rtsa rgyas pas/ /sgo gsum lhan skyes khyab pa'o—/ /lag na rdo rje bsam gtan la/ /stobs po che ni lhan skyes bde/ /rim gyis byon pas dga' bzhi rgyas/ /gsang dbang rdo rje nor bu la/ /slar gsungs 8—270

pa ni mthar thug nas/ /be+er yang ①gnas su gshegs pa'o/ /snying rje che dang ldan gyur pas/ //zhes pa thams cad bde chen khyab/ /rang snang bzhin du bzhin snang ba'o②/ /'gro la rnam par rtag zhepa'i rlung/ /phan pa'i don du 'gog par byed/ /yum ④lngas longs spyod ldan pa khyod/ /ye shes lus ni rdo rje'i lusaske/ /'jam dpal thig le'i khams yin te/ /ming brjod dga' ba skad cig ma/ /don chen rtog med khyabade ba che/ /dag par byed pa rtog spros bral/ /bcing grol thams cad de bzhin nyid/ /sdig sel ba ni srog gcod sogs/ /rtsa ba bzhi dag gos pa med/ / ti lo pa khye yi zhal nas kyang / /ri rab gser gyi logs la gang gnas pa/ /gang gi rang bzhin bor nas gser du snang / de bzhin skye med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin bor nas phyag rgya che/ /zhes gsungs so/ /da ni mchog mi 'gyur ye shes/ /nyan par brtson pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang nyid do/ /legs so nyon mongs ye shes rtogs/ /lag na rdo rje spyor grub la/ /khyod legs so ni bsgom pa'o / /gsang ba to ④ga nor bu'i gnas/ /bdag po lte bar bde ba 'dzin/ /lhan cig skyes pa nyams su myong / /de phyir gsum pa'i dus su ni/ /nga yis khyod la rab tu bstan/ /khyod ni rtog med rtse gcig pas/ /yid kyis ldunyon la bsgom par gyis/ /bcom ldan bha ga btsun mo'i gnas/ /de ni skyon nub pas legs zhes/ /de yang he yi rdo rje las/ /shin tu bzhin bzangs 'umig yangs ma—/ /gzugs dang lang tshos rnam par spras/ /rang gi ⑫dbang bskur snying rje che//rdo rje bu mo 'di khyer la/ /spyod pa byed par rtogs par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gyen la gshegs pa ⑪gsol ba'o/ /gtsug tor chen po la sogs pa'i/ /'khor 8—271

lo drug rtsa'i rnam dag pas/ /slar gsungs sh+lau drug tu dag /slar gsungs pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa pele'u gnyis pa'o// //rigs drug la gzigs le'u ni/ /de nas bcom ldan shākya thub/ /ces pas bcom ldan bde ba la/ /shākya stong pa chen po nyid/ /thub pa nor bu mi 'da' ba'o/ /gang gis gzigs na de yis gzigs/ /gang la gzigs na rigs drug la/ /ji ltar gzigs na 'khor lo drug /sangs rgyas drug tu gzigs pa'o/ /gsang sngags rigs chen thams cad ni/ /'khor lo drug lter khyab pa yis/ /'od gsal ba ni byang chub sems/ /nor bu'i kha nas mi 'pho ba//mi bskyod rdo rje lhan skyes dga'/ /badzi j-ika snyeste 'jig pa med/ /gsang sngags lte rtsa yi ge'i gzugs/ /rig sngags dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'phro 'chang ba'i rigs ni pha yin te/ /lte ba'i 'khor lo dzi na dzika /rnam par snang mdzad chen po'o—/ /rigs gsum rdul mun snying stobs te/ /rnam par gzigs ni mtshan nyid med/ /dang po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /'od dpag med pa ā ro t+paka③ /'jig rten lte ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'jig rten 'das pa snying ga nyid/ /rigs ni rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rin 'byung nyid/ /rat+na dh+rika 'uste gsal bar byed/ /'jig rten zhu ba'i khu ba la/ /snang byed bde chen snang ba'o/ /rigs ⑥ chen don grub ye shes sku/ /haṃ las 'bab pa'i phrin las byed/ /stong pas brgyan pas pradz+nyā j-ika⑨ /phyag rgya chen po rdo rje sems/ /rigs mchog rigs basbus bde chen grol/ /thig le bcu drug yongs sdogs pa/ /bco lnga'i mtha' can rnam par dag /de nyid gtsug tor chen po dang / /rin po 8—272

che yang de nyid do/ /chos kyi rgyal por ①dbang bskur ba/ /de la ston pas cher gzigs pa'o/ /gnas dang phung po dga' ba dang / /las dang lha dang ye shes dang —/ /drug ldan de la gzigs pa'o/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid kyis/ /sh+lau ka gnyis dag pa'o/ /rigs drug la gzigs pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa ste le'u gsum pa'o// //de nas sgyu 'phrul dra ba ni/ /mngon par byang chub le'u la/ /tshig gi bdag po sangs rgyas kyis/ /tshigs su bcad pa sh+lau ka /rtsa yi dra ba ji snyed pa/ /bsdus pas 'khor lo drug tu bsdus/ /de nyid gsang sngags rgyal po drug /ldan zhing badz+ra j-ika ldusna tshogs/ /'khor lo drug la ldan pa'o/ /gnyis su med par 'byung ba dang / /zhes pa kun sgob don dam la/ /kun sgob kun brtags gzhan dbang gnyis/ /don dam yongs su grub pa ste/ /med pa bden pa dbyer med la / /'byung ba sku gsum 'byung ba'o/ /yang na mtha' bzhi bral ba yi/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin no/ /nang du gnyis ni ro rkyang gnyis/ /de ni rtag chad mtha' yin pas/ /med pa kun 'dar ma nyid do/ /ma skyes rang bzhin ro gcig par/ /'byung ba bde chen mchog mi 'gyur/ /de nyid mi skye chos can no/ /'di gsungs pa ni bsam brjod med/ a lta.i yī u u e i o ausaṃ aḥ/ zhes pa 'di yi don bshad na/ /ma ning bzhi ni ma bshad pa/ /skye med ston pa'i rgyud yin phyir/ /yi ge bcu gnyis bsten 1/pa ni/ /sa bcu gnyis su bstan pa yin/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang ni/ /tshajo nye ba'i tshasdo dang / /'du ba byanye ba'i 'du ba phye/dang / /'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung 8—273

gcod dang / /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod dang / /thung ngu drug ni dang po la/ /ring ba drug ni nye ba'o/ /'khor lo drug la 'jug pa dang / /gnas pa ①longs spyod thim pa dang / /bzhi bzhis rlung 'gags mchog thob bo/ /'o na thob lam sa de gang / /zhe na a sogs bcu gnyis ni/ /kun du 'od dang bdud rtsi 'od/ /nam mkha' 'od dang rdo rje 'od/ /rin chen 'od dang pad+ma'i 'od/ /me tog 'od dang dpe med 'od/ /bla ma'i 37'od dang shes rab 'od/ /kun mkhyen dang ni so sor rig /dang po'i thung gsum sgo gsum dga'/ /dang po ring gsum mchog tu dga'/ /gnyis pa thung gsum dga' bral bathu/ /ring gsum lhan cig skyes dga'o/ /dga' bzhi'i rang bzhin pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes pa yi don bshad pa'o/ /de la skye ba'i rnam 'phrul ni/ /sbi to z-i di thig le la/ /dz+nyā na mūt+t+waṃ bde chen te/ /ra haṃ busgo spangs rtogs ldan/ /bud+dhā māṃ ni dhū tī'o/ /rgya dh+wa bat+t+waṃmāṃ ni rlung gsum bsgomathu/ /oṃ badz+ra t+t+waṃkyā zhes pa ni/ /nor bu mi bskyod rlung gcod pa'o/ /duḥkha srid pa ts+tsha 4da ni/ /lte ba'i nang gnas rnam snang mdzad/ /pradz+nyā shes rab 'od dpag med/ /dz+nyā na sprurta ye snying ga /dz+nyā na kā ya don grub ste/ /dpral bar gnas pa thig le'i khams/ /wā gī shwa ra ⑥rin chen 'byung / /mgrin par chos kyi phung po gnas/ /a ra pa tsa na ④rdor sems/ /gtsug tor gnas pa bcom ldan 'das/ /ya te na maḥde phyag 'tshal/ /yang na a ra pa tsa na/ /zhes pa'i yi ge kye don bshad na/ /mi 'gyur ye shes rtogs pa yis/ /'dod chags la sogs sman chen bsten/ /mi 'chi lnga spyad dngos grub thob/ /gsang spyod rigs spyod kun du bzang / /rnal 'byor rig pas dpyad ⑨par bya/ /in+d+ra byu ti'i gsung ngag yin/ /te ltar tshigs bcad gsum po ⑫ des/ /lus ngag yid gsum rnam 8—274

dag pa'o/ /sngags kyi rgya cher 'grel pa ste le'u bzhi pa'o// //le'u lnga pa rdo rje dbyings/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bshad pa ni/ /phung khams dag pa chos kyi dbyings/ /'di ltar phyag rgya chen po la/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das liṅga/ /rtag tu rgyas bde kun du bzang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nor rgyas pa'o/ /a las 'byung ni shes rab phyin/ /'od gsal phyag rgya chen mo la/ /gzugs brnyan snang ba ma mā 1sna khri/ /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /ma ning rdo rje'i bzlas pa yin/ /rlung 'gog bzlas pa mchog sgol ma/ /don chen yi ge yon tan la/ /dam pa thams cad ster bar byed/ /khong nas 'byung ba gtum mo'i me/ /de yang he yi rdo rje las/ /lte bar gtum mo sbar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs te/ /spyan sogs yang ni bsregs byas nas/ /haṃ las ri bong can 'dzag go/ /zhes gsungs so/ /srog chen sgogs byed gos dkar mo/ /tshig tu brjod pa nyams pa'i mtha'/ /spangs pa bde chen brtan spyan ma/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /bde stong dbyer med ye shes so/ /tshig kun rtsa rlung yi ge'i gzugs/ /gtum mos klag ⑤pas bde stong gsal/ /de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /nyams su myong ba mchod pa ste/ /phyi rol rdzas rnams rgya chen phul—/ /dam pa gsum gyis bsngo byas nas/ /'di phyi'i yon tan rjes 'brangs pas—/ /thar pa'i rgyur gyur shin tu dka'/ /thar pa'i ci —smos khams gong ma'i//rgyur gyur pa yang ting 'dzin dang 0/ /de byed rnam par g.yengs phyir ro/ / de nas 'a mchod chen ma yin no/ /bdud rtsi bsten sogs 'dod yon spyadasku/ /de yang rgyud 3pa'i rgyu min pas/ /mchod chen ma yin mchod chen ni/ /dug lnga'i de 8—275

nyid rtogs pa de'i/ /gsum pa'i ye shes gcig pu yin/ /chen po'i shes rab ye shes so/ /'dod chags gsum dus ye shes che/ /sems can las can skal bzang shesnal/ /sgo gsum dpag med dga' bar byed/ /mchod pa chen po gong bzhin la/ /zhe sdang che ni rlung 'gog pa'o/ /des ni bde g.yos rtog med pas/ /spang bya nyon mongs kun gyi sgra/ /che ba 'di la 3mi bskyod pa'o/ /mchod pa chen po gti mug che/ /srog rtsol dhū ṭī'i lam zhugs pas/ /gti mug blo ni shes rab la / /gti mug sel ba snang mdzad pa'o/ /mchod pa chen po gong dang mtshungs/ /khro ba chen po nyams pa 'joms/ /yang na dga' bral ye shes la/ /khro ba chen po lhan cig skyes/ /drag po chen po don grub pobye / /mchod pa chen po 'dod pa che/ /bde bas sems bsdus mi rtog rgyas/ /de yis 'dod pa thams cad nyid/ /sel bar byed phyir rin po che/ /chags pa nyid na chags pa med/ /'dod sogs lnga po dbyer med pa/ /drug pa rdor 'chang dus 'khor lo/ /'dod pa chen po lus bde ba/ /bde ba chen po gang bde ba/ /dga' ba chen po sems bde ba/ /mgu ba che ni ye shes bde/ /de yang ma log gnyid song dang / /rmi lam rmi lam chen po dang / /de nyid sprul longs spyod 5bde chen/ /dga' ba dga' bzhir nyams su myong / /gzungs yeche thig les liṅga rgyas/ /lus kyang 'od gsal che ba ste / /longs spyod rdzogs sku yul rgyas pa'o/ /de ni lus kyi dga' ba mchog /kha dog che zhing yon tan rgyas/ /lus po byuche ba dhū t+t+waṃ rgyas/ /de ni ngag gi mchog dga'o/ /ming yang che zhing mchog gsang theg /rgya che des khyab bde sems dga'/ /dkyil ni bde ba snying po la/ /'khor ni rtsa thig rlung gis bskor/ /chen po'i chos nyid yangs pa yin/ /sgyu ma lta bur shar ba'o/ /de ni ye shes 8—276

mchog dga'o/ /de ni longs sku'i dga' bzhi'o1/ /shes rab mtshon chen stong pa nyid / /'chang ba dngos rnams 'joms pa ste/ /nyon mongs chen po las brgya ⑤yi / /pad+ma la brten skyes pa yi/ /bde myong lus kyi dga' bral dga'/ /be+egs kyu'i mchog ni ye shes kyi/ /'dod pas 'khrig chags bzhi bde ba/ /de ni ngag gi dga' bral dga'/ /grags chen me rlung sgra yin la/ /snyan grags gsal snang ye shes te/ /sems kyi dga' bral dga' ba'o/ /snang ba chen po rdo rje thabs/ /gsal ba chen po shes rab yum/ /gnyis med spyor bas bde rgyas pa/ /ye shes dga' bral dga' ba'o/ /mkhas pa bde stong thabs la mkhas/ /sgyu 'phrul snang stong chen po 'chang / /de ni lus kyi lhan skyes dga'/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po phyag rgya bzhi / /'grub pa med pas don grub pa'o/ /ngag gi lhan cig skyes dga'o4/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po bha ga la/ /dga' bas dga' ni bde myong ba'o/ /de ni sems kyi lhan skyes dga' ba'o5/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po rtsa 'khor lo/ /mig 'phrul can ni zhen pa'o/ /de ni ye shes lhan skyes skyodaga'/ /gtsug tor rdo rje nor bu'i bar/ /dga' gsum dga' ba bcu gnyis las/ /mas yar dga' ba dga' bzhi ste/ /gnyis mnyam gnyis gnas dbus dag na/ /bde dang mi rtog mtshan dang bral/ /lhan byug skyes pa'i yul can la/ /dga' bral rtog zhes brjod du gsungs3/ /dga' ba rnam pa bcu drug go/ /rgyas par bshad pa dri med ltos/ /sbyin bdag chen po phyi nang gtong bye/ /gtso bo sgeg mos lhan skyes ster/ /'jig rten sbyin las khyad par 'phags/ /tshul khrims chen po byang chub sems/ /'chang ba mi mnyam nor bu yi tsu—/ /rtse mor phreng ba ma nyams mchog /bzod chen bde bas sems bsdus blus/ /'chang ba mi 'phro brtan pa'o/ /brtson 'grus chen po 8—277

g.yas g.yon rlung / /dhū ṣ+ṭṛr brtul ba 'phar g.yo gar/ /bsam gtan chen po bde stong la/ /ting 'dzin me tog rtse gcig blta/ /shes rab chen po stong pa nyid / /lus ni ma rig mun pa'i dngos/ /'chang ba gnyen po'i mar rnge 'dzin/ /stobs po che ni rlung grub pa/ /mkha' la 'gro ba'i bdug spos can/ /thabs che bas 1ni bde 'phel bas/ /lus rnams kun la khyab par byug /smon lam khu ba mnyam za bas/ /chos rnams dpe brgyad sa spyod ma/ /ye shes me rlung rgya mtsho ni//bin+d+ra rtedung khang gnas pa ste/ /mkha' spyod rnam par dag pa'o/ /byams chen shes bya bde bar shar/ /rang bzhin spros bral dpag med rtogs/ /snying rje chen po chags bcas la/ /blo yi mchog ni bde stong myong / /shes rab chen po gang du yang / /dmigs su med pa phyag rgya che/ /blo chen ldan ni dga' bzhi'o/ /mkhas pa chen po zhes pa ni/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las/ /sems dpa' reg pa chags pa rgyas/ /shin tu chags chen 'dar ba dang / /g.yo dang 'khrug dang yid 'khrug dang / /myos dang brgyal ༄ ba bcu ru 'dod/ /de nyid nang du sbyar ba yis/ /so so bsdu ba'i mtshan ma bcu/ /thabs chen yul ni nyi shu bzhir/ /bde bas khyab pa dpa' bo'o/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i stobs dang ldan/ /zhes pa rlung rnams 'chun pa'o/ /shugs chen byang sems mi nyams pa/ /mgyogs pa chen po rtsa kun khyab/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po cher grags pa/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /bde bas bdag gzhan bskul nus pa'o/ /stobs chen mtshams med lnga sogs las/ /pha rol gnod thupa des mi gos/ /de yang rdo rje theg pa las / /gdol ba spyig zhem mkhan la sogs/ /mtshams med lnga sogs byed pa'i mi 6 / /gsod pa don du gnyer bas kyang / /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /8—278

zhes pa'o/ /srid pa'i ri bo 'jig tshogs kyi/ /lta ba drug cu rtsa gnyis so/ /chen po gzhig par dka' ba'o/ /'joms ni bde chen spros bral lo/ /bde chen thob rtags gang zhe na/ /mkhregs shing nor bu'i rtsa gnas la/ /rdo rje chen po liṅga rgyas/ /'chang ba rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ /de nyid drag po chen po ste/ /drag shul chen po dug gsum 'joms/ /'jigs chen rtag pa 'jigs par byed/ /'jigs par byed pa chad pa 'joms/ /mgon po rigs mchog phyag rgya che/ /chen po de las hūṃlhag med pa'o/ /bla ma bde ba chen po la/ /gsang sngags bde —ba'i dam tshig bsrung / /che ba'i mchog ni thabs mchog go/ /theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas/ /zhes pa thabs 'dis 'jig rten 'di/ /'dir 'degs pas na tshul la gnas/ / de nas phyajeg pa chen po yi/ /tshul ni he ru bdag med ma — //mchog ni rdo rje pad+mar spyor/ /gtsug tor dpral ba mgrin pa snying / /lte ba gsang ba nor bu rtse/ /'gro dang byon pa bcu bzhi yis/ /tshigs bcad bcu bzhi rnam par dag /rdo rje'i lus nyid rdo rje dbyings/ /gnas bdun byon gshegs bde myong ba/ /lha'o des na dkyil 'khor te/ /brgyad brgya bcu gnyis bzhugs pa'o / /rdo rje dbyings kyi rgya cher 'grel pa ste le'u lnga pa'o// //le'u drug pa chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam par snang mdzad dkyil 'khor ni/ /sangs rgyas bde chen gsol bar mdzad/ /rnam par snang mdzad 'od gsal che/ /thub pa chen po mi nyams bde/ /thub chen ldan pa sgo gsum brgyas(/ /gsang sngags tshul chen bde stong la/ /de las byung ba 'dod yon lam/ /gsang sngags tshul chen dbang bzhi la/ /rig pa bzhi yi bdag nyid can/ /pha rol phyin bcu 8—279

thob pa ste/ /ces pa bum dbang rdzas bcu ster/ /gsum la ①rdzas gsum ster sbyin pa/ /gnyis sbyor byang sems brtan 'dzin pa/ /tshul khrims rtog bral bzod pa'o/ /brtson 'grus ba thag tsam mi 'jig /bde stong mi g.yo bsam gtan no/ /shes rab lha mo'i phyag rgya las/ /bla ma'i zhal las rnyed pa'o/ /thabs ni gong gis phyam rtogs na/ /ka ra na bcu la brten nas/ /'gog dang zlog ri dang khyab sogs thabs/ /de yang sdom pa rgya mtsho las/ /kun du tsulba kuṇ+ḍa li / /na khas rtse dang nā ④das rtse/ /yang dag spyor dang sid ces smra/ /nyed cing skyes pa ltar byed pa/ /brgyad la brgyad brgyad dbye ba yis/ /byed pa drug cu rtsa bzhir 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /smon lam bde chen mi 'bral ba/ /stobs ni bzlog 3dka' zlog pa'o/ /ye shes lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /phyin bcu thob pas dbang rdzogs pa'o/ /de yang kadza'i zhal snga nas/ dur khrod chen po'i dgon par rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis/ /gser snod dag tu seng ge'i zho ldugs tshe na phan tshun du/ /dbul ba sel dang bsil ba thob pas 7tswadang po gnyis/ /rjes chags khro med le lo med pas gnyis pas gsum dang bzhi/ /rtse gcig rtog bral gsum pas lnga pa drug pa de bzhin gzhan/ /'gog len khyab byed gnas pa 'khrul 'khor rlung thabs stobs/ /gnas dang nye gnas la sogs bcu gnyis smon 'debs de bzhin nyid/ /bde dang cig shos dbyer med gnas pa gzhi ni bzhi pa ste / /bla ma dam pa'i drin gyis bdag la 'di 'dra gsal bar snang / /zhes gsungs so/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu la gnas/ /zhes pa khams bcu 'joms pa ste/ /rlung dang sems dang byang chub sems/ /khrag dang rkang dang rus sprupa dang / /rus pa sha dang dbang po dang / /pags pa la sogs bcu po de/ /bde 8—280

bas khyab brtan gnas pa'o/ /de nyid gnas dang dag par 'dod/ /pha rol phyin bcu dag pa ste/ /zhes pa yul dang yul can dag /pha rol phyin pa bcu yi tshul / /zhes pa ka ra na bcu yis/ /bde stong skyes pa tshul chen no/ /mgon po bde chen he ru ka /sa bcu gnas dang nye gnas sogs/ /dbang phyug mi 'dzag dga' ye shes/ /sa bcu la ni gnas pa'o/ /zhes pa ka ra na bcu la/ /sbyin sogs re res brgyan pa'o/ /shes bcu rnam dag bdag nyid can/ /zhes pa lta stangs shes pa las/ /rnam dag thob rtags rnam pa bcu/ /du ba smig rgyu srin bu me / /'bar ba zla sngon mkha' dag dang / /thig le re khā nag po'o/ /bdag nyid can ni sna tshogs pa'o/ /longs sku mthong ba yin par 'dod/ /shes bcu rnam dag 'chang ba po/ /zhes pa bug med nam mkha' dag /bltas te dbang po yul yul can/ /gcig tu gyur pa mthong ba ni/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug yin te//rtags rtogs ldan pa 'chang ba yin/ /dpal ldan dang po'i rmyesangs rgyas las/ /nam mkhar sems gtad mig mi 'dzums/ /rdo rje lam zhugs rtags bcu mthong //zhes so/ /rnam pa bcu po don bcu'i don/ /zhes pa rnam bcu gong rtags la/ /sha la sogs pa spyan lnga yis/ /yul dang yul can mthong ba'o/ /thub dbang thustobs bcu zhes pa ni/ /gyen thur med khyab srog dang ni/ /klu dang rus rtsangs nor lha sbyin/ /khyab pa'i bdag nyid bde stong ngo / /kun gyi nyi khri chig stong la/ /don ni 'gog cing ma lus byed/ /rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po/ /me dang zla ba nyi ma dang / /thig le nag po thig le che/ /sangs rgyas longs sku mthong ba'o/ /de yang dang po'i rngusangs rgyas las/ /tshe las yo byad skye dang chos/ /rdzu 'phrul mos sgon sems ye shes/ /rtags bcu'i grub pa dbang bcu'o/ /zhes gsungs 8—281

so / /thog ma med pa skyedaga' ba la/ /spros med bdag ni mchog dga'o/ /de bzhin nyid ni lhan cig skyes/ /dag pa'i bdag ni dga' bral lo/ /bden par rang bzhin myong bzhin pa/ /smra zhing rigs ldan bu la ni/ /tshig mi 'gyur ni don dang rtags/ /bde ba che la sbyor ba'o/ /shes rab bu ni bla ma yis/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed/ /ces pa 'dzag pa spong ba'o/ /gnyis med gnyis su med par ston/ /zhes pa 'di yi don bshad na/ /dang po rtog pa bsgom (kyepa ste/ /de nas rtog med skye ba yin/ /zer ba mi 'thad rgyu 'dra las/ /'bras bu 'dra ba byung phyir ro/ /sā lu las ni khre min no/ /des na rtog med rgyu las ni/ /'bras bu rtog med ye shes skye/ /yang dag ye shes mtha' nor bu/ /de la rnam par gnas pa ni/ /mi 'dzag ye shes dga' ba'i sems/ /bdag med chos rnams brjod du med/ /seng ge rim zhuganon sgra ldan pas/ /mu stegs de nyid mi shes pa—/ /stong sgras ri dwags ngan 'jigs byed/ /kun du 'gro ba bde chen po/ /don yod stobs ni spyor bas brtson/ /ji ltar 'bab ④pa de bzhin du/ /dung khang gnas su be+er gshegs pa'i/ /bde chen khyab pa yid ltar mgyogs/ /rgyal ba 'dod chags las rgyal dga'/ /rnam rgyal rlung rgyal dga' ye shes/ /dgra las rgyal ba ma rig sogs/ /rten 'byel las rgyal lhan skyes so/ /'khor lo drug la sgyur ba ni/ /rtsa la thig les 75brgyan pa'o/ /stobs po che ni dpung bzhi ste/ /snang ba thob dang snang ba mched/ /brtan dang de kho na zhus bzhi'o/ /tshogs kyi stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /slob dpon shu kra ye shes so/ /tshogs kyi dga' gsum mchog ldan skyes/ /tshogs ni skad cig gsum yin te/ /rje ni mtshan med skad cig ma/ /tshogs ni phyag rgya gsum yin te/ /bdag po phyag rgya chen po'o/ /8—282

chos can bco brgyad de dag la/ /dbang dang ldan pas dbang ldan no/ /mthu chen bde chen gces pa la/ /rtag tu nyams med 'dzin pa ste/ /de nyid tshul chen rtags bcu thob/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog bcos ma med/ /tshig rje dag gis mchog sbyin nus/ /tshig ni so sor yang dag rig /tshig bdag smra mkhas zhes pa ni / /grub chen brgyad sogs phrin las rnams/ /tshig gi hūṃnus pas nges tshig rig /tshig la dbang ba don rig pa'o/ /tshig mtha' yas pa shes rab rgyas/ /spobs pa so sor rig pa'o/ /tshig bden kun rdzob lha dkyil 'khor/ /bden par smra ba don dam ste/ /rdzogs rim rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /de yang mkha' 'gro kun spyod las/ /thams cad bden pa gnyis la ni/ /brten par ngas ni rtag bshad pa/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub phyir/ /sgom pa zhumangon du gyur pa yin / /rgyud rnams kyi ni rnal 'byor pa/ /bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bden pa bzhi ni sdug bsngal sogs/ /ston pa'o ni dga' bzhir ston/ /phyir mi ldog pa rlung grub pas/ /phyir mi 'ong ba thig le brtan/ /'dren pa rang gis rig gi rlung / /hūṃ has bde rlung 'dren pa'o/ /rang rgyal de yis khams rgyas pa/ /bse ru a wa dhū tī yin/ /tshul ni mya ngan 'das pa'o/ /nges 'byung rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /sna tshogs theg pa sna tshogs lam/ /las byung ji ltar de ltar snang / /'byung ba chen po rgyu gcig po/ /zhes pa 'byung ba lnga yin la/ /chen po de las chos kun skyes/ /rgyu ni rgyu dang rkyen nyid do/ /gcig po chos dang chos can gyisasnye/ /rgyu rkyen gyur pa 'di nyid yin/ /chos ni 'byung la chos can ni/ /rnam par shes pa de la drug /shes pa skye ba'ang chos yin te/ /shes pa nyid na ci zhig shes/ /shes med sems ni 'od gsal ba/ /don dam 8—283

des na mya ngan 'das/ /'du shes med 'gog snyoms 'jug yin/ /theg pa chen po'i bsgrub bya ni/ /srid pa gsum la dmigs nas ni/ /mig 'phrul lta bu'i rnam pa yis/ /lam la thub pa'i yon tan len/ /kun rdzob 'khor dang myang 'das gnyis/ /'byung dang 'byung las gyur pa'o/ /de nyid don du bden 'dod pa/ /nyan thos phyi rol pa yi lugs/ /shes pa snang ba yin no zhes/ /gsal ba dam pa'i don 'dod pa/ /cig shos rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams/ /'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /khyad par cung zad yod min pas/ /kun rdzob mig 'phrul lta bur snang / /don dam rang bzhin med pa nyid/ /gnyis med phyag rgya chen por 'dod/ /rdo rje gsum gyi byed pa la/ /'byung dang 'byung 'gyur chos rnams gnas/ /sku rdo rje la sra ba sa/ /gsher ba chu ste dro ba me/ /bskyod pa rlung ste go 'byed mkha'/ /gsung rdo rje yi rnam pa ni/ /ā li shes rab ye shes khams/ /kā li thabs las khams lnga 'byung / /ka tsa ṭa ta pa lnga sa/ /kha tsha ṭha tha pha lnga chu/ /ga dza ḍa da ba lnga me/ /gha dzha bhā dha bha lnga rlung / /nga nya ṇa na ma lnga mkha'/ /ka tsa ṭa ta pa tshoye shes/ /mgrin rkang spyi bo mchu so las/ /'byung phyir mkha' rlung me chu sa/ /a ku e rka ha 1lnga ni/ /mgrin sgra nam mkha'i khams yin no/ /i tsu k+ṣa ya sha lnga ni/ /rkan sgra rlung gi khams yin no/ /ṛ ṭu ra ṣa ar lnga ni/ /spyi bo'i sgra ste me yi khams/ /u pu pa kruwa o lnga ni/ /mchu sgra chu yi khams yin no/ /rba tu la sa al ④lnga ni/ /so sgra sa yi khams yin no/ /'byung gnas lnga las byung ba yi / /'byung ba'i nus pa'i me tog ni/ /kha dog yi ge dug lngar smin/ /yi ge dang po'i sgra brtag phyapa/ /dbyangs dgra 9dbyangs la gsal byed dgra/ /gsal byed rang nyid yin par 'dod/ /gsal dbyangs thabs shes gnod pa med/ /8—284

dbyangs yig dgra gyur 'chi ba ste/ /gsal byed dgrar gyur nad kyis lkuthebs /yan lag dgrar gyur dpal 'phrog byed/ /dbang thang mi mthun rnyed pa med/ /de rnams mthun par gyur pas na/ /tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor ldan/ /phal pas btang snyoms 'bras gsal min/ /chu dgra rlung la rlung dgra sa/ /sa dgra me la me dgra chu/ /nam mkha' kun grogs mthun pa'o/ /sa bshes chu la chu bshes sa / /me bshes rlung la rlung bshes me/ /rlung bran chu la me bran sa/ /chu bran me la sa bran rlung / /dgras gnod bshes kyis 3phan par byed/ /bran ni tshur phan phar gnod pa'o/ /phal pas gsum char med par 'dod/ /'byung chen srog la 'byung chung lus/ /yan lag dpal la rkyen dbang thang / /gcig pur gyur na de nyid kyisagye/ /bye brag las ni bzhir shes bya/ /srog mthun tshe ring lus chomathun pas / /nad med dpal mthun dpal dang ldan/ /dbang thang mthun pas longs spyod 'phel/ /mi mthun tshe thung nad mang zhing / /sems med dpal med longs spyod 'grib/ /phal pas phan dang gnod pa med/ /bran gyis gcig gnod gcig la phan/ /mkha' 3gnyis dbyengs dang ye shes bzang / /gsum ni dbyer med mchog yin te/ /bzhi pas bshig par byed pa yin/ /rlung gnyis srog rtsol ngan pa ste/ /gsum gyi ye shes bzang por 'gyur/ /me gnyis phan khupa yun thung thabasamu/ /gsum ni snyug bsngal sna tshogs 'khrug /chu gnyis bzang po gsum yang btub/ /bzhi pa thams cad gong dang mtshungs/ /sa gnyis bzang po gsum pa khyabatub/ /bzhi pa bzang po lnga pa spang kye / /phan tshun phan gnod stobs las shes/ /stobs mnyam dpal dang dbang thang srog /gsum gyi cha stobs las phan tshun shes/ /de nyams kun du 'gran par byos/ /phan 'dogs 8—285

de yi grogs kyis bya/ /gnod byed de yi dgra yis bya/ /tshe dang nad ①dang dpal dang grogasakhya/ /srog lus dpal dang dbang thang la/ /de dang de yi gnyen pos byed / /sa ni ser po sa gru bzhi/ /chu ni dkar po chu zlum po/ /me ni dmar po me gru gsum/ /rlung ni sngon po rlung zla gam/ /nam mkha' kun grogs mdog dbyibs bral/ /de nyid gcig tu phan gnod dka'/ /'byung ba re la las drug ste / /bsnun dang dbab dang sreg 3pa dang / /tshim dang gso dang dgyes pa'o/ /re re'ang thig les brgyan par bya/ /sgon ma'i ming la mtshon byas na/ /oṃ ṭ+wāḥngaphaṭa ni bsnun pa'o/ /oṃ yāḥhūṃ 'u'abe+ebs pa'o/ /oṃṭ+wāḥbo ṭuṣaṭa sreg pa'o/ /oṃ dz+nyāḥ3na ma tshim pa'o/ /oṃ ltuḥswā hā gso ba'o/ /oṃ s+t+waṃ ge/ba ṣaṭa dgyes pa'o/ /'byung ba dar dang rgud sh+yidang mnyam/ /gsos btab shed smad 6gnyis gnyis nas / /re re la yang shes par bya/ /'byung chung nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ /dbyibs mdog las kyang nyi shu lnga / /dus phyogs nyon mongs nyi shu lnga / /spong thob 'dod pas shes par bya/ /sham+bha la dang siṅga gling / /'dzam bu gling sogs dpag med na / /yi ge grangs dang gog sa dang / /ming mi 'dra ba gang yod kyang / /'byung gnas lnga las byung shes pas/ /de yis sgra rnams thams cad shes/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /sngags kyi de nyid mi shes par/ /gang zhig lha sgrub ⑪las byed pa/ /nam mkha' bza' bar 'dod dang mtshungs/ /de phyir sngags pa rnams la ni/ /phan 'dod dri med 'od kyi don/ /cung zad bdag gis 'dir ni blangs/ /de yang dgyes pa rdo rje las/ /bo la kasko la spyor bas/ /reg pa sra ba sa yi khams/ /gsher ba chu ste dro ba me/ /bskyod pa rlung khams bde nam mkha'//lnga yis yongs su bskor ba yin/ /dge slong nyon mongs med pa'o/ /dgra bcom 8—286

'dod chags bde 'gyur ba/ /zag pa dri chu khu zad pa'o/ /'dod chags 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /bral bas dbang gsum ye shes la/ /dbang po thul ba bzhi pa'i dus/ /bde ba rnyed pas mi 'dzag pa'o/ /'jigs med thob ni 'khor ba med / /bsil bar gyur pa chags pa zad/ /rnyog pa med ni dwangs ma'o/ /de yang 'khor lo sdom pa las/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags rnam par spangs/ /gdul bya de rnams shes nas kyang / /yi ge las byung rnam par spangs/ /tshangs pa nyid du gyur nas phyis/ /nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so / /rig ①pa dang ni gsum skyes srizhu / /rkang par shes rab ye shes la/ /ldan pa bzhi pa'i ye shes so/ /bde gshegs thig le 'jig rten rig /nyon mongs byang lam rtog kyepa'i mchog /bdag gir mi 'dzin dga' ba ste/ /las rgya yin no ngar mi 'dzin/ /mchog dga' yi ni chos rgya'o/ /bden pa gnyis kyi tshul la gnas/ /zhes pa lhan skyes dam rgya la/ /'khor ba'i pha rol mthar son pa/ /dga' bral dga' ba phyag rgya che/ /bya ba byas pas skam sar gnas/ /rim gyis bzhi par gnas pa'o/ /shes pa 'ba' zhig chos rnams te/ /nges gsal lhan skyes ye shes rtogs/ /shes rab mtshon cha stong nyid kyis/ /nyon mongs nye nyon rnams ④'joms pa'o/ /dam pa bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /chos ni rngubargyad khri bzhi stong la/ /chos rgyal e baṃ chos kun dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi pha ma'o/ /gsal bar kā khuli ldan pa a/ /de las chos rnams thams cad skyes/ /de yang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ /ā li kā li ma gtogs 3par/ /gal te rdo rje'i chos 'dod pa/ /'dis ni 'bras bu ma yin te/ /phub ma rdung dang 7byed dang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'jig rten ma rtogs log rtogs so/ /snang 8—287

bar zhes lkupa'i de nyid mthong / /mchog ni lhan skyes ye shes so/ /chos kyi dbang phyug haṃ las ni/ /rang byin zlob pa chos kyi rgyal/ /legs pa'i lam ni chags bcas pa/ /spyod lam mi spyod snon sripa'o/ /don grub mchog tu mi 'gyur thob/ /bsam pa grub pa ste zhes pa/ /las rgya sdug bsngal snod yin pas/ /spangs te ye shes phyag rgya las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mngon byed pa'o/ /kun du rtog pa mi mo la / /brten pa'i bde ba thams cad spang 1/ /rnam par mi rtog yan lag drug /phag pyamo bdag med ma bsten ⑤te/ /dbyings mi zad ⑥pa'i ye shes thob/ /'di ni rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /de yang gsungs pa/ /rnam par rtog pa gang gang gis//dngos po gang la gang rtog pa/ /de nyid kun du brtags pa yi/ /ngo bo nyid med de med do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'o na spang bya kho na'am/ /zhe na chos dbyings dam pa la/ /zad mi shes pa'i thabs yod pas/ /blo ngan rnams la bstan pa yin / /de yang klu las khros pa las/ /zhi bas phan par ma gyur na/ /de bzhin gshegs nyid khro bor sprul/ /ji ltar ji ltar btul gyur pa/ /'di yi byed pa rdo rje sems/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bsod nams snying rje chen po la/ /ldan pa chags pa'i blun 3pa'o/ /bsod nams mi 'dzag bde ba'i sems/ /tshogs ni phyag rgya chen po'i thabs 5/ /de yang / lus la ye shes chen por kyeganas/ /'di rtogs grol bar kun 'dod la/ /de rtogs thabs ni bsod ye shes/ /yin par kun mthun thabs mi mkhas/ /bsod nams phyir bsog ⑩ye shes ni/ /blo yis byas pas thar pa ring / /'dir ni bsod nams dkyil 'khor che/ /bcud rnams kyis mchod mnyes khu'aphel bas/ /bde stong rgyas pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'di 'dra'i ⑫bsod nams gang la srid/ /ye shes tshogs rnams ⑫de nyid do/ /8—288

des na rgyud rnams kun las kyang / /dka' thub dka' spyad 'dir mi dgos/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams la/ /ci bde bar ni spyad pas 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /ye shes nor bu dmigs med bde/ /ye shes haṃ skyes thig le'i khams/ /'byung gnas che ni de nyid do/ /de yang rgyud las 'di skad gsungs/ /rlung bcings pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsreg⑨ /rtog med ye shes la sbyor ba/ /lus kyi thabs la brten pa mchog /ces gsungs so/ /rang la ye shes ldan pa yis/ /yod mi shes pa 'di yin te/ /pha rol ye shes yod med shes/ /yang na mtha' bral rtogs pa'o/ /tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa'o / /zhes pa ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /sprul pa sprul te 'gro don nus/ /'di 'dra'i bde stong snying rje'i sems/ /med par dka' thub zas spong sogs/ /rgya mtsho rus sbal khog gshog ②'dra/ /rtag pa mi nyams kun rgyal ba/ /rtsa stong phrag ni bdun cu gnyis/ /bde chen rang bzhin rgyas pa ste/ /rnal 'byor can ni sgo gsum dag /de yang lus las gsungs pa ni/ /ye shes tsam la snyoms 'jug pa//rnal 'byor zhes ni de bshad do/ /zhes so/ /bsam gtan dga' bzhi bsam bya ni / /rlung dang rtsa rnams dran pa'o/ /yang na snying ga 1pad+ma'i gnas/ /cha med dran pa blo ldan mchog /so sor rang rig mi g.yo ba/ /zhes pa gzhon nu sa ha dzās④/ /rig la smra bar ma nus pa'o/ /mchog gi dang po lhan cig skyes/ /sku gsum 'chang ba rdo rje sems/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes pa ma log log pa dang / /rmi lam rmi lam chen po dang / /sad pa gnas skabs lnga po ni—/ /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /khyab bdag lhan cig skyes pa la/ /ye shes lnga ni gnas skabs lnga/ /ye shes dag dang ldan pa'o/ /de yang te yi rdo rje 8—289

las / /bo la kak+ko la spyor nas/ /zhes pa 'di ru sbyor ba yin/ /sangs rgyas lnga bdag rigs lnga la/ /cod pan lnga phung dag rtags su/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'chang ba'o—/ /spyan lnga mtshan mo'i 1rtags lnga la/ /bltas pas chags pa med pa 'chang / /de yang dra ba sdom pa las/ /dang po ri dwags srid du snang ba ste/ /mtshan ma gnyis pa dud kha'i rnam pa can/ /gsum pa me khyer dang 'dra bzhi pa ni//sprin med nam mkha' mtshan ma lnga pa ni/ /shin tu 'od gsal rang gi snang ba 'char/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas thams cad skyed 5pa'o/ /zhes pa sprul longs sogs mthong la/ /nyin mo'i rtags mthong mngon shes drug /sangs rgyas sras po byang chub sems/ /dam pa'i mchog ni bye /bskyed pa'o/ /shes pa srid 'byung dkyil 'khor la/ /skye gnas med ni rdzogs pa'i rim/ /de yang gsungs pa / bskyed pa'i rim la rab gnas shing / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom blabyed pa//sangs rgyas thabs dang ldan pa yis/ /skas kyi sen mo bzhin du bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ /chos las 'byung ba bha ga la/ /baṃ gzhag pa yi srid pa sel6/ /gcig pu sra mkhregs rdo rje'i bdag /ces pa rkyelhan skyes ye shes so/ /dngos de skyes ma thag tu ni/ /kun gyi don grub 'gro ba'i bdag /smin cing 'khrul 'khor ldan pa yis/ /nam mkha' las byung rang byung byeb/ /rtags brgyad mthong ba 'di lta ste/ /shes rab ye shes me bo che/ /rang sems 'bar ba'i rnam pa can/ /mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /'od chen rnam par snang ba'o/khya/ /zla ba'i ye shes rnam snang mdzad/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ /nyi ma'i ye shes rin chen 'byung //'gro ba'i ye shes mar me sgron/ /rā hu ye shes don yod grub/ /gzi brjid chen po 'od gsal ba/ /glog gi ye shes mtha' yas nyid/ /sngags drag mnga' bdag 8—290

rig sngags rgyal/ /thig le gnas pa'i ye shes te/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid do/ /gsang sngags rgyal po don chen byed/ /zla sngon snang ba'i ye shes ni/ /te ru ka dpal nyid du 'dod/ /gtsug tor chen po'i lta stangs kyis/ /re khā nag po ye shes mthong / /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ / rmad 'byung nyugatsug ni rdo rje 'chang / /thams cad mthong ba mchog thob pa'o/ /nam mkha'i bdag po ta ra na/ /sna tshogs ston pa yon tan no/ /de yang dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ /ta ra na bcings yon tan gyis/ /srid pa gsum po ma g.yos pas/ /nam mkha'i bdag por de gyur te/ /rtags bcu la sogs sna tshogs ston/ /zhes gsungs so//sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po ni/ /rtags rnams snang bas dngos po mchog /de 'dra mthong ba'i rnal 'byor te/ /kun dga' chen po ṭu mig dang ldan/ /ldan chos lta stangs bzhi yin te/ /sna tshogs gzugs can rtags mtshan rnams/ /byed 1pa po ni yan lag drug /mchod cing brjod pa bsnyen sgrub chobazhi/ /drang srong chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /rigs gsum gnas dang zhing ye shes/ /'chang ba de la bde ba yod/ /gsang sngags 'chang ni rnal 'byor pa/ /thig le mi nyams gsang sngags 'dzin/ /dam tshig chen po rtag tu bde/ /gtso bo rtsa gsum dkon mchog gsum/ /'dzin pa de nang thig le 'dzin/ /theg pa mchog gsum ston pa po/ /zhes pa lhan skyes ye shes rten/ / skal ba 4snyedang ni khyogs gdugs so/ /don yod thig le zhags pa ni/ /rlung gis 4/'bigs pas rnam par rgyal/ /'dzin pa 'khor lo drug tu ni/ /rlung 'gog chen po rdo rje zhags/ /rlung gis de blangs rdo rje yi/ /lcags kyu zhags pa che zhes bya/ /yang na zhags pa che zhes pa/ /lte ba'i 'og rtsa 'khyil pa ni/ /nor rgyas ming can rlung de yis/ /8—291

dhū tī nas 'phags byang sems 'gugs/ /de la zhags pa zhes brjod do/ /lus ni yul chen nyi shu bzhi/ /dpral ba la sogs sbyar ba dang/ /snying dbus pad+ma'i 'dab mar ldan/ /gnas gtso yin te rtsa lnga yi①/ /tshigs bcad nyi shu rtsa lnga dag /rnam par snang mdzad chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rgya cher 'grel pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //le'u bdun pa rdo rje'i rigs tshigs su bcad pa bcu dang gcig /dang po rdo rje 'jigs byed ni/ /rdo rje a wa dhū tī la/ /de nang rlung ni 'jigs byed do/ /'jigs dā par byed ni de rtog bshigs1/ /khro bo'i rgyal po dga' bral mtha' /so sor sdud sogs gdong drug la/ /'jigs pa des ni rtog pa gcod/ /mig drug mngon shes lag drug rtags/ /stobs dang ldan ni 'dod chags kyis/ /chags pa thams cad 'joms pa'o/ /keng rus spyi bo'i haṃ dkar po/ /mche ba a shad gcigs pa'o/ /bla ma'i gdams pas gtum mo sbyor④/ /ha la ha la mkha' ye shes/ /gdong brgya rtsa rlung lhong pa yisa'u/ /ye shes mi 'dra gdong brgya'o/ /gshin rje gnyis med ye shes te/ /gshed po de yis gnyis snang 'joms/ /bgegs kyi rgyal ni bdud bzhi rgyal/ /rdo rje yang dag ye shes la/ /shugs chen 6zhes pas 'jigs par byed/ /rdo rje drag po lus ngag yid/ /gsang ba 'dus sogs las gsungs so/ /rdo rje snying po chos kyi tshul/ /sgyu 'phrul mā yā e dang waṃ//rdo rje liṅga gsus po che/ /rgyas shing shin tu rgyas pa'o/ /rdo rje las skyes rdor bum nang —/ /dzā lan+dha ra dbu rgyan par/ /bde bas gang la rdo rje'i bdag /rdo rje snying pos sku gsung thugs/ /mkha' 'dra ⑦gsang gnas las skyes bde/ /mi g.yo 8—292

srog rtsol gnas pa la/ /ral pa gcig pa ro gcig grol/ /bsgyings pa de 'dra gang yod pa'o/ /glang chen bde ba ko rlon ni/ /lus kun khyab cing mnyes par byas—/ /de ldan pas na gos su gyon/ /grags chen bde bas gang ba la/ /ha ha zhes sgrogs dpa' bo'i gad/ /hi hi zhes sgogs dpa' mo'i gad/ /'jigs par byed pa mngon bde stsong / /gad mo chen po bde chen thig /gad rgyangs can ni ltung ba'i sgra/ /ha brgyad brjod pa rdo rje'i gad/ /cher sgrogs pa ni rgyun chad med / /rdo rje sems dpa' byang chub sems/ /sems dpa' chen po dbyer med bde—/ /rdo rje bo 1/la rgyal po ni/ /de yi nang nas ②bde ba che/ /rdo rje drag po stong pa nyid/ /rtag tu de ldan dga' ba che/ /rdo rje hūṃ ste hūṃ zhes sgogs/ /zhes pa hūṃ bzhis gnas bzhir ni/ /dga' bzhi nyams su myong ba'o/ /rdo rje a wa dhū tī la/ /mda' thogs pa ni mtshon cha can/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi rlung 'gags pa/ /mtshon chen de yis rnam rtog gcod/ /rdo rje gnyis med ye shes kyi / /ral gris nyon mongs ma lus gcod/ /rdo rje rlung rnams kun 'chang ba /sna yi rtse mor yungs 'bru bsgom/ /de nyid nor bu rdo rje can/ /de yang dus kyi 'khor lo las/ /sna rtser yungs kar zhes brjod pa/ /de yang srog dang rtsol bar brjod/ /khams gsum pa ni ma lus la/ /srid gsum gzugs brnyan mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rdo rje gcig pu las rgya la/ /de bsten ④bde bas g.yul sel ba'o/ /rdo rje 'bar ba tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ /mig mi bzang phyani ri dwags mig /spyi bor rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /zhes pa yar rtse mar rtse 'bar/ /rdo rje 'bebs pa bcu drug la/ /de yi ⑫phyed phyed 'bebs pa che/ /khams gsum phyag rgya chen por dbang / /mig brgya pa ste ④mang la bya/ /rdo rje'i ⑤mig ni sha yi srun//8—293

de yis nyugazugs brnyan mthong ba'o/ /lus ni rdo rje'i ⑪ba spu can/ /zhes pa ba spu bye byed bzhi/ /nang du thig le'i kha 'bu'o/ /de nyid rdo rje'i sru yin te/ /gcig pu lus ni rgyun chad med/ /sen mo dkar dmar 'dres pa las/ /skyes pa bde stong rdo rje'i rtse/ /mi 'dzag rtag tu dga' ba'i yid/ /rdo rje snying po rnam rtog med/ /pags pa mkhregs ni skyon mi tshugs/ /rdo rje phreng 'dzin yul rtsa bzhir/ /thim dang longs spyod 'jug pa gsum/ /nyin mtshan dus 'das dpal dang ldan/ /de 'dra'i byed gsum rdo rje rgyan/ /rnal 'byor lus la brgyan pa ste/ /kun la bde ba'i gad rgyangs ni/ /dga' chen ha ha nges par sgrogs/ /yi ge drug pa 'khor lo drug /rdo rje'i sgra ni ak+ṣa ra'o1/ /'gyur ba med pa'i yi ge'o/ /'jam dbyangs thig le chen po la/ /de ni mi 'phro ④sgra che ba/ /'jig rten gsum na sgra gcig pa/ /zhes pa zag pa dgra gcig pu/ /de 'dul thabs chen stong gsum gyi/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas sgra sgogs pa'o/ /sgra dang ldan pa jeg chen chos / /sna tshogs thabs lam bstan pa las/ /rnams kyi mchog gyur 'di nyid do / /snying ga'i phyi yi rtsa bdun dang / /'og gi rtsa bzhi dri chen dang/ /dri chu khrag dang khu ba 'bab/ /bcu gcig dag pa sh+lau ka /bcu dang tshig rkang gcig dag phya pa'o—/ /rdo rje rigs kyi rgya cher 'grel pa ste le'u bdun pa'o// //le'u brgyad pa 'od dpag med/ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi le'u la/ /tshigs brgyad 'ubazhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes bstan/ /de bzhin nyid ni dhū t+t+waṃ'o/ /yang dag bdag med g.yas g.yon rlung / /yang dag mtha' ste rlung grub pa/ /yi ge med ni rnam rtog med/ /stong gnyis ④mi 'dzag gang ba'i 8—294

sems/ /smra ba ā li kā li la/ /khyu mchog bdud rnams 'joms pa ste/ /zab cing stong nyid rgya chen snang / /dbyer med dbyer med sgra sgrogs pa/ /chos kyi dung ste chos 'byung na/ /rtsa ni bde skyed gyedung can ma/ /bde ba dpag med sgra chen ldan/ /chos kyi gaṇ+ḍi mgrin par gnas/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos stong po/ /sgra bo che ni gsung rdo rje/ /mi gnas phyag rgya chen po la/ /mya ngan 'das pa chos sku'o / /phyogs bcu yul dang yul can te/ /chos kyi rnga chen rtsa rlung phub/ /gzugs med chos sku stong pa nyid/ /gzugs bzang longs sku bde ba che/ /dam pa ste ni rdo rje'i sku/ /sna tshogs gzugs can sprul sku'o/ /yid ni bde chen spros bral las/ /skyes pa sku lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /gzugs rnams rgyud lnga'i 'khor ba la / /thams cad rten dang brten bcas lakye/ /brten nas sku bzhi'i snang ba'i dpal/ /gzugs brnyan nyin mtshan rtags rngubacu bzhi/ /ma lus 'chang ba thob ④pa'o/ /mtshungs pa med ni 'dod yon lngas/ /mi gnod 'phel zhing cher grags pa/ /khams gsum dbang phyug chen po ste/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs mthar phyin/ /lam dang 'bras bu gnyis yin no/ /'phags pa nyams pa med pa'o / /lam ni 'khor lo drug yin no/ /shin tu mtho ba gtsug tor la/ /thig le mi nyams gnas pa'o/ /chos kyi rtog ni rdo rje rtser/ /rgyas pa po ni bde bas gang —/ /'jig rten gsum ni lus ngag yid/ /gzhon lus gcig ni gsum pa'i dus / /gnas brtan sprul pa'i 'khor lo la/ /rgan po lhan skyes ye shes so/ /skye dgu'i bdag ni bug dgu bsdams/ /de yang sgyu ma chen mo pyelas/ /mig gnyis dang ni rna ba gnyis/ /de bzhin sna dang kha dag dang / /yid kyi khyesnying po dgag pa ni/ /seng ge rnam grol phyag rgya che/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bcing bar bya//8—295

zhes gsungs so/ /de las skyes pa'i bde ba'o/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba—/ /zhes pa 'phel 'grib bcu drug go/ /sdu gu gtum mo'i na chung la/ /'khor gsum 'jig rten gsum na mdzes/ /'jig rten mig la sogs pa la/ /shes legs skyon gyis ma gos par/ /ston pa slob dpon zhes brjod do/ /'jig rten 'byung ba lnga ldan k+ṣa/ /slob dpon bzhi ba ster ba ste/ /de la 'jigs pa med pa mchog /gnyis med spyor ba mgon skyob pa1/ /'jig rten yid gcugs 3 don dam dang / /kun rdzob phan tshun mi 'gal ba'o/ /skyabs kha dang 'bab pa skyob pa ni/ /bzlog pas ye shes bla na med/ /nam mkha'i ④mtha' ni shes rab la/ /longs spyod pa ni gnyis med spyor/ /thams cad mkhyen pa sbyor drug gis/ /rtags ma lus pa thob pa las/ /ye shes mtsho ni zad mi shes/ /yon tan chen pos gang ba'o/ /ma rig rten 'byel bcu gnyis la/ /sgo nga'i sbubs ni mi shes gtums⑤/ /'byed pa gsum pa'i ye shes so/ /yang na lus la sangs rgyas ni/ /yod pa ma rtogs sgo nga'i sbubs/ /'byed pa bla mas ye shes spyorahūṃ/ /'di de lam mchog yin par gsungs/ /srid pa'i dra ba mi shes bsgribs/ /'joms pa po ni rtogs pa'o/ /nyon mongs rtsa ba nye nyon mongs/ /ma lus bzhi byed dga' ba bzhi/ /dbang bzhi las rnyed ye shes bzhi'o/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rgya ste/ /pha rol phyin pa ye shes rgya/ /rgya gram gnyis med bde chen po/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur gang rnyed pa/ /de ni ye shes dbang bskur te/ /cod pan can ni gtsug tor smin/ /sdogs pa rdo rje nor bu rtse/ /sangs rgyas bde chen nyams pa med/ /rgyan du thogs ni bde chen du/ /ye shes lnga ldan dbu rgyan no/ /gsung ni lus ngag yid gsum la/ /sdug bsngal srog rtsol 'tshed 8—296

bsregs ①myags/ /sdug bsngal zhi ni rtog larlung 'gags/ /gsum sel dug gsum sel ba'o/ /mtha' yas lhan cig skyes dga' ba/ /grol gsum thob ni sku gsum mo/ /sgrib pa sa chu me rlung mkha'/ /rags phra rab phra don spyi dang / /sems dpa' dang ni bcu pa'o1/ /kun las nges par grol ba ni/ /du ba la sogs bcu thob pa'o/ /de dus tsam na nam mkha' ltar/ /lhan skyes mnyam pa nyid la gnas/ /nyon mongs dri ma gong gi bcu/ /kun las 'das pa mthar pyaphyin pa'o/ /de yi dus na lhan skyes dor/ /dus gsum dus med rtogs pa'o/ /de nyid phyag rgya chen por 'dod/ /sems can kun gyi ldu spang bya la/ /klu chen po ni gnyen po ste/ /dga' bzhi reg dug la sogs pa/ /'dod sogs pham byas klu chen po⑪/ /yon tan theg pa chen po la/ /thod can rnams ni gsang sngags te/ /thod ces de thod 'di yin no/ /nyon mongs kun las zhes pa ni/ /spong dang thar pa 'dod pa'o/ /rnam par grol ni bde chen rtogs/ /rtsol ba med par ngang gis grol/ /shing thags ⑦bsregs pa'i thal phung bzhin/ /mkha' ltar mtha' med bder gnas pa/ /de nyid yid bzhin nor bu che/ /mi 'bral bden 5pa 'chang ba'o/ /rin chen zag med bde ba ste/ /kun mchog phyag rgya chen po la/ /khyab pa'i bdag ni brtan g.yo la'o/ /dpag bsam shing chen dhū tī la/ /rgyas pa rtsa rnams kun du ni/ /rlung dang thig les khyab pa'o/ /bum pa bzang po nor bu la / /che ba'i mchog ni mi 'dzag bde/ /de yi byed pa ci zhe na/ /sems can gdul bya la dgongs nas/ /kun don byed pa bde 'phel ba'o/ /phan 'dogs yon tan brgyad thob pas/ /sems can phan pas lgenyes gshin t+yapa/ /bzang ngan shes shing dus shes la/ /zhes pa phyi rol de bzhin nang / /phyi rol rten 8—297

'byel bcu gnyis kyis/ /skye dang las dang phyogs ngan 7dang / /g.yo dang rkun po don rnams dang / /ltas dang tshe tshad nad rnams dang/ /kun kyi bya ba shes par 'gyur/ /nang du g.yas g.yon dkyil 'khor lnga / /phyi nang don rnams grub ṭa/pa'o/ /gzhan yang chu srin bum pa nya/ /lug dang khyu mchog me thu na/ /karka seng ge bu mo srang / /sdig pa gzhu 'dzin bcu gnyis kyis/ /nyi ma zla ba shes pa'o—/ /de yi 1rang 'byung la sogs shing ④/ /dam shes lus ngag ye shes shes/ /dam ldan shes rab ma la ni/ /brtse dang shugs dang drud pa dang / /mi 'dzag bde ba dam tshig bzhis⑤/ /lus sems kun du khyab pa'i bdag /bdud rtsi 'byung ba las gsungs pa/ /mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar rgyug pa'i/ /rab tu rgyug cing 'pho khyeba'i sems/ /rnam rtog yul la 'dzag pa'i sems/ /bde bar gzung bar the tshom med/ /ces gsungs so/ /sems can dbang shes rab 'bring bzhis(—/ /dus shes de la dbang bzhi ster/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pas shes / /rnam grol gsum dam las ye shes/ /mkhas pa po ni sa 'og sogs/ /dbang thob nas ni yon tan kyis/ /snying stobs rdul dang mun pa rnams/ /ldan zhing de la ye shes ldan/ /yon tan ye shes de la brjod/ /chos shes bkra shis 'jig rten bde/ /rab bkra shis ni 'jig rten 'das/ /bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ /dga' ba rnam pa bcu drug po/ /nyams su myong phyabs grags pa yisaspu//bkra shis snyan grags dge ba thob/ /chags sogs ma spangs sbyidabugs 'byin che/ /tshim par byed pa dga' ston che/ /dga' chen lhan skyes rol pa ni/ /mig 'phrul lta bu'i snang ba la/ /chen po don dam phyag rgya che/ /bkur ste lus las rtsol ba byed—/ /rim gro rlung las legs spyor ba/ /phun sum tshogs pa yon tan thob/ /8—298

mchog tu dga' ba 'jig rten las①/ /grags bdag dpal ni lhan cig skyes/ /mchog ldan lhan skyes yod pa las/ /mchog sbyin bzhi pa'i gtso bo ste/ /de nyid skyabs kyi dam pa dang / /gnyen por che bas skyabs su 'os/ /'jig rten dgra ni dug gsum ste/ /rab kyi mchog ni bde stong ngo / /de yis pya/'jigs pa ma lus pa/ /shin tu med pas sel ba'o/ /gtsug phud 'khor ba'i bde ba la/ /phud bu dbang gis rab tu bcings/ /lcang lo can ni gzhan don du/ /mdzes shing rgyas par 'gengs pa'o/ /ral pa gnyis su med par sdom/ /len tshar cod pan thogs ldan pa'o/ /gdong lnga ye shes lnga yin te/ /gtsug phud lnga dang ldan pa ni/ /rigs lnga dag dang ldan pa'o/ /gnas skabs lnga po me tog thogs/ /zhes pa gnas skabs lnga po ni/ /ma log log dang rmi lam dang / /rmi lam che dang sad pa'o/ /me tog thogs pa rdzas 'dzin pa'o/ /mgo zlum kha khra shā mu kha la/ /brtul zhugs rnyed dang ma rnyed pa/ /bde ba chen po 'dzin pa ni/ /tshangs par spyod pa mi nyams pa/ /brtul zhugs mchog kyang de nyid do/ /dka' thub nyan thos mthar thug pa/ /pha rol phyin pa dka' thub che/ /rdo rje'i theg pa nyid yin te—/ /de nyid gsal ④ba'i rgyud las su/ /kha chu tsam zhig zags pa na/ /mkha' 'gro ma mos rnal 'byor pa/ /bsgral te khrag ni 'thung bar byed/ /dmyal ba zhes pa'ang de las 'gyuratsa// /zhes so/ /gtsang gnas dam pa skyon med pa/ /go ñtsa ta ma rigs ma nyams/ /bram ze tshangs pa rig byed yin/ /snyan dngags srid srung ⑦nges brjod dang / /mchod sbyin bzhi po tshangs pas shes/ /mya ngan 'das ni don dam pa/ /tshangs pa bral ba thob pa'o/ /grol ba stong pa thar pa ni/ /bde chen spros bral rnam grol lus/ /rnam grol phyag rgya chen po la/ /zhi ba zhi ba 8—299

dga' bzhi nyid/ /de yang he yi rdo rje las/ /ji ltar me yis tshig pa la/ /me de nyid kyis bdugs stite 'tsho/ /'dod chags me yis tshig pa la/ /'dod chags nyid kyis rnam grol byed/ /ces so/ /mya ngan 'das pa chos kyi sku/ /mya ngan 'grel ni gzugs kyi sku/ /rnam par bshad pas de legs par/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob par nye/ /de ni mtha' bral ye shes so/ /de yin pa yi rgyu mtshan yang / /bde sdug sel ba mthar gyur pa/ /zhes pa bde ba dga' mchog dga'/ /sdug pa dga' bral dgos pa ste/ /mthar gyur lhan skyes ye shes so/ /mi 'dzag dga' ba chags bral la/ /yul yul kun las 'das pa'o/ /thub pa med pa spang bya la/ / rgyas par rjubyas pa dpe med pa/ /mi mngon dga' ba 'go bar min/ /mi snang mchog dga' chags par min/ /gsal byed min ni dga' bral la/ /mi 'gyur lhan cig skyes pa ste/ /kun 'gro khyab pa po de nyid/ /phra zhing dhū tī zag med nyams/ /sa bon rtog pa'i dri ma bral/ /rdul med chags pa'i rdul med cing / /rdul bral dngos po'i zhen pa spangs/ /dri ma med pa zhi kyeba'i dus/ /nyes pa spangs par pyarang bzhin rig /skyon med pa ni ma bsgribs pa'o/ /shin tu sad pa dbang dus su/ /go rtog ⑤ skyes pa de yin la/ /legs par sad ni de nyid dang / /ma bral rtag tu ldan pa'o/ /kun shes gzugs sogs thams cad la/ /lhan skyes shes pa kun rig pa/ /dam pa po ni mchog mi 'gyur/ /rnam par shes pa kun gzhir bye gnas/ /de yang mdo las 'di skad du/ /thog ma med pa dus kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de yod pas na 'gro kun dang / /mya ngan 'das pa 'byung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bdun po 'gags pa 'od gsal te/ /'od gsal rtog med chos nyid 'das/ /'das pa gnyis med ye 8—300

shes de/ /tshig gi yul min smra brjod bral/ /de yang he yi rdo rje las/ /ngag gi lam 'das spyod yul bral/ /bla ma'i dus thabs ① bsten pas shes/ /tshul 'chang ba ni bla ma yi⑧/ /dus thabs 1bsten pas lhun grub tu/ /rnam par rtog med ye shes ni/ /gsum pa'i dus su nyams su stsong / /'jig rten kun las 'das pa'oske/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rtog ④pa'ang de/ /las byed pa ni de 'dra bas/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka smin pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med/ /ces pa de ni rtog ④pa'i don/ /sangs rgyas rang gi ngo gang la/ /thog ma mkha' 'dra skye ba med / /mkha' dang 'dra bas bar du yang / /gnas dus nyid nas mkha' dang 'dra / /dper na gzugs brnyan snang ba bzhin/ /rgyu lam 'bras bu rnam dag pas—/ /re dogs kun dang bral ba'o/ /de ltar yin pa'i 'thad pa yang /dang po sangs rgyas rgyu med pa/ /zhes pa dus gsum dag pa'o/ /de thabs gang las skyes she na/ /ye shes lhan cig skyes pa la/ /mig gcig dhū tī ⑥ nang yin te//dri med de ru rlung sems zhugs/ /ye shes lus can bde stong gang / /de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhin nyid/ /ma bsten rang lam byon gshegs byed/ /tshig gi dbang phyug rlung gnas pa/ /smra ba che ni gsung rdo rje/ /smra ba'i rlung la dbang phyug thig /smra ba'i rgyal po rtsar son pa/ /smra ba'i dam pa gsung rdo rje/ /mchog gi gsung ni gsung dag pa'o/ /rlung grub smra ba'i seng ge nyid/ /nyon mongs rnam dag mtshungs pa med/ /kun du lta ba spang blang med/ /mchog tu dga' ba ye shes snang / /gzi brjid gsum mo ye shes la/ /phreng ba rgyud 'byel goms pa la⑦/ /blta na sdug ni yon tan thob/ /'od bzang 'bar ba sa bon te—/ /dpal kyi be+e'u bkra shis mtshan/ /dga' ba 'khyil pa 'dzin pa ni/ /lag 8—301

pas nyams su blangs pa las/ /'od 'bar snang ba bde ba po①/ /dug chenapo ni dngos po'i gnod/ /'dod chags la sogs gcod chen po/ /gtso mchog gi ④ni stong pa nyid/ /zug rngu rtog bcas rlung gnyis po/ /'byin pa rlung bsgom bla na med / /sman rnams ma lus gnyen po'i tshogs/ /ljon pa'i shing ni dhū t+t+waṃ rgyas/ /nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong la/ /nad ni thog med des mnar ba'o/ /des na de nyid dgrar che ba'o/ /'jig rten gsum ni sgo gsum ste/ /thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa ni/ /yungs kar sbom po'i tshad tsam pa/ /mdzes ni 'bar ba bsgom pa'o/ /dpal ldan bde chen khams yin te/ /rgyu skar dkyil 'khor can zhes pa/ /rgyu ba rtsa la skar ma thig /lus kyi khams rnams bskor ba'o/ /de yang rtsa thig du zhe na/ /gtsug tor bzhi pa dpral bcu drug /nyi shu bad kan mgrin so gnyis/ /snying gar brgyad de bzhi bcu'o/ /mkhris pa lte ba drug cu bzhi / /gsang ba bcu drug brgyad cu po/ /rlung khams cha mnyam nor bu'i bar/ /bcu drug rigs snyedrug nyi shu gnyis/ /rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'o/ /rtsa re'i nang na rlung bcu ste/ /rlung la brten pas thig le re/ /de ltar rtsa rlung thig le la/ /rkang grangs snyesum stong sum brgya dang / /drug cu tham pa yin par 'dod/ /de nyid dpa' bo dpa' mo ni/ /sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag /phyogs bcu lus kyi nying lag la/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug rlung lnga'i bar/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan ye shes khams/ /mi 'dzag bde ba legs par 'dzug⑤ /dhū tī rgyas pa mchog yin no/ /'gro la rtsa rlung byang chub sems/ /gdugs bzhin bde chen 'khor lo la/ /yangs pa mi zad ⑥mdzod yin te/ /bde ba skyob phyir gdugs zhes brjod/ /de yang sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /e waṃ las ni 'byung ba 8—302

dang —/ /thabs mang myur dang bde skyob 1dang / /'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyun ②du 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /byams pa dang ni snying rje 'di / /bde chen dkyil 'khor can bdag nyid/ /dpal ldan rdo rje pad+ma ni/ /kasko la zhes rab tu grags/ /gar gyi bdag ni sbyor thabs kyis//yan lag drug cu rtsa gnyis te/ /de yang gzhan gyi gzhung lugs yin/ /khyab bdag chen po thig le la/ /rin chen gdugs ni nor bu'i rtser/ /nyon mongs thams cad bsil ba'o/ /gtum mo che las skyes pa yi/ /ye shes de la rab tu 'jug /de nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ /mchog tu gyur pas rgyal po la④/ /lam des sangs rgyas kun gyi sku/ /'bras bur 'chang ba 'di nyid do/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi lam 'bras la/ /sbyor bar byed pas rnal 'byor che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bstan pa ni/ /bslab gsum yin la de 'di la/ /ldan pas lhan skyes bstan pa gcig /'di ni dang po'i dbang bskur te/ /rdo rje mtha' yas 'du shes dag /rin chen nyi ma tshor ba dag /dbang bskur dpal ni don yod grub//'du byed rnam dag kun bdag ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzugs phung dag /dbang phyug ste ni mi bskyod pa/ /rnam shes phung po rnam dag pa'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang / /rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kun kyi bdag /de ltar sgrub cepa'i dbang phyug ⑥thob/ /rdo rje 'chang ba rgyud gsum gyi/ /mchog gam kun gyi rje bo'o / /de yang gnas rdzas dag dbang dang / /yon tan sgrub pa rnams sbyar ro/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu che ba/ /zhes pa snod du gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje'i ming ni dbang bskur bas/ /skye ba 'dir ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces pa 'di yi don bshad na/ /bum pas bskyed rim ④ legs gnas khyod/ /khyod ni 'gro drug gang 8—303

ma yin/ /de ni kun brtags yin zhe na/ /'di yang kun brtags des na lha/ /bla ma'i drin las rnyed pa yi/ /ci phyir rin chen ces spras min/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs la gnas/ /rjes su 'dzin cing skyong ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba/ /dbang dang rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs/ /lus kyi phrin 1las slob dpon che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung yang yin/ /zhes pas gsang ba'i dbang yin te/ /bla ma yab yum gnyis med las/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor mngon sprul la/ /rdo rje nyi ma mtha' yas la/ /de yi bde ba snang ba che/ /rdo rje zla ba mi bskyod pa/ /ye shes 'phro 'du dri med 'od/ /bu yi lce la sbyin par bya/ /chags bral la sogs chags pa che/ /zhes pa gsum pa'i dbang yin te/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin rnams la/ /chags bral bla mas mtshon par bya/ /de ltar min na bla ma nyams/ /slob ma shin tu 'dod na yang / /so sor thar pa spang bar bya/ /lam 'di lam mchog thub chen gsungs/ /gang zag rnams la dge slong mchog /longs spyod gnas bsdams nam mkha' mthong / /kha dog gnyis med lhan cig skyes / /chags pa che ni bu de la/ /de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud chen las/ /rigs ldan lo ni bcu drug ma/ /lang tsho sogs kyis brgyan pa la/ /dang po legs par bslab bya ste/ /dpral ⑤ba la sogs gnas lnga ⑤dgod/ /sangs rgyas skur ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /de yi cho ga yang gsungs pa/ /dang po gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de nas babe+eb pa'i gnas bcu sbyin/ /de nas bye brag mdo sde bstan/ /de nas dbu ma'i tshul lugs sbyin/ /de rjes dus kyi 'khor lo sbyin//zhes gsungs pas/ ka ra na yi bstan bcos kyis/ /rnal 'byor ma yang rnam pa lnga/ /bzang mo cod pan dung can dang / /ri mo can dang glang po can/ /gla rtsi pad rtsa chu 8—304

dri dang / /nya dang rnag gi dri yis ①mtshon/ /phag mo sgrol ma gos dkar mo/ /mā ma tī ④spyan ma yi rigs/ /lus ran rked phra rkang lag 'jam/ /lhung phyed rtse ldan phag mo yi/ /cung zad lus phra ring zhing mig /mi g.yo skra 'khyil khyapad can sgol—/ /'dod chen ngo tsha med rtsol thudaga'/ /thung ba dung can gos dkar mo/ /ring zhing lus rgyas skra srab dang / /so mtho thig le lta bur snang / /ri mo can te mā ma khri/ /spom thung lus mkhrang shin tu sra/ /smra brtson sbyan ma glang po ma/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor pha yang lnga/ /seng ge ri dwags rta glang po/ /mi bskyod don grub rin 'byung dang / /'od dpag med dang snang mdzad do/ /dri ni sngon dang 'dra ba la/ /dbe+en gnas 'jigs med yul dang bral/ /gtong a+yodang sdom brtson mi bskyod rigs/ /myur du 'gro zhing myur du 'dzag /skrag cing 'jigs pa don grub bo/ /'dod chen gtong phod gzhan don brtson/ /gzhan dbang 'gyur ba nyi ma'i rigs/ /dal bus spyo'agro zhing mig mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin bems po yi yon tan/ /nya dri 'od dpag med pa'i rigs/ /shin tu rmongs bzang smra ba nyung / /rnag dri rnam par snang mdzad rigs/ /dri med 'od las de skad gsungs/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /shes rab de las byung ba dang / /rdo rje skyil krung bcas nas ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sku bskyed la/ /sangs rgyas yang dag brjod chos ni/ /bum pa'i sbyor ba yan lag lnga/ /'dus byas bsod nams tshogs kun gyispyo/ /rdo rje 'chang gi khru'agran med gsungs/ /'dzin pa dbu ma me tog ⑨ldan/ /dpal ldan ye shes chen po ste/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma las skyes pa'o/ /bzhi pa'i dbang bskur byas pa yis/ /kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod 'dzin pa/ /phyag rgya chen po de rnyed pas/ /rjes la ⑩rtog pa'i snang ba ni/ /8—305

rgyal po sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs 'chang / /zhes pas ①rdo rje gcod pa las/ /skar ma rab rib mar me dang / /sgyu ma zil pa chu bur dang / /rmi lam glog dang sprin dang ni / /sgra brnyan mgal me gzugs brnyan dang / /'dus byas de ltar rtogs par bya / /rtogs pa 'phags pa'i gang zag go/ /zhes gsungs so/ /che ba bzhi pa'i ye shes la/ /gsum 'phags sangs rgyas rig sngags rgyal/ /rdo rje rnon po bzhi pa de / /ral gri che de rtog kun gcod3/ /yi ge mchog ste a zhuyin la/ /rnam par dag pa 'gyur ba med/ /dbang bzhi de yi yon tan ni/ /theg pa chen po sdug bsngal gcod/ /de yang mi spong brten pas gcod/ /mtshon cha chen po de nyid la/ /rdo rje chos zhes grags pa yin/ /rdo rje zab mo skye med la/ /rgyal ba de rtogs 'jig rten 'das/ /las rgyal dgra bcom zil mnan pa'o/ /don ni dbang bzhi'i don rnams la/ /rigs ④ni de nyid lam mchog rtogs/ /de nyid rdo rje blo gos la/ yon tan 'di rnams bshad bzhin thob/ /pha rol phyin pa kun ni bcu/ /rdzogs pa dbang bzhi la ldan pa/ /sa rnams kun ni sa bcu la/ /rgyan rnams 3ldan ni dbang re zhing / /dang pos dbang skye7 po gnyis pas bzhi/ /gsum pas bzhi dang bzhi pas gcig /de yang gsang ba mdzod las gsungs/ /rab tu dga' ba chu yi dbang / /gsang ba dri med 'od 'phro byed/ /shes rab ye shes sbyang dka' ste/ /mngon gyur mi g.yo ring song ba/ /phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bskur bas/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi dbyingasasku / /zhes gsungs so/ /rnam par dag pa'i lam de yis/ /bdag med chos nyid rdo rje 'chang / /yang dag ye shes bde chen po/ /zla 'od bzang po haṃ las thob/ /brtson chen bum pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba rtsa rlung khyab/ /rgyud kun gyi ni rtsa rlung nyid/ /bdag 8—306

po thig le mchog bde stong / /rdo rje gdan ni lte ba la/ /ma lus ldan ni rigs drug dang / /'phro stib chu tshod dbyu gu dang / /dkyil 'khor lnga lngar buldan pa'o/ /lta stangs yon tan rlung grub dus/ /ye shes sku ni mtshan ma la/ /rnams ni dug ①sogs bco lnga la/ /ma lus 'chang ni re khā mthong / /blo gros bzang po rtog dpyod pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes can/ /kun du bzang po mnyam pa nyid / /phyag rgya chen po lhun gyis grub/ /sa ni sa sogs 'byung lnga yi/ /snying po ye shes rlung grub pa'o/ /'gro ba 'dzin ni 'gyur ba 'gags/ /sangs rgyas kun ni gshegs pa'i lam/ /snying po chen po dhū tīr zhugs/ /dus sbyor la sogs bcu gnyis ni/ /rim gyis rim gyis rnam dag pas/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo rgya chol sogs/ /yon tan sna tshogs 'chang ba'o/ /rgyas par dri ma med par blta/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /mi 'gyur 'od gsal chos kyi dbyings/ /dngos po kun gyi snirang bzhin ni/ /skye med rtogs pa'i lta ba 'dzin/ /skye med chos te don dam pa/ /sna tshogs don ni kun rdzob la/ /chos kun jeg pa sna tshogs la/ /ngo bo nyid ni mthar thug pa/ /'chang ni bde stong dran pas skyong / /shes rab chen po stong pa nyid/ /skad cig tshe gcig 'jam dpal mthong chos dang 'khor dang mya ngan 'das/ /khong du chud pa ro gcig 'chang / /chos kun khams gsum rtog 'upa gsum/ /rdul mun snying stobs bde chen du/ /mngon par rtogs pa mchog yin te/ /thub pa mi 'dzag blo mchog ni/ /rnam grol bde stong 'byung po sel/ /mi g.yo rlung la de yis ni/ /rab tu dang ba'i bdag nyid can//thig le bde bas brgyan pa la/ /spro dga' gnas pa sdogs sangs rgyas/ /de lta'i rang bzhin byang chub 'chang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes de/ /rnal 'byor pa 8—307

yi mngon sum pa/ /gnyen po ye shes me lce can/ /dhū tīr 'od 'bar gsal bas thob/ /gnas pa lus la 'khor lo drug /'byung ba phung po rnam pa lnga/ /yon tan drug dang mtha' drug dang / /las kyi dbang phyug byed ①dbang drug /zhi gnas lhag mthong rnam pa gnyis/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dag pa yis/ /tshigs bcad bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dag /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rgya cher 'grel pa ste le'u brgyad pa'o// //dgu pa rin chen 'byung ldan ni/ /mnyam nyid ye shes le'u ston/ /'dod pa mchog gi ye shes la/ /don grub de ni bde bas thob/ /dam pa ste ni rtsol ba med / /ngan song dgu ni dug gsum la/ /thams cad nyon mongs brgyad khri stong / /rnam par spyong ba ma rig pa/ /lhan skyes ye shes chen po rtogs/ /mgon po rdo rje theg pa 'di/ /sems can kun gyi lam mchog go/ /sems can thams cad ma lus pa/ /phyag rgya chen por rab sgrol byed/ /'khrul pa'i snang ba nyon mongs g.yul/ /stong nyid gcig pus 'joms pas dpa'/ /mi shes bden 'dzin 'du byed rnams/ /de nyid dgra ste dregs pa 'joms 'joms pas dpal ldan nyid yin la/ /blo ldan chos ldan chos de yis/ /sgeg pa 'chang ba ye shes ldan/ /brtan po gtsug tor thig le brtan thu/ /mi sdug stong pa shes rab la—/ /gzugs 'chang ba ni bde stong ldan/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon rlung gnyis so / /brgya phrag kun ni nyi khye dang / /chig stong drug brgya'i grangs yin la/ /bskyod cing zhes pa rnam shes rta/ /'phags pa klu sgrub zhal snga nas/ /sems can kun gyi srog gyur pa/ /rlung zhes bya ba las kun byed/ /lnga yi bdag nyid bcu 8—308

ming can/ /'di ni shes rab zhon ① pa'o/ /rtsa lam dhū tīr 'jug pa ste/ /goms pa'i stabs ④kyis gar byed cing / /zhes pa sa ma he du 1sogs/ /skar ma drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /dpal ldan dhū tīr ④lag pa gnyis/ /brgyas gang la ni rlung rtsa ganga'u// /nam mkha' stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ /khyab par stong pa rlung dang ni / /thig les brgyan pa gar byed pa'o/ /ya bo gcig gi khyen gyis ni/ /zhes pa ya bo ster ⑪rlung ste/ /khyen ni thams cad rdzogs par blang / /sa yi dkyil 'khor chos 'khor lo/ /mthil du gnon ni snying dbus ni/ /chu shing me tog lta bu yi/ /dpyid kyi thig ler thim pa'o/ /ming gzugs glang po can zhes grags/ /tshangs pa yi ni sgo nga'i rtse/ /zhes pa tshangs sgo rtsa 'bras gnyis/ /rtse mo 'og rlung 'then ④pa ste/ /khyen ni lus la rkang mtheb kyi/ /sen mo mnan pas gtum mo 'bar/ /dpyid kyi thig le 'byung ba bzhin/ /kha ba ba mo lta bur 'dzag /de yi 'phel grib dkar nag phyogs/ /rim gyis bin+d+ra blu/'phel ba yin/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nga gtsug tor rgyal/ /rtse nas rim gyis 'grib pa las/ /nag po g.yon pa'i ma rol 'bab/ /don gcig mi 'gyur byang chub sems/ /gnyis med gzung 'dzin skye mched drug /chos kyi don zhes gsungs pa ni/ /chos kyi yul dang yul can la/ /mig la sa snying gzugs rdo rje/ /rna ba phyag rdor sgra rdo rje/ /sna la 'jam dbyangs dri rdo rje/ /lce la spyan gzigs ro rdo rje/ /lus la sgrib sel reg rdo rje/ /yid la rdor sems chos rdo rje/ /dbang yul bden par grub pa med/ /dper na lha sbyin gcig nyid la/ /chags sdang gti mug gsum skye ba/ /chung ma dgra dang phal pas phye/ /des na yul kyis gnod pa med/ /don ni bde chen spros bral lo/ /de nyid dam pa'i don yin te/ /'jigs pa med pa phyag rgya che/ /8—309

rnam rig kun brtags log shes pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni gzhan gyi dbang / /rgyu rkyen dngos po'i snang ba'o/ /don can dmigs med yongs su grub/ /sems ni gsum po rang sems te/ /rang gi ngo bo rnam shes ni/ /'od gsal rgyud dang ldan pa'o/ /dngos ni yul te dga' ba las/ /don ni yul can mchog dga' nyid / /ma lus yul dang yul can rnams/ /dga' ba gsum 'dus bcad thob pa / /reg pa lhan skyes ye shes so/ /stong pa nyid dga' dga' bral ba /mchog gi ye shes dbu ma'i lam/ /yid la mi byed 'dod chags blo/ /'o na dngos por 'gyur zhe na/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags sogs pa yi/ /dngos 'dzin byed pa spangs pa'o/ /srid gsum lus ngag yid gsum la/ /dga' ba chen po ye shes khyab/ /sprin dkar dag pa rdo rje sems/ /dkar po tshor ṭ+wābade gnyis su med / /'od bzang bubag chags spong gnyen po/ /ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od 'dra ba'i / /thig le bde chen mkha' la gnas/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes/ /gtum mo ye shes me 'bar ba/ /de bzhin gshegs dang yum rnams bsregs/ /sen mo'i 'od ltar 'dres pa yi/ /byang sems mer 'dres shas cher dmar/ /cod pan bzang po mthon ka'i rtse/ /gtsug tor gnas pa stod 1par byed / /skra mchog mthon ka haṃ las ni/ /chen po can ni bin+d+ra gnas/ /nor bu chen po bum par zhugs/ /'od chags dpal ni bde mi rtog /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /ces pa'i don ni 'di yin te/ /'di ni rang byung ④bcom ldan 'das/ /de yang rgyud las gsungs pa ni/ /mngal gyi khru ma chos gos te/ /spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba phyag /gcer bu skra dang kha sru byegs/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa a dang haṃ/ /zla ba bcu gnyis khrims kyi gnas/ /pha dang ma ni mkhan slob 8—310

nyid—/ /rang byung ①skyes pas dge slong nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa' 'dus ma byas//sred pa'i chags pa rnam par dag /ces pa'o/ /'jig rten lus ngag yid gsum la/ /khams brgya kun spyod khyab pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa phyi nang rlung / /yongs su sgogs pa len par byed/ /stobs chen ldan ni bde chen rgyas/ /de nyid mi 'bral ldan pa ni/ /dran pa chen po 'chang ba'o/ /dran pa bzhi ni tsusbra na/ /yul bzhi rjes su dran pa ste/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang / /bltas dang bgad pas tshim pa ni/ /rim gyi 3dran bzhir dbang bzhi sbyar/ /mchog ni bltas pas tshim pa'o/ /byang chub yan lag ces pa ni/ /byang chub thig le 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /zas bad mkhris dang sha khrag dang / /rus pa klad pa bdun yan lag /me tog kun da spos gtum mo/ /de yang lan bdun bza' bar bya/ /zhes pa ༄ mi nyams za ba'o/ /de bzhin chos kun gshegs pa'am/ /yon tan mtsho ni srid pa sel/ /lam ni a wa dhū tre+e la/ /yan lag me rlung thig le'o/ /brgyad ni yas 'bab mas brtan pa'o/ /tshul rig bla ma'i ngag las so/ /yang dag rang byung rteye shes la/ /sangs rgyas lam ni zung 'jug pa/ /mthar thug lam du rig pa'o/ /des na sems can kun la ni/ /sgyu ma lta bur shas cher chags/ /chags pa 'khor ba yin zhe na/ /nam mkha' lta bur chags pa med/ /chags pa med bzhin 'gro don du/ /sems can kun gyi yid la ni/ /gang 'dul skye ba len cing 'jug /sems can kun gyi yid lta bur/ /brtson 'grus chen pos don byed mgyogs/ /sems can kun gyi dbang don ni/ /rab 'bring chen po mchog rnams shes/ /sems can kun gyi don byed tshul/ /yid 'phrog pa yi phye'ago don nus/ /phung po lnga po don dam pa/ /mya ngan 'das shing ma dmigs 8—311

pas—/ /de nyid shes ni ye shes lnga'o/ /rnam dag phung po lnga po ni/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol rnam grol ye shes mthong / /'dzin pa mi 'dzag dga' ba'i hūṃsems/ /gang yod de la phung lnga ldan/ /nges 'byung kun gyi byang chub gsum/ /mtha' la gnas ni rdo rje 'chang / /nges 'byung kun mtha' gong ma nyid/ /de la mkhas pa rdo rje theg /nges 'byung kun gyi lam la ni/ /ngo bor bde chen ye shes gnas/ /nges par 'byung ba rnam pa kun/ /bshad zhucing spyod pa ston pa'o/ /yan lag bcu gnyis ma rig sogs/ /ma bkag srid rtsa 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /de ltar yin par byams pas gsungs/ /sgrib pa'i phyir dang 'debs phyir dang / /'khrid dang 'dzin pa'i phyir dang ni/ /rdzogs byed gsum 'dus gcod phyir dang / /nye bar spyod dang sdud pa'i phyir/ /spyor ba byebyed dang mngon du byed/ /sdug bsngal phyir na 'gro nyon mongs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur ye shes nyid/ /rtogs dang myong bas srid rtsa bton/ /de nyid dag pa nyid yin la/ /rnam pa bcu gnyis 'chang zhes pa/ /rten 'byel dag pas gnas la sogs/ /bcu gnyis kun du spyod pa'o/ /bden bzhi lte snying mgrin dpral ba/ /tshul gyi rnam pa can zhes pa/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung lam 'gog rte pa / /gnas brtan phal chen mang bkur smra/ /bden pa re res lam 'bras byed / /shes pa brgyad po zhes pa ni/ /sna tshogs rnam smin rnams ⑤med dang / /lha sngags ye shes dga' bzhi brgyad/ /rtog tsapa 'chang ni de dag pa'o/ /bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ni/ /byed dbang myong ba rnam par smin/ /'bras bzhi re re che 'bring gsum/ /ldan pa rdo rje'i sku yin no/ /de nyid thig le chen po la/ /dga' ba rnam pa bcu drug rigasamu/ /rnam pa nyi shu phung lnga dang / /'byung lnga 8—312

—yab lnga yum lnga la/ /byang chub pa ni bdes khyab pa'o/ /rnam par mi 'dra ba yin la / /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang 'byung ①gi /ye shes lhan cig skyes rig mchog /sangs rgyas kun kyi sprul pa'i sku/ /skye dang las dang bzo dang mchog /de nyid dbab zlog bskyil dgram pa'o/ /bye ba dpag med rlung gis ni/ /thig le rtsa mig 'byed pa'o/ /skad cig dus mtha'i skad cig la/ /thams cad lhan skyes mngon par rtogs/ /sems kyi skad cig lhan skyes bde/ /don kun rigs phyani bzhi pa'o / theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyi/ /zhes pa theg gsum gnas pa ni/ /spyor ba dgu yi tshul gyis ni/ /'gro ba'i sems can sna tshogs pa/ /don byed ji ltar gdul don du/ /ston pa po ni chos don nges/ /theg pa gsum ni dbang gsum kyi/ /bzhi pa kho na'i nges 'byung la/ /bde chen theg gcig gis 'bras bu bye / /bla ma'i dus thabs lta bur gnas/ /nyon mongs khams rnams drug gyur pa / /dag pa'i bdag nyid shudha ste/ /gzhan dag nyon mongs spang ba'o/ /rdo rje theg pas rtog pa 'joms/ /nyon zad rtog med ma yin te/ /rtog bral ci yang gnas pa med/ /de yis ④de nyid rnyed pa yis/ /dge sdig rtog pa las kyi khams/ /bde ba chen po zad che ba'ophye/ /chu bo rnam pa lnga yin te/ /bdag lta'i chu bo rdzas chu bo/ /zhe sdang gti mug chu bo dang / /'dod chags chu yi rgyun phyogs khyer/ /dga' bzhi'i gzings kyis sgol byed pas/ /rgya mtsho ma lus rgal ba'o—/ /de rnams yongs su dag pa yis/ /kun las rgal zhes brjod pa yin/ /spyor ba thabs dang shes rab la/ /chags bral chags pa mya ngan 'das/ /bde ba tshor ba sred pa 'dzin/ /ngo tsha rtse dang lta rol pa/ /shes rab ma yi chos brgyad do / /chags dang tshim dang dga' ba dang / /gya nom pa dang rtse ba dang / /tsudza 8—313

nyed 1dang sgra brjod dang / /brtan dang brtson dang yid byed pa/ /bcu gcig thabs kyi byed pa'o/ /de lta'i chos spangs sems can ni/ /ye shes rnyed dka' dgon par 'dod/ /de las byung ba ye shes rten/ /de 'dra'i rnam grol lam gyis ni—/ /nyon mongs nye ba kun nyon mongs/ /'khrul pa'i khams rnams rtog pa kun—/ /bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs pa/ /de ni thabs chen dug la bsngags/ /brtul pyib lta bu yon tan thob/ /sngags med dug gis 'chi bar byed / /sngags ni snying rje chen po dang / /shes rab stong par rtogs pa yis/ /sbyor sgol byed pa thabs kyi mchog /de ltar las rnams don yod pas/ /bde bas 'gro ba'i don byed pas/ /srid dang zhi bar mi gnas pa'o/ /'du shes ming dang rdzas dang brda/ /kun gyi ldudon spangs mnyam gzhag byung / /rnam shes don ni 'od gsal bas/ /bltas pas rtog kun 'gag par byed/ /sems can 'gro ba rigs drug la/ /rnams kyi yid yul dug gsum sogs/ /ldan pa chags sdang sems skyes pa'o/ /de 'dra sems can kun gyi yid/ /rig pas 'khrul spangs 4 gnyen ye shes/ /sems can kun gyi yid la ni/ /'od gsal chos dbyings rab tu gnas/ /de dag don byed ye shes la/ /sems dang mthun par 'jug cing bsgyur/ /sems can kun yid gang yod pa/ /tshim par byed de ma spangs grol/ /sems can kun gyi 'khor ba'i gnas/ /yid dga' ba ni lam thob pa'o/ /grub mtha' rang rang 'dod pa la/ /'dod pa med pa mthar phyin pa'o/ /'khrul pa med do dam pa'i don/ /de yang dang po'i ⑤sangs rgyas las/ /ji bzhin pa ni rtog kye dang bral/ /byis pa rnam gnyis rnam par rtog /rtog bral rgyal ba chos kyi sku—/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs can yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nor ba rtag 8—314

chad la sogs pa/ /thams cad de la rnam par spangs/ /don gsum kun brtags gzhan dbang dang / /yongs grub de nyid shes pa yis/ /the tshom med pa'i blo thob pa'o①/ /kun don 'gro ba'i bya ba la/ /yon tan gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /phung po lnga don bde chen du/ /dus gsum mnyam nyid rtogs pa'o/ /skad cig gcig la dbu ma can/ /rlung rnams thams cad bye brag phyed/ /skad cig gcig gis dbu mar tshud/ /de la bde stong rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /de nyid sangs rgyas kun gyi ⑤ni/ /rang bzhin 'chang ni ye shes 'dzin/ /yan lag med pa chos kyi sku/ /sku ni longs sku bde ba che/ /lus kyi mchog ni sprul pa'i sku/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa de yin no/ /lus kyi mtha' ni sku gsum du/ /rtogs pa po ni rnal 'byor pa'o/ /de yi mchog thob dus dag tu/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni yongs su ston/ /zhes pa mi 'dra sna tshogs gzugs/ /gang la gang 'dul yongs su ston/ /bsgrub bya yin pas nor bu las1// /'dod dgu 'byung bas rin po che / /nub pa med pas tog nguces bya/ /dgag phyogs ma rig la sogs pa/ /bcu gnyis spangs te mthun pa'i phyogs/ /sa bcu gnyis ni thob pa las/ /tshigs bcad nyi shu rtsa bzhi dag /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rgya cher 'grel pa ste le'u dgu pa'o// //le'u bcu pa don yod grub/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes la/ /las kyi bya ba tshes 3bco lnga/ /dag pa sh+lau ka pyabaco lnga bstan/ /sangs rgyas kun ni dus gsum bzhugs/ /rtogs bya ba ni ye shes sku/ /de yang de nyid 'dus pa las/ /khyod ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i yab/ /'byung dang 'byung bar gyur pa yin ñdzu/ /sangs 8—315

rgyas byang chub khyod la brten/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams khyod la brten/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas byang chub lhan cig skyes/ /bla na med pa gong na med/ /yi ge med las gsang sngags 'byung / /zhes pa byang chub yi ge med/ /de las gsang sngags byung ba mi// /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthu yin no/ /gsang sngags chen po rlung yin te/ /rigs gsum pa ni 'byung 'jug gnas/ /de ni rlung gi byed pa'o / /gsang sngags don kun bde ba ste/ /bde med rlung ni nyan thos yod/ / de nas bde ba skyed dhipa'o/ /phrin las zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi/ /'di yis nges par sgrub pa'o/ /thig le che ②ni don dam pa/ /bde chen rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /yi ge med pa nyid yin no/ /stong pa yi ge med pa nyid/ /chen po 'byung lnga phung po lnga—/ /yi ge lnga ni 'di yin te/ /oṃ hūṃ ṭ+wāṃḥtwe khaṃ lnga dang / /lo mo paṃ tai baṃ rnams so—/ /thig les rtsa rnams yi ger 'gyur/ /gyur pas ཿbde ba sna tshogs 'byung / /rlung gis khams gsum rtog pa rgyas/ /stong pa rang gi ngo bos stong / /bde bsdus yi ge drug po ni/ / ཿhaṃ oṃ hūṃ ④ho k+ṣaḥdrug /re rer bde rlung 'dus pa las / /lus ngag yid la mtshan ma 'byung / /yang na snying dbus cha drug pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang la hūṃ du 'dod/ /kun rdzob rnam pa kun ldan la/ /don dam par ni rnam pa med/ /dga' ba de nyid dga' bcu drug /mgrin pa la sogs phyed phyed 'dri / /thig le gnas nas nor bu'i rtser/ /gnyis gnas pa ni dbus na'o/ /de nyid shes rab ye shes so/ /rnam rtog yan lag med pa'o⑤/ /grangs bgrang byis pa'i rtsis las 'das/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i ⑥rtog dpyod dang / /dga' bde bzhi sde ⑦dga' bzhi sbyar/ /rtse mo 'chang ni gtsug nor gnyis/ /mi 'dzag bde ba 'chang ba'o/ /bsam gtan yan lag kun shes shing / /thabs dang rtog 8—316
