bzhin 'khor dgod bya/ /'on kyang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang ①/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni bong bu yi/ /rnam pa'i gdong can khrag mig gam②/ /mkha' 'gro ma'i lag na mdung rtse gsum pa steng du bskor zhing kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams pa phyag bzhi pa—/ mi ro'i gdan la bcibs shing me bzhin 'bar ba spyan gsum pa skra grol ba gcer bu'o/ /bdag po la sogs pa thams cad kyi mtshan ma dang rgyan dang gos la sogs pa ni sngar bstan pa bzhin du blta'o/ /'on kyang thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo thams cad ni nam mkha' lding gi zhal can no/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rnams kyi zhal ni rma bya'i gdong can no/ /sku'i 'khor lo'i dpa' bo ni seng ge'i gdong can no/ /khwa'i gdong pa la sogs pa ni rang gi ming gi gdong pa'o—/ /gshin rje'i gdong pa la sogs pa mtshams kyi ni ma te dang / ri dwags dang / stag dang / de bzhin du gung gi gdong pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa la spyan dmar zhing snying rje chen pos yongs su gzung ba /kye chos bdag med pa las byung ba'o/ /'di rnams rnal 'byor dam pa'i gtso/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zad byed pa'o/ /dbugs rnams lte ba'i rtsa ba nas/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa gnyis dag gis④/ /zla ba nyi ma rnam par bshad/ /chu shing me tog lta bu ni/ /lte ba'i rtsa ba nas 'greng pa/ /ba lang rmig 'dra'i pad+ma ni/ /bong bur rnam par shes par bya/ /'og tu phyogs pa'i pad+ma gang / /zla ba'i 'od 'dras rnam brgyan pa/ /de dbus rtag tu stong pa ni/ /hūṃ yig rlung gi rang bzhin nyid/ /'bar ba mar me lta bu ste/ /'og gi rlung ni yongs gang las/ /snying ga nas ni steng du rgyu/ /spyi bo phug ste 'gro bar bshad/ /rnal 'byor pa gang sa gsum mnyam/ /sems can kun gyi snying gnas pa/ /sems ni mnyam par 8—901

song ba ste/ /sems kun la ni dbang thob pas/ /mchog gi pha rol phyin thob ste//rab tu 'bar ba'i skad cig la/ /mun pa'i tshogs kun 'joms byed pa/ /nyi 'od nor bu ji lta bar/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu ma lus pa'i/ /sa gsum gsal bar byed pa ste/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar/ /g.yo ba med cir 'khrul pa med / /rgyu dang dpe las rnam par 'das/ /rnam par mi 'gyur gos pa med/ /sgrib pa lnga ni rnam par spangs/ /te ru ka dpal mgon rang bzhin/ /bdag nyid rig pa med pas na/ /skad byug de la 'das kun dang / /ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung —/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i rang yid mthong / /'di ni bong bu'i rnal 'byor pas / /lag mthil gnas pa bzhin du mthong / /de yi don du g.yeng ba kun/ /spangs nas zla ba drug tsam du/ /lkugs pa'i dngos por ldan gyur pas/ /bong bu'i mkha' 'gro bsgrub par 'gyur/ /bsgrub pa dang ni ldan pa yis/ /rnal 'byor thams cad rnyed par 'gyur/ /brtul zhugs bral yang brtul zhugs ldan/ /dri ma can yang dag par 'gyur/ /dbul po yin yang nor 'byor 'gyur/ /nad pa yin yang nad bral 'gyur/ /rgas med 'chi ba med rnyed pas/ /thos pa med par chos ston cing / /sdug bsngal du ma'i tshogs la ni/ /sems can dgrol bar byed pa po/ /bstan pa bla med ston pa yin/ /mi snang la sogs dngos grub dang //lha mig mngon shes lnga thob pa/ /'jig rten gsum gang cung zad yod/ /thams cad skad cig de la mthong / /tshe zad par ni snang ba dang / /de bzhin tshe ring gyur pa nyid/ /bong bu dang ni glang chen dang / /gang dang gang du rigs 'gyur pa—/ /skye ba stong phrag du mar yang / /de dang de yi gzugs su ni/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'dir mthong 'gyur/ /gang 'dir skye ba bdun shes nas/ /de yis 8—902

gtor ma sbyin sreg bya/ /rnam par mi rtog bdag nyid kyis/ /mtshan mo gsang ba la gnas te/ /bzang po nyid du sbyar byas nas/ /lha yi lus su 'gyur ba dang / /grub pa nyid du the tshom med/ /zlos pa zhes bya ba ni dung gi phreng ba la'o/ /gsang ba zhes bya ba ni skye ba bdun pa'i dang sngags kyi mtshan nyid kyi'o/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u bcu bzhi pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas brda zhes bya ba ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi brda byas pa'o/ /dngos grub 'dod pa rnams kyis shes par bya'o/ /dang zhes bya ba ni go sla'o/ /bsam pa gcig pa nyid kyi phyir de mnyes par 'gyur ro zhes pa'o/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u bco lnga pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas zhes bya ba ni rim pa bzhin du'o/ /gsang ba zhes bya ba ni skal ba med pa'i sems can rnams la mi bstan pa'o/ /dngos grub che zhes bya ba la sgrub pa po de nyid kyi gnyis su med pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i byed pa po'o/ /de gang zhe na/bram ze rnam snang bshad pa ste/ /rin chen tsaṇ+ḍa līr 7 shes bya/ /gar mkhan dpag med mgon po ste/ /tshos mkhan don yod rdo rje can/ /mi bskyod pa yi ḍom+bi ste/ /drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /rgyal rigs su ni shes par bya /bdun pa te ru ka yi ni/ /sna tshogs rigs 'byung midamangs rigs so/ /g.yon nas 'gro ba'i bud med gang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni go sla ste/ sgrub pa po'i 8—903

thabs rjes su mthun pa'i phyir des nan tan du shes par bya'o/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u bcu drug pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas rnyed dka' zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ chags pa chen po'i rang bzhin nyid ni 'dod chags lkubral ba la sogs pas rnyed par 1dka' ba'o/ /de gang zhe na/ dam tshig dkyil 'khor dam pa'o/ /bdud rtsi lnga zhes bya ba la lnga ni sa la sogs pa'o/ /dngos bden pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni chos thams cad bsdus par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas lnga po rnams kyi 1bdud rtsi ni stong pa nyid kyi snying po ste/ yang dag sbyor bas gcig bsdus pa④/ /snying po gang yin de bde ba/ /rlung zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems/ /dbang po kun gyi gtso 'di yin/ /de yi dbus su yang dag bskyed/ /yi ge la sogs pa yi gzugs/ /gzugs can ma dang rnal 'byor ma/ /lā mā khyadang ni dum skyes te/ /zhal bzher 'u/par ni rnam par bshad/ /spyor ba bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /lnga pa 'khor los ⑦sgyur ba ste/ /ge sar dang ni lte bar ldan/ /'dab ma bzhi yis yang dag mtshan/ /de dbus dpa' bo chen po ste/ /phyag brgyad kyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dang po'i sha yis yongs bkang ba/ /de bzhin gnyis pa'i khrag gis te/ /lhag ma'i phyag gnyis dbang bskur ba'i/ /dra ba'i phyag rgya 'dzin par mdzad/ /lnga pa drug pas lha mo 'khyud/ /gzhan gyis kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u/ /sku mdog dkar po 'od 'phro ba/ /ston ka'i nam mkha' dri med bzhin/ /dkar po dmar po sngo dang ljang / /'bar ba'i zhal bzhi gsungs pa'o/ /gshin rje ma dang skrag byed ma/ /nags tshal ma dang 8—904

'jigs ma dang/ /kun spyod tshe za ba su ra/ /brgyad pa phag mor yang dag brjod/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo dang mtshams/ /brgyad du rnam par 'gyur zhing 'jigs pa nyid/ /sha dang khu ba gsol ba ste/ /dang po rgyas 'debs phyag rgya ste//gnyis pa snying dral ba yi rgya/ /gsum pa rmongs byed phyag rgya ste/ /de bzhin bzhi pa slong ba'i rgya/ /lnga pa gar gyi phyag rgya ste/ /de bzhin drug pa gsod pa'i rgya/ /bdun pa 'jog par ①byed pa ste/ /brgyad pa ldang ba'i phyag rgyar 2nges/ /phyag rgya brgyad du bshad pa'o/ /phyag gi mtshon char yang dag ldan/ /'od zer phreng ba du ma las/ /sangs rgyas tshogs kyi sprin 'phro zhub/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /yang na sngon du bstan pa bzhin/ /'khor lo gsum po 'od kyis nam mkha' rgyas pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa brjod bya ba/ /dbus su 'khor lo yang dag bri/ /ge sar dang ni lte bar ldan/ /'dab ma bzhi dang ldan par bshad/ /kha dog sna tshogs yang dag 'bar/ /de dbus dpa' bo dgod pa'o/ /shel ltar dag pa dri ma med/ /dang po'i zhal ni rnam bzhad cing / /chags pa'i lta bas rnam par gzigs/ /khro gnyer rab tu 'bar ba dang / /mche ba gcigs pas 'jigs par mdzad/ /g.yas kyi zhal ni gdengs pa ste/ /g.yon pa ngo mtshar che ba nyid/ /rgyab zhal 'jigs pa che ba ste//zhal dag ④'bar dang bcas pa'o/ /dkar dang dmar dang de bzhin sngo/ /ljang gu rnams kyi gdong can no/ /phyag brgyad par ni yang dag bri/ /rgyan kun 'dzin pa dpal dang ldan/ /ljags 'dril bas ni 'jigs su rung / /'jig ⑤ pa'i dus ltar drag shul che/ /dur khrod du ni 'jigs shing rngam/ /ha ha zhes bzhad cher bzhad cing / /yi ge phem gyi pyasgra sgogs pa'o/ /zhal gcig pa dang phyag 8—905

gnyis su/ /lha rnams bzhi po bshad pa ste/ /shar du rdo rje sems dpa' yin/ /lho ru rnam snang mdzad du brjod/ /nub tu don yod rgyal po ste/ /byang du pad+ma gar dbang ngo / /kha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa phyag bsnams nas/ /khrag dang khu ba dag gsol mdzad/ /'khor lo'i dbus su he ru ka /sngon bstan stimatshon cha bsnams nas bzhugs/ /gnyis pa 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad che/ /thal mdog 'od zer dmar po 'bar/ /de la lugs 'byung lugs bzlog pas/ /dgod pa nyid du rab tu grags/ /gzugs can ma dang 'o byed ma/ /khā ma yongs 'gyur byis bcas mo//mi ldog lha mo dī ②pa mo/ /brgyad pa rdo rje'i gar dbang brjod/ /nang gi lha mo'i gzugs brgyad ni/ /sku mdog dkar la 'bar dang bcas/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni phyag gis 'dzin/ /spyan gsum rgyan kun 'bar dang bcas/ /sgeg dang bcas pa'i lha yi lus / /snying rje dga' ba'i mdzes dang ldan/ /de nas thugs gsung sku yi ni/ /'khor lo lha rnams dgod par bshad/ /shar phyogs pa la sogs pa ji lta ba bzhin bye snalugs su 'byung ④ba dang lugs las bzlog pas/ dung can ma dang lbos pomo dang / /gsod byed ma dang ser mo dang / /dral byed de bzhin gtum mo ste/ /ri khrod nyid dang sgol ma'o/ /de dag ni thugs kyi 'khor lo'i'o/ /khro gnyer khams gsum rnam rgyal ma/ /so can de bzhin za byed ma/ /sna chen ma dang ba lang gdong / /byi la can dang glang chen lce/ /de dag ni gsung gi 'khor lo'i 'o//ba lang sna dang bzhin bzangs ma/ /dmar gtum ma dang so sngo bsangs/ /stobs chen nags tshal dri ldan ma/ /mdog khra mo dang bden g.yon ma/ /sku yi 'khor lo'o/ /de dag sgeg gdong sgeg dang bcas/ /snying rjes gdungs shing 8—906

myos dang ldan/ /rang ming brjod pa'i sngags la ni/ /oṃ dang hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sbyor pas / /thugs gsung sku yi dbye ba yis/ /lha mo rnams ni mdog sngo zhing / /zangs gri dang ni thod pa can/ /gang yang sku mdog dmar lha mo/ /pad+ma dang ni thod pa can/ /lha mo sku mdog dkar ba dang / /mdung thung dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ thogs//dka' bzlog nyid dang tsā muṇ+ḍi①/ /tshangs pa dang ni khyab 'jug ma/ /sgo rnams skyong bar yang dag bshad/ /sgo bzhi rnams su sbyar bar bya/ / gang gis ekha ṭ+wāṃ thod pa ste/ /khrag dang khu ba gsol mdzad pa'o/ /kun kyang rgyan kun yongs sdogs shing / /skra grol gcer bur gyur pa yi/ /snying rje dga' ba'i bde ba che/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi rgyal po 'di/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /thams cad bza' bar gang rigs pa/ /dngos por rang bzhin mnyam bsres te/ /dag dang ma dag ngor mi lta/ /rigs dang mi rigs min de bzhin/ /de nyid bcu ni rig pa yis①/ /thams cad za zhing longs spyod bya/ /bud med mtshan nyid shes byas la/ /de nyid rig pas mchod par bya/ /mngon par zhen pas zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ sgra ji bzhin pa ste gsal lo/ /'on kyang / gzugs can ri mo can du brjod/ /dung can 'o byed mar gsungs te/ /khā ma nyid ni glang chen ma/ /yongs 'gyur ma ni pad+ma can/ /mi ldog pa'i cel bir shes bya/ /dī byepa mo dang phur bu ma/ /re re yang ni gnyis gnyis su/ /so so yi ni mtshan nyid 'gyur/ /pad+ma can ni pad dri dang / /glang chen myos pa'i stobs bzhin du/ /dbyangs snyan snyan par smra ba dang / /mnyen bzhin lang tsho 'bar ba'i gzugs/ /yan lag rtsub la pad+ma yi/ /'dab 'dra'i mig la skra 'khyil zhing / /sna dang so ni phrad de yang / /sor mo thung zhing yan lag mnyen/ /sen mo 'jam zhing zangs 8—907

kyi mdog /bzhin ni rab tu zhi ba ste/ /dpal 'dod pa ni pad+ma can/ /zhi ba'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /glang po can ma glang po'i dri/ /mchu 'phyang byin pa sbom ma dang / /glang chen tsas pa'i stabs ①su 'gro/ /sor mo ring zhing lus po ring —/ /nu ma 'phyang zhing skra rtsub la/ /lte ba mtho zhing nu ma rtsub/ /mig ni phra zhing sbrang rtsi sred/ /snyan par smra zhing skad 'dzer ba/ /'dod ldan ro sad mchu 3 sbom zhing / /rkang mthil mnyam par gnas pa ste/ /chang la dga' zhing dus rtag tu / /nor 'dod glang po can ma ste/ /rgyas pa'i sbyor ba brtsam par bya/ /dung can ma ni dung mdog dang / /zhib ma'i gdong can byin pa ring / /bya rog skad dang bong bu dri/ /so sbom sor mo ring ba ste/ /skra rtsub yan lag 'jam pa dang / /lus bong mtho zhing mig chung ma/ /mgrin pa phra zhing so thag ngan/ /sna mtho mchan khung sru yod pa/ /mchu srab gdugs kyi rnam pa can/ /dung can ma ni khyim thab gsod/ /dbang gi las la sbyar bar bya/ /ri mo can ma rtag tu ni/ /ri mo la dga' sna tshogs mdog /sna tshogs gzugs can nu ma 'phyang / /sen mo mnyen zhing skad chung la/ /lus bong chung zhing byad kyang chung / /sgra ngan bya rog rang bzhin can/ /bya rog sgra skad sha la dga'/ /tshig rtsub 'dod pa'i nus dang ldan/ /nag po'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /pad+ma can ni lha yi rigs/ /glang po can ma gnod sbyin rgyud/ /dung can ma ni mir shes bya/ /ri mo can ma yi dwags rigs/ / ba ta ⑤pa ya lha yi rigs/ /gdugs kyi dpung pa mgrin pa ring —/ /so snang ba la mchu snum zhing / /mig ni pad+ma ltar dmar ba'i/ /skye gnas yangs shing dpral ba yi/ /dbyes che skra snum ser skya'o/ /lus po ran zhing ring ba yi/ /sna mtho sna ni rno ba ste/ /yan lag 'jam zhing lag pa'ang ring / /8—908

ngang pa'i 'gros can ngang pa'i skad/ /dri dang me tog 'o ma sred/ /ldug par gtong zhing lha la gus/ /bud med dbang phyug rnams kyi gtso/ /nyung ngu za zhing nor dang ldan/ /rgyas pa'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /pi la pi ni nu rgyas ma/ /lus bong mtho zhing byin pa sbom/ /ngo tshon mig ni phra ba ste/ /rna ba 'phyang zhing skra rtsub pa—/ /bung ba'i skad la mchu 'phyang ma/ /lus rgyas lto ni mang du za/ /'dod pa chung zhing rtag stobs ldan/ /tshogs pa la dga' dpung pa 'phyang / /yan lag rtsub cing skra ring ba/ /so sna sen mo 'jam pa ste/ /rkang pa mnyam zhing sna ring la—/ /lto ni bum pa ltar sgom zhing / /bum pa'i 'phyang ba ①la mdzes pa'i bzhin/ /zhi dang rgyas la'ang ②sbyar bar bya/ /phur bu ma ni mig g.yo zhing / /'og mig can la gdong srab pa/ /so snang lus kyi sha srab cing / /skra chu 'dod drag na 'bab pa/ / sago skya bus 1pa ltar 'gro zhing / /sgur zhing lus bong chung ba ste/ /lag pa thung zhing nu ma mtho/ /smin spom dpral chung byin yang sbom//de yis reg na mi 'tsho ste/ /nye du rnams ni brlag par byed/ /nag po'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /brgyad pa ri dwags ma skal bzang ④/ /lto ba chung zhing rkang pa chung —/ /ri dwags mgrin pa ri dwags mig /skra ni phra zhing snum pa ste/ /so yang sra la mchu snum pa/ /gzugs mdzes thig le lta bu'i byang / /reg 'jam sred pa mang du smra/ /sgra ni bya rog skad lta bu/ /rtag tu gcer bu dbul ba yin/ /sems rtsub pa la sdig la dga'/ /skur 'debs ma de yi dwags rigs/ /dbang gi las la sbyar bar bya/ /'di brgyad du ni rab tu grags/ /thod pa dang dgra sta la sogs pa'i mtshan ma brgyad ni/ ji ltar bstan pa'i rigs kyi go rims bzhin du gzugs can ma la sogs pa'i phyag dang po'i mtshan ma'o/ /8—909

gzhan gyi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa nas khrag dang khu ba gsol ba'o/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u bcu bdun pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi go 'phang mchog /ces bya ba la mchog ni mang po'i rigs te/ mang por 'gyur ba'i rigs rnams so//gang yang gsungs pa/ dam pa'i rigs ni rnam pa brgya/ /zhes pa'o/ /rab tu gnas pas na go 'phang ste/ gang gi mtshan nyid gsung ba de nyid kyis yongs su dag pa'o/ /dam tshig ces bya ba ni rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi rjes su 'jug pa ste/des gnas pa'o/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u bco brgyad pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /zhes bya ba ni mdog dang mtshan ma'i rjes su'o / /lā ma zhes bya ba ni yid du 'ong ba reg pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ste/ yan lag thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /gang gi bzhin zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni go sla'o/ /srin ①mo zhes bya ba ni sbyor ba gcig pa'o/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba ni/ lag pa gnyis pad+ma skor ④bar sbyin par bya'o/ /yang na pad+ma'i phyag rgya ni pad+ma'i phyag rgya ste/ gang du ji lta 1 bar—/ langs pa'am ni stan dag la/ /mdun du skal bzang bzhag nas ni/ /pad+ma rab tu rgyas par bya/ /myur du gnyis gnyis sbyor ba yis/ /mkhas pas rdo rjes rgyas gdab bya/ /rus sbal gyi phyag rgya ni lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /8byed910

rus sbal phyag rgya bha gar ni①/ /thal mo brdeg spyedang ldan reg bya/ /phyag rgya sngags kyi sbyor ba yis/ /sa bhuyis ma mchu bcir bar byed/ /mi thub ri dwags lpags pa'o④/ /yang na 'jam zhing mtshan nyid bzang / /mi thub stan du shes par bya/ /spyi blugs thod pa zhes brjod de/ /yang na spyi blugs lus su brjod/ /lag gnyis mgrin par dam 'khyud nas/ / ji ltar ⑤skyil krung bcas nas 'khyud/ /ji ltar phyag rgya rtogs 'gyur ba/ /phyag rgya'i lan du brjod pa yin—/ /tshes bcu bzhi zhes bya ba la sogs pa go sla'o/ /yang na tshes bcu bzhi'i gnas skabs ji ltar rnyed/ pad+ma rnam par rgyas shing 'bar dang ldan/ /dpal ldan gang gi sems ni gang mnyam pa/ /de ni pad+ma can gyi mtshan nyid yin/ /mchu gnyis glo zhing zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni go sla'o/ /mdung zhes bya ba ni ser mo gcig bstan pa'i phyag rgya sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje skyil krung gis/ /rang gi rdo rje der gnas pa'o/ /gar nyid kyang ni bstan par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni/dam du 'khyud nas 'o byed cing / /byed pas bsngams pa'i phyag rgya rnams/ /rab tu bskor ba byas nas ni/ /glang chen ma dang bde sgrub ma'o/ /bcu bzhi zhes bya ba ni go sla'o/ /ci nus pas mchod par bya'o zhes bya ba'o/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u bcu dgu pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /lag pa g.yon gyi brda rnams te/ /zhes bya ba la brda rnams kyi gnyis ka'i rang bzhin gcig tu gyur nas ming po dang sring mo ltar shin tu gdung ba'i dbang du gyur nas bsgom pa ⑥thams cad byed do zhes bya 8—911

ba'o—/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u nyi shu pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas gsang ba chen po ni/ /mtshan nyid nga yis bshad par bya/ /zhes bya ba la nga yis zhes bya ba ni rdo rje 'chang bas te/ snying rje chen po'i dbang gis rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi thabs gang gis sgrub po 'grub par 'gyur ba de nyid ni gsang ba chen po'i mtshan nyid de/ nyan thos la sogs pa'i spyod yul ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bud gang spyi gtsug reg byed pa/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni sgra ji bzhin pa ste go sla'o / /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang rab bshad pa/ /yan lag phyag rgya'i khyad par ni/ /zhes bya ba ni 'dir gsang ba chen po'i mtshan nyid do/ /gzhan zhes bya ba ni dam pa ste/ gang gis rnal 'byor ma rnams mnyes par 'gyur ba'o/ /khyad par zhes bya ba la lag pa'i spyi las khyad par ni sor mo rnams so/ /gang gis shes pas zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni sgra ji bzhin pa'o/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ sgra ji bzhin pa ste go sla'o/ /gzhir ni sa gzhi byas nas su/ /zhes bya ba ni stan las ldang ba'o/ /mchod ces bya ba ni 8—912

dam por 'khyud dang 'o bya ba'o/ /smin ma g.yo zhes bya ba ni/ cung zad ngo tsha ba'i phyir ro/ /rnal ①'gyur bskor ba zhes bya ba ni/ phul du byung ba'i bde ba sgrub pa'i don kyis bskor ba ni byang chub kyi sems la yongs su bskor ba ste/ srog dang rtsol ba sdom pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis yang dag par phul du byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du 'bar bas stong pa dbus su chud pa'i sngags pas 'jig rten gsum po dang lhan cig tu 'dre ba ste/ sa dang chu dang rlung nyid dang //me dang nam mkha' nyid dang ni/ /bdag dang gzhan du rtag tshor thu/dang / /skad cig de la kun mi dmigs/ /de'i mod la ldog 'gyur te/ /bdag gis bde ba nyams su stsong / /zhes so/ /khyam du zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni go sla'o/ /yang na—/ bha ga'i dbus chung rdo rje ni/ /shin tu stong par bsgoms pa ni/ /thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'o/ /ma rig la sogs glo bur ba/ /rtog pa'i nyes pa rtog las byung / /rang bzhin 'od gsal rnam dag pa/ /sems ni me long bzhin du blta/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag pa nam mkha' mtshungs/ /ral gri nyon mongs gcod byed pa/ /sems can don byed rno ba'ospyo/ /bsod nams kyis 'degs rgyal mtshan bzhin/ /mdung thung nyon mongs 'bigs byed pas/ /sems ni rtse gcig pa nyid dorngu// /de nyid me rtse ④rnal 'byor pas/ /kha sbyar bde ba thob pa'o/ /mtshan ma'i cha byad gsal zhes bya/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje dang 'khor lo dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang ral gri dang sna tshogs rdo rje rnams ni rgyal mtshan dang / mdung thung rnams ji lta ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rigs kyi dbye bas rdo rje dang rgyal mtshan dang ral gri dang mdung thung ni nas kyi 'bru tshad tsam mo/ /'khor lo dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang 8—913

sna tshogs rdo rje rnams ni sran tsa na ka'i tshad tsam ste/ mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i rim pas ji lta ba bzhin rang rang gi mtshan ma kha dog lnga po'i nang du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo chud pa la/ sems brtan pa phra mo'i rnal 'byor sgom pa las/ rnal 'byor pas phyag rgya'i dngos grub yid kyi rang bzhin bzang po 'grub par 'gyur ro//dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang brda yi skad/ /ces bya ba la yul sna tshogs kyi khyad par gyi skad ni brda zhes bya ba kla klo ①ste/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o—/ /pro haṃ gi zhes bya ba ni gsang ⑤por smra ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ sgra ji bzhin pa nyid kyis na go sla ba ste/ gang zhig brda yi skad rnams shes pa ni3/ /'dir rnal 'byor pa nyid du the tshom med do/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas don kun 'dod pa yi/ /be+e bya brgyad mtha' sbyar byas te/ /zhes bya ba la brgyad kyi mtha' ni yi ge ha ste/ yi ge u dang thig ler bcas pa'o oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni go sla'o/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //8—914

de nas gzhan yang zhes bya ba ni dpal he ru ka'i bdag nyid chen po'o/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog pa yis/ /zhes bya ba ni rnal 'byor gyi bslab ① pa'i rim pa las ma 'das pa'o/ /'og dang steng gi dngos grub ste②/ /zhes bya ba la 'og ni sa 'og la sogs pa gang ci yod pa'o/ /steng gis ①zhes bya ba ni steng gi dngos grub ste phyag rgya chen po'o/ /pho nya dang 'dra bar gyur pas na pho nya ste byang chub pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad du nges shing thams cad du gnyis su med pa'i dga' ba'i rang bzhin kyis legs par gnas pa'i pho nya'o/ /bdag gi pho nya ma zhes bya ba ni spyod pa'i mchog lhan cig tu spyod pa'o/ /kun 'gro zhes bya ba ni skal ba ④ ldan pa'i sems can rnams kyi don bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir 'o bya ba dang rab tu 'khyud pa la sogs pa thams cad ster bas so/ /rnal 'byor gnas kyi khyad par nyid/ /ces bya ba la/ gnas ni sa ru rab tu bshad/ /pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor gnas su gsungs/ /gnyis med dga' ba'i rang bzhin rgyal/ /bde chen gang du gnas pas na/ /de phyir mchog gi pad+ma gnas/ /khu khrag 'dres shing gang ba ni/ /khyad par du ni 'o byas nas/ /lce yis yang dag dril nas blangs⑪/ /chang 'thung rab tu dga' ba yis/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam dgar sbyar/ /ji snyed rnal 'byor tshogs rnams ni/ /zhes bya ba la dga' ba'i bstan bcos las bshad pa'i byed lugs de snyed rnams rdo rje sems dpas gsungs te/ byang chub 'utu grub pas tha mal pa'i mtshan nyid kyi dbye ba shes par bya'o/ /de nyid kyis na/ bden can kun la sbyin bya yi/ /gzhan du nam yang ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ma dang sring mo zhes bya ba la sogs pa rnams ni sgra ji bzhin pa'o/ /gang zhig rtag tu sngags sbyin pa/ /zhes bya ba ni phyag rgya de nyid dang sbyor bas shes rab ye shes so 8—915

zhes bya'o/ /rnyed dka'i dam tshig nga yis bshad/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa ni go sla'o—/ /he ru ka las sbyor gzhan med/ /ces bya ba ni gang zhig bstan pa de thams cad he ru ka'i sbyor bas bya'i gzhan kyis ni ma yin no zhes bya ba'i don no/ /de nyid kyis na/ slob dpon rnal 'byor ma nyid kyisti/ /zhes pa ste/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi ma ni rnal 'byor ma'o/ /de'i phyir brnyas mi bya zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rnal 'byor gzhan dang kun sbyor pas/ /zhes bya ba la/snying rje chen por khyerab dga' ba'i/ /rnal 'byor mchog gi thabs spangs nas/ /'dod lha'i dngos grub bsgrub don du/ /rnal 'byor gzhan la brten byas pas /gang zhig dngos grub 'dod gyur pa/ /dmus long bzhin du rnam par rmongs/ /rgyal srid las nyams rgyal po bzhin/ /nges par sdug bsngal kyis rmongs 'gyur/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod pa bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa sna tshogs pa gsungs pa ste/rnam par mi rtog sems kyis ni/ /rigs rnams thams cad mnyam par sbyar/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /nyan pa la sogs dbang bo kun/ /bsre zhing bde bar bsdu bar bya/ /gtso bo gang du spyod pa yi/ /tshangs spyod stong pa nyid du 'gyur/ /brjed med dran pa'i spyod pa yis/ /bde ba rtogs par byed pa'i gzhi/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub lam dag pa'i/ /de nyid bla na med pa ni/ /dam tshig spyod pa rab tu gsungs/ /byang chub bsgrub la gnas pa yi/ /sgrub pa po yis rtag zhes bya/ /rgyud kun gyi ni thun mong du/ /zhes bya ba ni bya ba dang spyod pa dang rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / rnal 'byor bla ma'i rgyud chen po'i rang bzhin du bya ba'i sbyor ba dang mtshungs pa ma yin no/ /mi gzhom zhes bya ba ni/ mnyam pa'i bdag nyid du blta bar mi bya ste/ rgyud de dang de rnams ni 8—916

rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dam tshig mi spyod shin tu sbas/ /gang la mi sbyin mi bya ste—/ /skal ldan sems can rnams la bshad/ /kha la sogs pa brgya po 'di①/ /mos dang dad pas 'phel byed pas/ /zhes bya ba la 'dod pa'i don phun sum tshogs pa nges shing / byang chub kyi lam la ②thams cad la khyab pas legs par gnas pa'o/ /dad pa'i ①nyid kyis zhes bya ba ni/ chos rnams dad pas gzung bya ste/ /shes rab ldan pa'i de nyid rig /ces pa'o/ /de nyid kyis na brtag pa'i rgyal po gnyis pa ④las gsungs pa/ lag pas ma yin dung por min/ /mkhas pas lce yi blang bya ste/ /tshe dang nad med 'phel byed pas/ /yang dag ye shes 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /mthe'u chung zhes bya ba mthe'u chung ni tshigs ⑤dang ldan pa ste / lo bcu gcig pa'i bdag nyid bzung nas/ lce yis blangs te ra sa ya na'i ⑥ dngos grub brtsam pa ni bde ba chen po 'byung ba'i rgyu'o/ / sgrub pa po ⑦ni gsum du gnas/ zhes bya ba ni chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i bye brag gis so/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u nyi shu rtsa drug pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas dpa' bo spyod brtul zhugs/ /zhes bya ba la kun la spyod pas na spyod pa'o—/ /brtul zhugs ni rus pa'i rgyan la sogs pa'o/ /dpa' bo zhes bya ba ni rnal 'byor pa'o/ /de su zhig ce na/ rnal 'byor ma rnams rab bsgrub pa/ /zhes bya ba'o/ /mtshan nyid dbye ba shes byas nas/ /zhes bya ba la/ phung po khams sogs mdor bsdus nas/ /sgyu ma lta bur shes par bya/ /'jig rten chos brgyad yongs shes shing / /dpal ldan slob dpon rdo rje can/ /kun gyi mgon la 8—917

phyag 'tshal nas/ /bya ba byas pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa bsten par bya/ /'khar gsil lhung bzed chos gos dang / /chu tshags sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis/ /yan lag lung bzhin mi spang ste/ /lung ma rtogs ①pa'i rnal 'byor pa—/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs can du 'gyur/ /shes rab pha rol phyin dmigs pa/ /lhag pa yi ni lha gcig nyid/ /stong pa'i ye shes yang dag 'byung / /gdug pa thams cad 'jigs byed pa/ /sngon bzhin drag shul rnam 'gyur dpal/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par mdzad/ /mche ba rab tu gatshigs pa po/ /gtsug na zla ba phyed pa la/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i ral pas brgyan/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par klubs/ /rgyan rnams thams cad yongs rdzogs shing / /stag gi pags pas rnam dkris pa/ /phyed krung bcas pas shin tu gnas/ /sdang ba thams cad 'dul mdzad pa/ /sred dang rmongs pa phrag dog 'gyur/ /kā la rā ṭi 'og tu mnan/ /sbyan gsum zhal bzhi mgrin pa bzhi/ /mkha' ltar sngo skya ser dang dmar/ /steng gi zhal ni ljang gu ste/ /rdo rje dril bus snyems 'jug sbung / /phag mo dang ni gnyis med dga'/ /chos kyi 'khor lo khar gsil snod/ /mdung dang zhags pa lcags kyu'i phyag /de bzhin mgo dang rnge'u chung ste/ /phyag gnyis na ni chos gos so/ /mi lpags snam bu gnyis kyis 'phyar/ /phag mo mdog dmar gcer bu la/ /spyan gsum skra ni grol ba ste/ /rgyan rnams thams cad rab 'bar ba/ /g.yon pa ro yi lhung bzed de/ /g.yas pa rnge'u chung chos dbyangs sgogs/ /byin pa gnyis ni mnyam 'khyud cing / /snying rje dga' ba'i bde ba che/ /shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma la/ /rngon pa mo dang gdol pa ni/ /btso blag mkhan dang puk+ka sī/ /shan pa ma dang ri khrod ma/ /de bzhin nya ba sha wa ri/ /ser dang 8—918

sngo dmar dud kha dang / /skya bo dang ni dmar dang ljang / /de bzhin brgyad pa dkar po ste/ /lugs su 'byung dang lugs las bzlog /bzhad dang zhi dang snying rje dang / /sgeg dang rngam dang mi sdug pa/ /drag shul khro bo'i nyams dang ldan—/ / khar gsel dang ni lhung bzed dang / /rnge'u chung dang zangs gri phyag① /sgo bzhir khro mo dgod par bya/ /he ru ka yi rang snang ba/ /rdo rje gtum mo rdo rje'o/ /srin mo rdo rje 'jigs byed ma⑤/ /drag shul gdul dka' kun gsol ma/ /thal ba'i mdog dang ljang gu dang / /dmar dang sngo ba drag shul 'jigs/ /lhung bzed dang ni khar gsil g.yon/ /chos kyi 'khor lo che'u chung g.yas/ /phrag pa'i steng na chos gos 'phyar/ /kun kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par klubs/ /ro steng phyed krung gar gyis ni/ /bzhugs shing skra grol gcer bu'o/ /bsod snyoms pa dang chos gos gsum/ /phyis mi len dang cog pu pa/ /stan gcig pa dang bla gab ①med/ /shing drung pa dang dgon pa ba/ /dur khrod pa dang phyag dar khrod/ /phying pa can dang gzhi peji bzhin/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis po/ /de rnams rnam dag rnal 'byor pa/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis pa'i/ /chos kyi 'dul ba'i tshul khrims kyis/ /rab tu mgu zhing snying rje che/ /dga' ba'i rab tu mdzes pa'o—/ /de rnams dang lhan cig spyod cing rjes su 'dug pa rnams dang bcas pa des yid dga' zhing / rdo rje byin gyis brlab pa byas nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i bde bas bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ shrī ma hā su kha badz+ra he he ru ru rka hūṃ ⑤hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dam tshig gi kha zas la longs spyod cing / sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa dang /brtul zhugs bhu su ku'i spyod pa'i rim pa 'dis spyad par bya'o/ /de la rim pa ni 8—919

'di yin te bhu zhes bya ba ni za ba ste/ de tsam 'ba' zhig rjes su dran zhing 'du 'dzi thams cad yongs su spangs nas/ dka' thub dang bsnyen gnas la sogs pa cung zad tsam yang bsam par mi bya'o/ /su zhig ces ①bya ba ni gnyid log pa ma rig pas nye bar mtshon pa 'di dag rnam par shes pa tsam du mngon du byas la dge ba'i rnam par bsnyen pa'o/ /de ci zhe na slar yang 'jug par bya ste/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyid du mngon du byas te/ rang bzhin gyis dri ma med pa'i phyir ro / /kun gezhes bya ba ni bshang bar 'gro ba ste/ bshang gci tsam zhig 'dor bar byed pa'o/ /des de tsam zhig rjes su bsams nas 'du 'dzi yongs su spangs nas/lus dang tshor ba dang yul dang dbang po'i rang bzhin rnam par bsam par mi bya'o//yul dang yul du zhes bya ba la sogs pa la ngal na phyi rol song nas pho nya'i mtshan nyid nye bar dpyad nas sangs rgyas kyi brtul zhugs la 'jug par bya'o/ /pho nya mo rnams legs 'dres pas/ /phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang gis/ /bla med mchog gi byang chub ni/ /'bad pa med par thob par 'gyur/ /myur ba nyid du zhes bya ba ni / 'od gsal ye shes dag par 'gyur/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pa mtshan bya/ /bsam gtan 'byor pa 'di yis ni/ /sems kyi rin chen rtag 'gyur na/ /byin gyis rlob par byed 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab tu gnas/ /lo grangs bcu drug gzung bya ste/ /rgyan rnams kun kyis rnam par klubs/ /bzhin bzangs ma ni mig yangs ma/ /rnyed nas rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad/ /brtul zhugs chen pos dus bzhir ni/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa rtag tu bya/ /zla ba drug gis de dag kun/ /'grub 'gyur 'dir ni gdon mi za/ /zas la rtag tu spyad par bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ phyag rgya che la zhugs pa ni/ /de ni bza' ba kun 8—920

'dus yin/ /rigs kun la ni kun spyod yin/ /rigs gcig nyid du brtag par bya/ /ji ltar me yis gser bsregs bzhin/ /de bzhin sngags kyis kha zas bsgrub/ /oṃ sarba badz+ra kā mi ṇi sarba bhak+ṣa sho dha ya gu h+ya badz+re ṇi hūṃ swā hā/ mi 'chi bcu phyed mar dang ni/ /sbrang rtsir lhan cig ldan byas la/ /'thungs na sman gyi dam pa ste/ /rga dang 'chi ba ring du spong / /gzhon zhing nad med dpal dang ldan / /gzugs bzangs 'dod lha 'gro ba'i bdag /de nyid dbyer med de yis ni/ /pho nya mo gnyis bsgrub pa la/ /zhes bya ba ni dbang bskur ba'i don du rgyan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya gnyis phun sum tshogs par ①bya ste/gcig ni gsang ba sbyin pa'i don du'o/ /gnyis pa ni shes rab ye shes don du ste/'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung ba dang / gnyis pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i dbugs dbyung ba'i rjes su gnang ba byin la/ de'i rjes su pho nya gcig pu sbyin pa ste④/ slob dpon ①bdag nyid chen po nyid kyis brtul zhugs gzugs kyi phyag rgya chen po'i don bsgrub par bya'o/ /'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa yang dag par sbyin pa gsang ba'i gnas las byung ba'i bla ma'i ④man ngag gi rim pas dbang bskur ba thob pa gsang ba 'di ston pa ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis yang dag par gsungs pa'i ye shes yang dag ⑤ sdogs lus skyes zhes bya ba ji snyed pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis phyag bya bar 'os pa'o zhes bya'o/ /nang par sngar langs zhes bya ba ni 'od gsal bar gyur pa las so—/ /nying lag gis ni bstan bcos rnams/ /lus la gnas pa kun tu spyad/ /ces bya ba la yan lag shin tu dman pas na nying lag ste/ byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i bdud rtsi lnga'o/ /bgegs thams cad bsal bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ /8—921

kun tu spyod pa dang bsod nams dang ye shes 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ /bstan bcos rnams ni rnal 'byor gyi bstan bcos kyi mtshan nyid yin la kun tu spyod pa rnams ni kun spyod do/ /dag byed byas pa lus dang ni/ /zhes bya ba ni lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pas so/ /de yang rim pa 'dis bdag nyid bsam par bya ste/gzugs dang tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa nyid ni/ zlo khyesaṃ tweḥhoḥhūṃ zhes bya bas rnam par snang mdzad dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / 'od dpag tu med pa dang / don yod grub pa dang /mi bskyod pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyid du gyur pa ni dpal he ru ka ste hi yis so/ /mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang /yid ni/ oṃ hūṃ t+t+waṃ dze+ekhye khaṃ haṃ gis gti mug dang / zhe sdang dang / ser sna dang / 'dod chags dang / phrag dog dang / dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hotshokhaṃ re/ gis ni gzugs rdo rje la sogs pa'o/ /dze+e rmā shā t+t+waṃ khaṃ ④ gis ni sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha' rnams spyan ma dang /mā ma tī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma dang / rdo rje phag mo rnams so/ /oṃ s+dzahūṃ hūṃ gis sku dang gsung dang thugs dang ye shes sems dpa' rnams so/ /chos kyi 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la dz+wa e hūṃ 'ukhaṃ hūṃ ltaṅghaspru e'o/ /longs spyod pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa la/ oṃ k+ṣiṃṅgha.u e ste dbyangs yig lnga'o/ /bde ba chen po pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa la haṃ ngo / /sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa la ni a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha ste sde tshan brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa dang / yi ge ka la sogs pa dbus su sbyar bar bya'o/ /pu dza o a go rā de ma kā o tri ko ka ⑥la ka hi/ bye gri sau su na si ma ku dang khaṃ dṛ mo rtsa 8—922

rka pre bo saṃ sum̐ bo/ saṃ khaṃ baṃ lo baṃ bye e e baṃ saṃ oṃ baṃ baṃ/ sum̐ sum̐ shaṃ/ paṃ sum̐ saṃ haṃ/bo khaṃ oṃ rtsa ram̐ khaṃ haṃ/ saṃ e rtsa shri sum̐ paṃ oṃ/ no rtsa baṃ mo/ mgo bo dang / spyi gtsug dang / rna ba g.yas pa dang / rgyab logs dang / rna ba g.yon pa dang /smin ma'i dbus dang / mig gnyis dang / dpung pa'i rtsa ba gnyis dang /mchan khung dag dang / nu ma gnyis dang / lte ba dang / sna rtse dang / kha dang —/ mgrin pa dang / snying ga dang / chu so dang / mtshan dang / bshang ba'i lam dang / brla gnyis dang / byin pa gnyis dang / sor mo rnams dang —/ rkang pa'i bol dang / mthe bo gnyis dang / pus mo ru'o/ /sen mo dang so ni rab tu gtum ma'o/ /sgra 2dang spu ni gtum pa'i mig go/ /pags pa dang dri ma la ni 'od ldan ma'o/ /sha la ni sna chen ma'o/ /rgyus pa la ni dpa' bo'i blo ma'o/ /rus pa la ni mi'u thung ma'o/ /mchin pa la ni lang ka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /snying la ni ljon 'khril ma'o/ /mig gnyis la ni sa srung zhuma'o/ /mkhris pa la ni 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /glo ba la ni klung gi shugs ma'o/ /rgyu ma la ni chang 'thung ma'o/ /gnye ma la ni lha mo sngo bsangs ma'o/ /lto ba la ni shin tu bzang me'o①/ /chu so la ni rta rna ma'o④/ /mdoms bar la ni bya'i gdong pa can noske/ /bad kan la ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /rnag la ni dum skyes ma'o/ /khrag la ni glang sna ma'o/ /rdul la ni 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /tshil la ni rab tu dpa' mo'o/ /mchi ma la ni stobs chen ma'o/ /mchil ma la ni 'khor los sgyur ba'o⑤/ /snabs la ni brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ de ltar mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings su rab tu grags pa'o/ /bstan bcos ci gsungs dor mi bya/ /zhes bya ba la/ bdud rtsi rnams ni sman gyi mchog /mi bskyod bsten 8—923

pas rnal 'byor pa/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms par 'gyur/ /rtag pa yi ni gzi che zhing / /'od dpag med pas stobs che la/ /rdo rje nyi mas rgas pa med—/ /gang phyir don yod rgyal po che/ /sems can kun lus las byung ba/ /don kun bsgrub pa dpal dang ldan/ /sbyor ba de yis mnyam nyid 'gyur/ /mi baspyod 'thung ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /stong phrag lngar ni 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /rtag pas khri phrag rab tu gsungs/ /bye bar don yod rdo rje can/ /'od dpag med kyis tshe mtha' med/ /rdo rje nyi mas rgas pa med/ /'khor ba bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba gnyis/ /'di yis rten byed rnal 'byor pa/ /kun du bzang po dang mnyam 'gyur/ /dag par byas pa'i lus kyis ni/ /rtag tu sngags ni brjod par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni/ oṃ ā nā nā sa ma ya shudhaḥsarba dharmā chonā nā sa ma ya shurnyolhahaṃ/ oṃ swa bhā ba shudhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba shurnyophohaṃ/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba a kophohaṃ/zhes pa'o/ /rnal 'byor gnas rnams nges bstan zhing / /zhes bya ba ni rang gis dbang bskur ba'i rdo rje can la'o/ /mtshon cha rnams ni bsgom mi bya/ /zhes bya ba ni dam tshig yongs su bskyang pa ste/ de nyid ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa chen po'o/ /dam tshig can gyis khro mi bya/ /zhes bya ba ni dag pa'i lam la legs par gnas pa rnams la'o/ /mngon par brtson las 'da' mi bya/ /zhes bya ba ni 'khor lo sdom par dbang bskur ba'i bla ma dang slob ma gnyis la brnyas pa mi bya ba ste—/ gang gi phyir pho nya mo'i bka' thob pa'i phyir/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bskal pa du mar bsags pa yang de'i mod la 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /de'i don zhes bya ba ni bdud rtsi lnga'i don du'o/ /mtshan mo zhes bya ba ni phyag rgya'i mchod pa bya ba'o/ /gnag dang zhes bya ba ni he ru ka'i 8—924

gzugs su'o/ /dmar zhes bya ba ni rdo rje phag mor ro/ /'gul to zhes bya ba ni gsal lo/ /bde ba 'dod pas bde spyod bya/ /zhes bya ba ni ji ltar thos par bde ba ste/ bde ba de nyid kyi rang bzhin gyis phyogs bcur gsal bar byed pa nirka/ 'di lta bu'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid kyi mar me snang ba shin tu chags pa'i dga' ba dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas lhan cig skyes pa'i snying rje chen po la spyad par bya'o/ /rigs dang rigs min zhes bya ba la dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i cho ga dang bslab pa ni dang po'i las can sems can la/ /snying rje'i rgyu yis gzung bar bya—/ /bsgom pa yis ni bar chad can/ /srid pa'i 'ching dang ldan pa bzhin/rmongs pa'i mchog tu gyur pa nyid/ /de bas 'ching ba spangs gyur na/ /tshe 'di nyid la grub par 'gyur/ /don de nyid kyis na/ ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du bya/ /zhes pa'o/ /de la/ zhal bzhir gsungs pa gang yin pa/ /dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin gsungs/ /dga' kun rdzogs pa'i byang chub gabyug /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir/ /zhal gcig tu ni rab tu grags/ /spyan gsum srid pa gsum du shar/ /thog mtha' med pa'i chos rnams ni/ /be+ems po'i rang bzhin las bzlog pa/ /ral pa'i don du rab tu gsungs/ /sna tshogs sems can don mdzad pas/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa yin/ /zla ba byang chub sems 'gyur ba//bde chen rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /srid pa'i yan lag bcu gnyis phyir/ /bcu gnyis phyag dang mngon du ldan/ /yul rnams dang ni dbang po rnams/ /gnyis med rnam pa'i spyod yul gyis/ /phyag rnams mtshan mas mtshan pa yin/ /byang chub sems ni rdo rjer 'gyur nyu / /shes rab dril bu rab tu baspyod/ /sku gsum dag phyir mdung rtse gsum/ /glang po gti mug dral pa ste/ /dgra sta zhe 8—925

sdang gcod byed pa/ /lus ngag sems las yang dag byung / /zhags pas nyes pa 'ching ba ste/ /lus can ma lus mi mthun phyogs/ /sems can don byed rtsom pas na/ /zangs gri shin tu rno ba'o/ /mgo bo tshangs pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ stong pa'i rnam pa ste/ /cang te'u thabs rnams ①dag pa'o/ /rtag tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /chos kyi dbyangs sgra hūṃ mdzad pa'o/ /thod pa nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor te/ /snying rje ro yis yongs bkang ba'o/ /gsol ba dngos grub rgyu yin no/ /mche ba bzhi ni mngon gyur pa/ /bdud bzhi 'joms par mdzad pa'o//'od zer 'khrigs pas 'khrug ldan pa'i/ /rtag tu tshes kyi phreng ba gnyis/ /snying rje ro yis yongs bkang bas/ /ha har bzhad pas gsal mdzad zhal/ /nyon mongs bdud bzhi bdag nyid pas/ /mgo bo'i do shal gyis brgyan byas/ /stong nyid dag pa'i sdigs mdzub bo/ /3pho nya gtsang sbra dang po yin/ /zhes bya ba ni rgyal ba thams cad bde ba'i rin chen gyi ③'byung gnas kyi ④ phyir ro/ /zhi ba ni bdud rtsi dang chang ngo / /zas gcig pu ni za ba nyid/ /ces bya ba ni gang gi phyir rigs du ma nyid rigs gcig pas na dbye ba mi skye ba de ltar bya'o/ /gtsang sbra 'di ni yang dag ⑤spyad/ /ces bya ba ni go sla'o/ /rnam dag bdag nyid ye shes kyis / /sa rnams kyang ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba ni phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub bo/ /gang yang kha cig brtson 'grus go 'phang dman pas thob par ma gyur na yang / sbrul bzhin du lus 'di yongs su btang nas gtsang ma'i gnas la sogs par de bzhin gshegs pa lta bur 'ching ba las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na mi'i 'jig rten du skyes nas ni/ chos ldan rgyal por 'gyur zhes pa ste/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rang bzhin las byung bas byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dang 'dra 8—926

bar sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho zhing sems can skyob pa'i sems kyis smon lam btab pas skye ba dang skye bar bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs su skye ṭ+wāste/dpal dang ldan pa'i shākya'i mgon pos/ ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /de bas na/ bca' ba ④/btung ba la sogs ldan/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas kun sogs mchod/ /ces pa'o/ /rang 'dod pa yi las rnams la/ /dad pas gtor ma sbyin bar bya/ /zhes bya ba ni zhi ba dang rgyas pa la sogs pa rnams la'o/ /mar ngo zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni sgra ji bzhin pa'o/ /mdzub mo mdud byas gung mo nges par sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan par yang dag bsdams/ /'di ni dpral ba'i dbus su rab bzhag nas/ /bskor zhing bskor bas kun du bskor bar bya/ /sngags 'di brjod par byas la/ /oṃ ā rakhra hoḥ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ de ltar lan gsum bzhir brjod do/ /gcer bu spyi gtsug grol 'gyur bas/ /sgrub pos gnas ni mthon po ru/ /lho phyogs kha bltas bzhag nas ni/ /mtshan mo phyed na gtor ma byin/ /mthon po'i gnas zhes bya ba ni ri'i rgyal po lhun po'i steng du lha'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i spyor bas 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma sbyin pa ste/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan/ /rim pa lnga yi dbus su ni/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi dkyil la—/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yongs gyur las/ /bdag nyid he ru kar bsgom bya/ /rtag dang chad pa'i rnam rtog gis/ /'jigs byed dus mtshan 'og tu byas/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /bdud rnams thams cad rab 'joms pa /sku mdog sngo zhing drag chen po/ /'jig dus me ltar drag shul che/ /spyan gsum 'jigs shing rngam pa ste/ /thod pa'i phreng ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /sangs rgyas lnga 8—927

yis byin gyis brlabs/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes ral pa bcings/ /byang chub zla bas nye bar mdzes/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku brgyan byas/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis mtshan pa ste/ /zhal drug pa la bcu drug phyag /dpa' ba mi sdug sgeg pa dang / /bzhad dang drag shul ljags 'dril ⑨zhing / /sngo dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu dang ni dkar po nyid/ /steng gi zhal ni cher drag cing / /nam mkha'i cha la longs spyod pa/ /ha har bzhad dang hūṃ hūṃ mdzad/ /hi hi zhes pas 'jigs mdzad pa / /hūṃ hūṃ mdzad bcas phaṭa mdzad pa/ /yi ge oṃ oṃ zhes brjod cing / /rdo rje dril bus snyoms 'jug pa/ /lha mo'i nu ma 'tshir mdzad pa/ /dus mtha'i drag po 'jigs pa yi/ /pags pa na bza' bsnams shing 'dzin/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung rtse gsum/ /zangs gri dang ni dgra sta dang / /lcags kyu zhags pa mgo dang ni/ /cang te'u de bzhin mdung thung ni/ /gnyis kyis dra ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /dpral ba'i steng du legs gnas pa'i/ /phag mo'i mdog dang phyag la sogs pa yang de dang 'dra ba ste/ 'on kyang pags pa'i gos spangs shing / /mda' gzhu 'dzin pa'i lha mo phyag /lha mo'i skra gol gcer bu la/ /dum bus mtshan pa'i ske rags can/ /byin pa gnyis ni mnyam 'khyud nas/ /snying rjes chags pa'i bde ba can/ /'gro drug srid pa yang dag sbyong / /sems can don la brtson par mdzad/ /'dab mar pho nya bzhi po ni/ /sa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin can/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa ste/ /sngo dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum gcer bu skra grol ba/ /brang gi nu ma rab rgyas shing / /sgeg bcas rnam par bzhad pa'i zhal/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yon pas lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgog dang 'bebs pa yi phyag /dgug 8—928

pa dang ni gzhug pa dang / /bcing dang mchog tu mnyes byed pa'o/ /gzhan gyis gri dang thod pa dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang cang te'u 'dzin/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis legs par bzhugs/ /snying rjes chags pa'i myos ldan yang / /'khrul ba thams cad rnam par spangs/ /mtshams su bum pa dang thod pa/ /bza' ba kun byus yongs bkang ba/ /steng du thod pa byang chub kyi/ /'o mas yongs su bkang ba'o—/ /lus ngag yid gsum byin brlabs shing / /ye shes sems dpa'i go cha gnyis/ /pu la sogs pa yang dag sbyar/ /dbang bskur nas ni mchod bya ste/ /bka' bzhin du ni bstod byas la/ /shing gcig dang ni dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su ni/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i sngags kyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ 'jig rten pa thams cad dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i zhing skyong la sogs pa dgod par bya ste/ de la rim pa 'di yin te/ /phag mo dang ni dge ma gnyis/ /gzhon nu ma dang tsā muṇ+ḍi/ /tshangs pa dang ni tshogs bdag ma/ /khyab 'jug dbang po rgyas par bshad/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i 'o/ /rim pa gsum pa la ni/ dbang po gshin rje chu lha dang / /gnod sbyin yi dwags gtso mo dang / /sreg byed srin po rlung gi lha/ /rim pa bzhi pa la ni / nyi ma zla ba mig dmar dang / /gza' lhag dang ni phur bu dang / /pa ba sangs dang spen pa dang / /sgra gcan 'dzin dang rgyal mtshan no/ /rim pa lnga pa la ni/ tshangs pa khyab 'jug de bzhin drag /skem byed nyid ni sgo bzhir ro/ /rim pa gnyis pa'i shar phyogs su/ /tweḥyig las byung lha mo ni/ /phag mo zhes bya phyag bzhi pa/ /mda' dang gzhu dang de bzhin du/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni thod pa nyid / /mdog sngon drag mo chen mo ste/ /phag gi gdong can 'jigs byed ma/ /8—929

byang du dze gyis ①dge ma ni/ /mdog dmar drag mo chen mo ste/ /thod pa nyid dang lcags kyu dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u de bzhin no/ /nub tu nyi yis gzhon nu ma—/ /mdog ser pa la phyag bzhi na/ /mdung rtse gsum dang ba dan gsum/ /gzhu dang mda' ni de bzhin no/ /lho ru hi yis tsā muṇ+ḍi⑤/ /mdog sngo ba la phyag bzhi na/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ nyid dang thod pa dang / /de bzhin ral gri cang te'u 'o/ /me mtshams baṃ gyis tshangs pa ni/ /sku mdog dkar mo phyag bzhi na/ /tshangs pa'i sku dang thod pa nyid/ /gzhu dang mda' ni de bzhin no/ /srin por shaṃ gis tshogs bdag ma/ /mdog ljang ma'o phyaphyag bzhi na/ /mdung rtse gsum dang thod pa'i phyag /bgrang phreng dang ni la du'o/ /rlung du baṃ gyis khyab 'jug ma/ /mdog sngon ma la phyag bzhi na/ /chang dang chu yi thod pa dang / /zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ de bzhin gzhan/ /dbang ldan i yig las byung ma/ /dbang mo mdog ser phyag bzhi na/ /rdo rje mdung thung thod pa dang / /sdigs mdzub dang ni zhags pa nyid/ /lha mo thams cad gyen skra 'bar/ /sna tshogs rgyan kyis rnam par bklubs/ /mi ro'i stan bzhugs spyan gsum ma/ /stag gi pags pas rked pa dkris/ /rim pa gsum par/ dbang ldan yi gis gnod sbyin ni/ /khyu mchog stan la bzhugs pa ste / /mdog dkar ba la phyag bzhi na/ /thod pa dang ni mdung rtse gsum/ /thal mo sbyar la gzhol pa'o/ /shar du i skyes brgya byin ni/ /glang po'i stan la bzhugs pa ste/ /mdog ser phyag ni bzhi pa la/ /rdo rje dang ni thod pa'i phyag /phyag gi thal mo sbyar bar mdzad/ /me mtshams baṃ kyis drang srong ni/ /mdog dmar phyag bzhi ra skyes zhon/ /me thab dang ni thod pa dang / /skrag pas thal mo sbyor la brtson/ /lho ru yi gis nyi ma'i bu/ /mdog sngo phyag bzhi ma he zhon/ /8—930

dbyug pa thod pa bsnams pa dang / /skrag pas thal mo sbyar la gzhol①/ /bden bral re gyis ②srin po ni/ /mdog ljang phyag bzhi mi ro zhon/ /ral gri dang ni thod pa thogs/ /skrag pas thal mo sbyor 1la brtson/ /nub tu baṃ gyis chu yi bdag /mdog dkar phyag bzhi chu srin stan/ /zhags pa dang ni thod pa thogs/ /skrag pas thal mo spyor la gzhol/ /rlung mtshams yi gis rlung gi bdag/dud kha phyag bzhi ri dwags zhon/ /ba dan dang ni thod pa nyid/ /de bzhin thal mo sbyor la brtson/ /byang du rku gis ku be+e ra/ /mdog ser phyag bzhi bum par bzhugs/ /rin po che dang thod pa 'dzin/ /thal mo sbyar la gzhol par mdzad/ /rim pa bzhi pa la ni/ shar du nyi ma mdog dmar ba/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni pad+ma 'dzin/ /thal mo sbyor la brtson par mdzad/ /rta bdun ldan pa'i shing rta zhon/ /me mtshams saṃ gis pa ba sangs/ /kha dog dkar po 'bar ba ste/ /g.yon pa pad stengs me nor bu/ /g.yas pa de bzhin thod pa ste/ /thal sbyar ba la ra skyes zhon—/ /lho ru saṃ gis mig dmar ni/ /mdog dmar ro yi gdan la gnas/ /ral gri dang ni zhags pa 'dzin/ /thal mo sbyor la gzhol bar byed/ /srin por ram̐ kyis rjosgra gcan 'dzin/ /g.yas pa nyi ma g.yon zla ba/ /dud kha thal mo sbyar byas la/ /lus phyed rang gi stan la gnas/ /nub tu saṃ gis spen pa sngo/ /phyag gnyis thod pa thogs pa dang / /thal mo sbyar ba byas pa'i phyag /me yi thab kyi steng du ni/ /me bzhin 'bar bas gnas pa'o/ /rlung du shaṃ gis zla ba dkar/ /g.yon du pad+ma zla nor bu/ /g.yas pa pad+ma'i steng du zla/ /thal mo sbyar byas ngang pa zhon/ /byang du baṃ gis phur bu ser/ /g.yon du ril pa spyi blugs te/ /g.yas su de bzhin thod pa'o/ /thal sbyar rin chen stan la gnas/ /dbang ldan 8—931

thu gyis gza' lag dkar/ /g.yas pa na ni rin chen mda'/ /g.yon pa na ni thod pa'o/ /thal sbyar bum pa'i stan la gnas/ /ke gis rgyal mtshan sbrul gzugs dmar/ /phyag gnyis ral gri thal sbyar ba/ /de bzhin rgyu skar rnams bud med kyi ①gzugs can te/ tha skar ni dkar ba'o/ /bra nye ni ljang gu'o/ /smin drug ni sngo bsangs so/ /snar ma ni dmar skya'o/ /mgo ni sngon po'o/ /lag ni ser po'o/ /nab so ni ser po'o/ /rgyal ni sngo bsangs so/ /skag ni dkar po'o/ /mchu ni ser po'o/ /bre ni ljang ser ro/ /dbo ni ljang gu'o/ /me kyebazhi ni dkar po'o/ /nag pa ni ljang gu'o/ /sa ri ni ser po'o/ /sa ga ni sngon po'o/ /lha mtshams ni sngo bsangs so/ /sgon ni ser po'o/ /snrubs ni ljang gu'o / /chu stod ni sngon po'o/ /chu smad ni dkar po'o/ /gro zhun 1ni skya bo'o/ /byi bzhin ni sngo bsangs so/ /mon gru ni sngon po'o/ /mon gre ni ser po'o/ /khrums stod ni ljang gu'o/ /khrums smad ni ser po'o/ /nam gru ni ser skya'o/ /thams cad ni gser gyi stod g.yogs can la thal mo sbyar bar bsam mo rim pa lnga par ni/ shar sgor baṃ las tshangs pa ni/ /mdog dkar zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa'o / /thod pa dang ni bgrang phreng dang / /spyi blugs dang ni pad+ma nyid/ /byang sgor bo ④las skyes pa yi/ /khyab 'jug ces bya phyag bzhi pa/ /mdung dang de bzhin 'khor lo dang / /thod pa nyid dang dbyug pa'o/ /nub tu saṃ las drag po ni / /dud pa'i mdog la sgephyag bzhi pa/ /mdung rtse gsum dang thod pa nyid/ /de bzhin zhags pa bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /lho ru shaṃ las skem byed ni/ /mdog ser phyag ni bzhi pa la/ /mdung thung dbyug pa thod pa dang / /de bzhin bgrang phreng 'dzin pa'o/ /de dag kun kyang bu dang bu mo la sogs pa'i 'khor dang bcas 8—932

shing | sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'o/ /yang dkyil 'khor chen po'i de nyid kyi sa'i dbus su/ shar du ru dra nag po ste/ /byang du ru dra chen po'o—/ /nub tu lha sbyin zhes bya ba/ /lho ru de bzhin nag po'o/ /dbang ldan du ni gcigs pa ste/ /me mtshams su ni mi sdug pa'o/ /bden bral dga' las 'das pa ste/ /rlung mtshams su ni log 'dren no/ /de kun zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ /phyag bzhi gri dang thod pa dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung rtse gsum pa'i phyag /gnag dang ser dang dmar dang ljang / /mtshams na gnas pa rnams ni yid 'phrog pa gzugs gnyis pa'o/ /ru dra nag po'i mdun du ni tsā muṇ+ḍi'ogye/ /g.yon du ni drag mo'o/ /rgyab tu mi sdug ma'o/ /g.yas su dka' bzlog lha mo'o/ /de dag ni mkha' 'gro ma'i gdong can phyag gnyis mchod pa lngas gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /ru dra chen po'i mdun du ni/ rgyal ma dang / rnam rgyal ma dang —/ mi thub ma dang / gzhan gyis mi thub ma rnams te/ bca' ba dang btung ba 'dzin pa/ lā ma'i mdog can no/ /nub tu lha sbyin gyi btsun mo/ nag mo bzang mo dang / nag mo chen mo dang / nag mo sbom mo dang / rnal 'byor ma rnams te/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha'i khrumadog can phyag na mchod pa lngas bkang ba'o/ /lho ru nag po'i btsun mo dbang po rngudang / zla ba mo dang drag mo dang ldan ma rnams te/gzugs can ma'i mdog can phyag na bza' btung thogs pa'o/ /dbang ldan du ni gtsigs pa'i btsun mo 'phyang ma dang / lha'i dbang phyug ma dang / dung can ma dang / mar me ma rnams te/ tsā muṇ+ḍi'i cemadog can phyag na bza' btung thogs pa'o/ /me mtshams su ni mi snyug pa'i gzugs dang / grong khyer du gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma dang / drag po'i gzugs can ma dang / gzugs chen 8—933

mo ste/ dbang mo'i mdog can sngon du bstan pa bzhin du phyag na ston mo thogs pa—/ bden bral du dga' ba ①las 'das pa'i chung ma mche ba'i gzugs dang /gcigs ma dang thod pa'i phreng ba can ma gshin rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'phyar ba'o/ /nag mo bzang ba'i mdog can bza' ba dang btung ba lag na thogs pa'o/ /rlung du log 'dren gyi chung ma lag na ral gri dang dgra sta ma dang / lag na rdo rje ma dang /lag na pad+ma can ma rnams te/ rgyal ma la sogs pa'i mdog can lag na bza' ba dang btung ba la sogs pa thogs pa'o/ /yang shar phyogs kyi rta babs kyi mdun kyi dur khrod du 'jigs byed thod phreng can dang srin po dang tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang dril rna ste/ bzhi po de dag chung ma dang bcas shing mkha' 'gro ma'i mdog can no / /byang gi dur khrod du ni gtum pa'i dbang phyug dang / dza yig rnga ma dang rked pa'i ru dra dang / sbom pa'i dbang phyug chung ma dang bcas pa lā ma'i mdog can no/ /nub phyogs kyi dur khrod du ḍa ma ra ②dang 'dam ka dang pheg dang 'jigs su rung ba rnams chung ma dang bcas pa 1khaṇ+ḍa ro hā'i ④mdog can no/ /lho phyogs kyi dur khrod du ni sku'i dbang phyug dang / sgra ⑤chen dang mche ba gatshigs pa dang mda' 'dzin zhes bya ba rnams chung ma dang bcas pa gzugs can ma'i mdog go/ /de dag thams cad kyang zhal gcig pa phyag bzhi pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa dang / mdung rtse gsum pa dang lha mo la 'khyud pa ste/ sngar bstan pa'i shing brgyad la yang gnas par ⑥blta bar bya'o/ /de dag thams cad 'jig rten gsum na grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang / lha'i bu mo dang mi la sogs pa rnams kyis phyogs bzhir ⑦kun du mdun du bdar ba/ yi dwags sha za la sogs pa 'du ba/ki li ki li'i sgra sgogs par yid kyis blta bar bya zhing / sgrub pa po la yang mcho ga 8—934

ster bas mngon par phyogs pa/ rang gi ming gi yi ge snying gar dgod cing lus ngag yid gsum/ oṃ t+pahūṃ dang bcas pas rigs gsum las byung ba'o/ /de nas cho ga bzhin du bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil byin la dam tshig dang mnyam pa'i sbyor bas/ rang gi 'khor lo la kha zas dbul bar bya ste/ phyag 'tshal ⑨dbus su a dang ldanakhye/ /yi ge hūṃ byas sbar ba yis/ /yi ge tweḥlas me 'bar 1ba/ /ji srid bya ba rdzogs bar du/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen kha dbye/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /kha kha khā hi la sogs pa'i sngags kyis me tog dang bdug pa dang byug pa la sogs pas mchod do/ /de nas sems yang dag par mnyes nas mchog ster bar 'gyur ro/ /gtso bor bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gsung thugs la rnam par gnas par bsam mo/ /dpal he ru ka zhes bya ba'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi las le'u nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'i rnam par bshad pa'o// //de nas mchod pa rnam dag bdag /ces bya ba la/ rnam dag ces bya ba ni dngos po thabs cad las so so ma yin pa nyid de/ gnyis su med pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /de nyid sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi sku'o//de las nges par byung ba ni dpa' bo'o zhes bya ba la srid pa dang zhi ba dag la mi gnas pa'i phyir te longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o/ /de yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rjes su spyod pa ste/ tshogs ma lus pa bsags pa las nges par 'byung ④ba'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi tshogs spros nas sems can gyi don byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni sprul pa'i sku zhes bya ba ste/ de'i ngo bo nyid kyi bdag nyid 8—935

kyis ①bdag nyid mchod par bya ba ni rang gi lha'i sbyor ba yis ji ltar sbyor bas so/ /spun dang sdug pa'ang mchod par bya ste zhes bya ba ni lhan cig tu mnyam pa dang bsam pa dag pa dang nges par sbyor ba dang gcig tu byas pa'o/ /'ang gi sgras ni rnal 'byor ma nges par bzung rjoste/ gang gi phyir de rnams ma gtogs par de'i phun sum tshogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nyid kyis na nges par gnas/ /zhes bya ba ste/ lha mo dang 'dus pa'i sbyor bas so/ / zhi ba zhes bya ba ni chang ngo yang na zhi ba'i bde ba'o/ /rtag tu shar ba 'od gsal ba/ /snying ga'i pad+mar nges brten nas/ /de 'dra stong pa nyid 'gyur ba/ /sems nyid bsgom par mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /spun dang bu dang lhan cig tu/ /zhes bya ba la brtse gdung gi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ma gtogs par bya ste/ sngags dang phyag rgya mchod cing dkyil 'khor dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bstan pa dang rdo rje'i glu yang thos pas dam tshig la skur zhing slob dpon la smod pa dang / sems can thams cad sun 'byin par byed pa de'i phyir na rdo rje slob dpon gyi bu dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur zhing /de'i 'dus pa'i sems can gzhan yang byang chub kyi sems dri ma can du 'gyur ro/ /de rnams yongs su gzung ba'i phyir zas la spyad par bya ba zhes bya bar sbyar ro/ /'di ni thun mong ngo / /khyad par du ji lta bu zhe na/ gang gi phyir snying rje'i dbang gis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ji lta ba de ltar de rnams la yang bstan par mi bya ste / dad pa'i dbang gis de rnams kyi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gzhan nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags su la'ang sbyin mi bya/ /zhes bya ba ni sems can yongs su ma smin pa rnams la'o/ /sbyin par bya zhes bya ba ni/ 'dir dbang bskur ba rnams la'o/ /pho nya zhes bya ba la sogs pa la lam dang 'dra bas lam ste/ byang 8—936

chub kyi lam mo/ /de yang mtha' yas pa'i nyon mongs pa dang skye ba spyong ba ste/nyon mongs pa glo bur ba nyid kyi phyir nam mkha' la sprin dang khug rna dang du ba dang 'khrul pa tsam zhig bsal bas tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de bas na de spangs nas rnal 'byor gzhan la brten par ni/ nyan thos kyi spyod pa dang / kṛ ya dang spyod pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rnams su ji skad bshad pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'dod pa de dag rmongs pas dngos grub med cing bde ba med par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal srid shor ba'i skyes bu bzhin/ /dad pa'i nor dang phral phyir ro//zhes pa ni zhen pa'i lta bas blta ba'o/ /thar pa ni grol ba ste/ pho nya la zhen pa des grol ba'o/ /de bas na/ /bde ba yis kyang longs spyod bya/ /zhes bya ba ste—/ bde ba thams cad ni bha ga las byung ba'i 1bdud rtsi nyid du nges pa'i phyir ro—/ /bsnyen bkur kho na bya ba min/ /zhes bya ba la/ bsnyen bkur gyi ni don can min/ /chags pas 'dus pa 1dga' ba ste/ /de phyir 'khyud par rab tu bya/ /rjes su chags dang ldan pas thob/ /gzhan du bde bar mi 'gyur ro/ /skye gnas dman pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni rdo rje'i rigs la sogs pa'o/ /'ang gi sgras ni bram ze mchog la sogs pa bsdu ba'o/ /de rnams kyang ma dang sring mo la sogs pa ltar shin tu gdung ba'i dbang gis so/ /dka' thub bdag nyid chen po yis—/ /gang zhig rtag tu mchod byed pa/ /bshung zhing dman rka pa'i sems kyis ni / /dka' thub nges par zad par 'gyur/ /'khor lo de bzhin grub pa yis④//zhes bya ba ni gang gi dam tshig dang sdom pa nyams pa rnams kyi yang phyis blang ba la ni rnal 'byor 'di sbyin par bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor pas/ /dam tshig sdom pa bla na med/ /nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbus gnas par/ /dam 8—937

tshig dkyil 'khor bla na med/ /de yi dbus su 'khor lo che/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yis brgyan pa ni/ /dbus su nyi stan yi dwags la/ /phywali kā lir yang dag ldan//sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshon ①'chang zhing / /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan/ /byin kyis brlabs pa'i tshig byas nas/ /yi ge hi las yang dag byung / /'jig dus 'od zer ltar 'jigs pa/ /spyan gsum mche ba gcigs pa'o/ /ljags 'dril khro dang bcas bzhad zhal/ /lha chen thams cad gsol mdzad pa/ /bskal pa'i me ltar yang dag 'khrug /ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan zhing / /'jigs byed pags pas rked pa dkris/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis legs bzhugs pas/ /'jigs byed dus mtshan kun du mnan/ /dpral bar rdo rje phreng ba dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyed brgyan/ /sku la rgyan drug rgyan du byas/ /phyag drug zhal ni lnga pa ste/ /sna tshogs nyams dang ro mchog ldan/ /sngo dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang dang steng dkar zhi ba'o/ /shi ba'ang gso bar byed pa'i mchog /sdang ba thams cad nges gnas pa'i/ /rdo rje dril bu snyoms zhugs shing / /phag mo'i sku la yang dag 'khyud/ /sa srungs pags pa na bza' 'dzin/ /steng du gdugs dkar gzung ba steñtsha/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin/ /drug pa na ni cang te'u'o/ /de dang 'dra ba'i phag mo yid/ /dbu skra grol zhing gcer bu la/ /mi rus rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs④/ /'on kyang pags pa'i gos kyi gnas su gri dang tshangs pa'i mgo dgod par bya'o/ /de shar sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ste/ /de bzhin byang du las mkha' 'gro/ /nub tu chos kyi mkha' 'gro ste / /lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro nyid/ /dkar dang sngo dang dmar po dang / /ljang gu dang steng dmar ser po/ /'khor lo dang dril bus khru/snyoms par 'jug 8—938

cing phyag gnyis kyis tshangs pa'i pags pa'i gos bsnams pa dang gzhan gyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang cang te'u'o/ /g.yas brkyang pas tshangs pa khyo shug ①mnan pa'o—/ /yang ljang gu dang ser po dang dmar po dang sngon po dang / de bzhin du lnga pa steng ma dkar po ste0/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bus ⑦snyoms par 'jug pa/tshogs kyi bdag po'i pags pa bsnams pa dang / gzhan gyis thod pa dang /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang cang te'u bsnams pa'o/ /g.yas brkyang gi ④gnas pas tshogs kyi bdag po khyo shug ⑤mnan pas 'jigs shing myos pa'o/ /yang dmar po dang sngon po dang ser po dang ljang gu dang steng ma dkar po ste/ pad+ma dang dril bus ⑥snyoms bar 'jug cing 'dod pa'i lha'i pags pa dral ba bsnams pa dang / thod pa dang —/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / ḍa ma ru ste/ g.yas brkyang ba'i gnas pas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug bus khyo shug ⑦mnan pa'o/ /yang ser po dang sngon po dang dmar po dang ljang gu dang de bzhin du steng ma dkar po ste/ rin po che dang dril bus ⑪snyoms par 'jug cing dbang po dral ba'i pags pa bsnams pa dang thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang cang te'u'o/ /g.yas brkyang ba'i gnas pas dbang po khyo shug ⑪ mnan pa ste/kun kyang spyan gsum pa phyag drug pa ral pa'i cod pan dar gyis bcings pa me mtshams dang bden bral dang / rlung mtshams dang dbang ldan gyi mtshams rnams su ni sangs rgyas kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang / pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dang / las kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams te/ dkar po dang sngon po dang dmar po'o/ /yang sngon po dang dkar po dang ser po'o/ /yang dmar po dang sngon po dang ser po'o/ /yang ljang gu dang sngon po dang ser po ste/ kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /spyan gsum gcer bu skra grol la/ /phyag rgya lnga 8—939

yis brgyan pa'o/ /nga rgyal bcas shing gar mdzad pa/ /snying rje chags pa'i dga' dang ldan/ /'khor lo'i mda' dang rdo rje'i mda'/ /pad+ma'i mda' dang rin chen mda'/ /rang gi mtshan 1mas mtshan ma'i mda'/ /g.yon pa thams cad na gzhu'o/ /thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍa ma ru'o/ /gzhan gyis zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /shin tu zlum zhing re mig dgu/ /phyi rol gru bzhi sgo bzhir ldan/ /de la shar sgor ni gzugs mang ngo 1/ /byang du ni gzugs bzang ngo / /nub tu ni ke rdo rje dbyig pa can no/ /lhor ni rdo rje snang ba'o/ /kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis bklubs ④pa ste/ /sngon bstan sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro sogs/ /rim bzhin mtshan ma thogs pa'o/ /de yi phyi rol ⑤yul du yang / /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis brgyan pa dang —/ /dar dang me tog gi phreng ba 'phyang ba ste/ de la lha'i snam bu gru bzhi pa'i me'i mtshams la sogs pa'i g.yon skor gyis dgod par bya ba ni rdo rje'i kha dang drag po'i kha dang / rdo rje phag sna ma dang / snyan grags ldan ma dang / rdo rje pho nya mo dang / rdo rje sen mo dang / rdo rje gzhon nu ma dang / rdo rje dung can ma dang —/ rdo rje dri ma dang / rdo rje nyal ma dang / dri can ma dang / 'jigs ⑥ma'i zhal dang / spyi gtsug zla ba dang / khro gnyer ma dang / sna tshogs kyi gzugs ma dang / rdo rje lus can ma dang / rdo rje sgog ma dang / sgyu 'phrul lha mo dang / snyan byed ma dang / kham pa ma ste/ de ltar lha mo nyi shu'o/ /shar phyogs kyi sgor ni rdo rje 'bar ba ma dang / byang du ni rdo rje 'khyil ma'o/ /nub tu ni rdo rje 'jigs byed ma'o⑦/ /lhor ni rdo rje grub ma'o/ /de dag ni mkha' 'gro ma'i dkyil 'khor grub pa'o/ /sgo srung byeb thams cad kyang spyan gsum 8—940

pa—/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba gsus pa 'phyang ba'o/ /gzhan dag ni sna tshogs kyi gzugs can rol pa mo thams cad phyag rgya lnga 'dzin pa thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa zhal gsum pa dpa' ba ①dang sgeg pa dang snying rje'i ros gang ba nu ma rgyas shing skal ba dang ldan ma gcer bu skra gol ba snying rje chen pos chags pa'i dga' ba'i dam pa ro'i gdan la bzhugs pas gar byed pa'i mchog ste/ thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rnge'u chung gi bdag nyid can/ zhags pa dang lcags kyu can rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol ba'o/ /de nas sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis brlabs la go cha gnyis kyis brgyan nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo de la dgug pa ste/ dbang bskur ba la yang dag par mchod nas/ bstod pa byas la sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ḍā ka a haṃ dzuhūṃ ḍā ki ni dzā la sasbra ra hūṃ byehūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gus pa'i bsam pas rtag tu bzlas par bya ste/ rdo rje mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs chen po spro ba dang bsdu bar bya'o/ /oṃ shrī burnye ḍā ka a hūṃ ④hūṃ ḍā ki ni dzā la sadza ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī karma ḍā ka a khaṃ hūṃ ḍā ki ni dzā la sasbra ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī pad+ma ḍā ka a dh+ri hūṃ ḍā ki ni dzā la sadza ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī rat+na ḍā ka a saṃ hūṃ ḍā ki ni dzā la sasba ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shrī badz+ra wā rā tī ⑤baṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de ltar mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi bzlas pa'i sngags rab tu bshad pa'o/ /sdom pa 'di rnam par nges par bzung ⑥na rdo rje dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub bzang po gdon mi za'o⑦/ /mchog dang tha ma zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni gang yang gzhan dag sngon du grub pa dam tshig can byen gyis brlab pa'i go 'phang dran par bya ste/ mchog tu zhes bya ba ni lhan cig skyes ma'o/ /dbus ma 3ni zhing las skyes ma'o/ /tha ma ni sngags skyes ma'oske/ /des lhan cig skyes pa de'i ⑪ rdzas ni rnam par nges pa yin zhes bya ba ste/8—941

rtsar chud pa'i dbang po thams cad las byung ba'i rdzas gang de rnams kyi rkyen gyis rtag tu bskyed pa'i bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa gnas pa'i thod pa la khrag dang chang du ldan pas dkyil 'khor gru gsum byas la/ steng dang dbus dang 'og rnams su/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams ji ltar gsungs/ /de nas kha zas bza' bya ste/ /de nyid gsum ni mngon bsngags ①la/ /dam tshig mchog ni btung zhing sbyin/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin gtso dang / /rnal 'byor ma tshogs bdag la gson/ /sdom pa ma lus bzung byas nas/ /rtag tu bdag gis bskyang bar bgyi/ /zhes bya'o/ /'jig rten la rtag ñtshagayon nas sbyong /zu / /ces bya ba la g.yon pa'i kun du spyod pa rnams ni bde ba'i 'byung gnas yin pas grub pa'i don du rnam par spyod do/ /rnal 'byor chen po 'di nyid bde ba can dang nam mkha'i pho brang dang / 'jig rten gsum kyi 'gro ba'i bdag po'o/ /gang g.yon pas g.yon pa las skyes pa rnams brgyan na 5mchog gi don thams cad ster bar nus shing rgyas par byed la bde ba ster bas na g.yon gyis bkur ste bya ste/ rnal 'byor pa thabs thams cad la mkhas pas so/ /gang gi phyir bde mchog gtso bo'i nges pa thams cad g.yon pa las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /phyag rgya chen pos mchod med par/ /gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /de yis ngal ba don med de/ /'bras bu thob par mi 'gyur ro / /brtul zhugs ma nyams zhes bya ba la brtul zhugs ni dus kyi nges pa dang /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis la sogs pas bskal pa du mas brgya lam na sangs rgyas pa de dag thams cad zil gyis gnon cing brtul zhugs spong ba ste/ tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /gang gi phyir sgrub pa po bya ba la brtson pa ni 'jig rten pa'i spyod pa las rnam par grol ba ste ⑤brtul zhugs rdzogs 8byed942

pa'o—/ /dam tshig ces bya ba la sogs pa la 'dis grangs su bgrangs pas ni rigs te drug dang lnga la sogs par gsungs pa'o/ /lhan cig ces pa ni sngon du bstan pa bzhin no/ /rigs lnga las ni kun spyod pa/ /zhes bya ba la rin po che'i rigs mi bskyod pa ①nang du 'dus pas rigs bzhi ru rab tu gtogs so/ /mthar thug pa yang sems kyi bdag po'i rigs su gcig pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor pa rnams der mnyam pa'o/ /rnam par mi rtog kun spyod bya/ /'du 'dzi yongs su 'dzin med cing —/ /longs spyod min pa'i zas rnams dang / /'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga—/ /kha na ma tho me+ed bsten rjobya/ /me la ji ltar bzang ⑦ba mnyam spyod yul/ /ji ltar nyi ma'i snang bas mnyam par ston/ /rlung gis ⑤ji ltar dri ma mnyam par bsdus/ /rnam rtog rmongs pa'i rgya mtsho rigs spangs la/ /dam tshig ma lus kun tu spyod ⑤par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum zhes bya ba la/ sa phyogs rtsub cing snying po ma yin pa/ gas shing mdog gnag ⑥pa la/ rgyar 3sor nyi shu/ zabs su sor bcu pa'i thab khung byang du mgo bstan pa byas la las kyi rdo rje dang / de bzhin du mdung rtse gsum pa dang / rdo rje tho ba'i mtshan ma rnams rtse mo steng du bltas pas gsad bhupa'i las la mdung gi rtse mo steng du blta bar bya ste/ phyag mtshan 'dir sor bzhi pa'i tshad du bri bar bya'o/ /de'i steng du sor gsum bor nas zheng dang dpangs sor gsum pa'i kha khyer gyis thab khung bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas sa nag po nyid dang bong bu dang rnga mo'i rtug pa dang / mi rus dang 'bras kyi phub ma dang / sol ba byugs la dri mi zhim pa'i me tog dang bdug pas mchod la / shing dri mi zhim zhing rtsub pa tsher ma can gyi shing ngam/ dur khrod kyi shing ngam—/ bong bu dang rnga mo'i rtug pa skam pos bya zhing nim pa dang seng ldeng dang 8—943

tsher ma can nam/ ba lu ti ka tsher ma can la sogs pa'i shing rnams kyi yam shing sor bcu pa'i tshad tsam rtsa ba'i cha las byas pa'am/ ro bsregs pa'i rtsub shing gshags pa las byung ba'ang rung ste/ dug dang khrag dang mar khu la bdug 1pa bsreg par bya'o/ /yang yungs kar tsha ba'i mar khu dang khrag dang lan tshwa dang ske tshe dang nim pa'i 'dab ma'i thal ba dang / rkang rjes kyi sa dang bong bu dang rnga mo la sogs pa'i rtug pa dang skra dang zhag dang bya rog dang 'ug pa'i sgro dang bshang ba dang gci ba dang mi rus kyi phye ma dang spu dang sha la sogs pa re re zhing ji skad rnyed pa'i rdzas dug dang khrag dang smyo byed kyi 'dab ma'i khu bas sbangs la/ thal ba dang sol ba dang 'bras kyi phub ma la sogs pas dgra bo'i gzugs brnyan byas la mtshon rnon pos mgo bo nas brtsams te/ lus dum bu dum bur gtubs la/ mngon spyod kyi las la sbyin sreg dbul te/ lcags kyi snod du khrag dang chu dang mi dang bong bu'i gcin la yi ge phaṭa kyi mtha' dang ldan pa'i mngon spyod yi ge bdun pa lan bdun bzlas la/ bsreg ⑤dzas la bsang gtor byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa rnams dang / dam tshig las 'da' bar byed pa rnams sbyar bar bya'o//de nas gos nag pos brgyan zhing lcags kyi rgyan dang ldan pas zhukhro bo'i sems kyis gshin rje'i phyogs su kha bltas la sngags pas khro bo'i khrug krung gis stan mkhrang po la gnas shing mtshan phyed dang nyin phyed na bsgrub bya rnam par bsams te/ rang gis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ yi ge hūṃ phaṭa mtha' na yod pa'i 'brug sgra ltar sngags brjod la/ des rab dang 'bring dang tha ma'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /'dir mngon spyod kyi me ni dur khrod kyi me'am rus pa las byung ba'am rdo las skyes pa'am gdol pa'i khyim nas byung bas gong ma thab khung du ji ltar bstan pa'i bud shing la 8—944

rlung g.yab kyis ba ba ka sbar te/ hūṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ zhes brjod cing cho ga bzhin du me sbar ro/ /de nas lag pa g.yon pa ku sha dang bcas pa'i mthe bong srin lag gi rtsa bar btsugs la me lha spyan drang bar bya ste/ oṃ e bye 1ma hā bhū ta de ba ṛ ṣi dī dza satwa ma rja hi twa ā hu ②ti phywaha re 1a smin san+ni hi to bha ba zhes bya bas me'i phyogs nas spyan drangs te/ byon nas 'bar ba'i snying po'i dbus su khro bo mi bzad ces bya ba'i klog ltar phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa ba spu kham pa de bzhin du du ba'i mdog can mig g.yo ba steng du gzigs shing sbra byeche ba/ mche ba ⑤bzhi pa stobs che zhing rlung gi dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa 'jigs pa'i yi ge hūṃ gis hūṃ zhes mdzad pas spyan gsum pa la phyag bzhi pa rdo rje 'od zer gyi gzi brjid che zhing rig pa'i gnas la legs par bzhugs pa/ zhal bdun pa rnam par gcigs shing ma he'i gdan la babyubs pa'i du ba'i phreng bas 'khrug cing 'jigs su rung ba lcags kyi rgyan bzang po dang ldan zhing lcags kyi lugs ma'i zhal can 'bar ba'i phreng ba dang bcas shing spyan dmar ser mnyam pa med pas 'jigs par gzigs pa gos sngon po ⑥mnabs shing 'jig pa'i me ltar drag po'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gsum po gsal ba/ phyag gnyis kyis mdung dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ yang gzhan gyis ral gri dang zangs gri 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i g.yas logs su ni nag po kham ser zhes bya ba g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang gri gug 'dzin pa yan lag nag po'i du ba'i spyan can tshesas kyis khrum mchu bzung nas 'tshir ba'o/ /g.yon gnyis khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang ral gri 'dzin pas gnas pa 'od zer dmar po mnyam du 'bar ba'o/ /g.yon du ni gshin rje mthar byed drag cing char sprin kyi 'od dang mnyam pa zhal drug phyag drug mnga' zhing / zhal drug la spyan gsum pa rnam par 8—945

'gyur zhing / zhal mche ba rnam par gatshigs pa lcags kyi rgyan 'bar ba can dur khrod kyi me ltar dpangs mtho ba ma he la zhon pa sti'ajam dpal gyi snying po las byung bar bya'o/ /me thab kyi ngos gnyis la ni mthar byed dang nag po gnyis ji lta ba'i rang bzhin can du bsam par bya ste/ ltogs shing za 'dod pa phyag bzhi pa dang drug pa can no/ /yi dwags kyi rgyal po ji lta ba de bzhin du drag cing bya ba byed pa'i byin za drag po'i las 'ba' zhig sems pa'o/ /de ltar thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs las byung ste/ don thams cad bsgrub pa'i sgrub pa pos las dang rjes su mthun pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'i zhusbyor bas yang dag par ldan par byas la/ sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis brlabs ke par byas nas cho ga bzhin du mchod yon la sogs pas mchod pa bya ste/ mgo bor mchod yon no/ /rkang pa gnyis la ni zhabs bkru'o/ /oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra t+t+waṃts+tsha swā hā/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo dang /mje bong bkab pa lta bur byas pas chu blangs te lag pa bskyod pas dbul bar bya'o / /oṃ pā h+ye ④pra tre+ets+tsha swā hā/ de nas zhal bsil dang bsang gtor byin la mchod pa bya ste me tog ni mgo la'o/ /bdug pa ni mdun du'o/ /dri ni snying gar ro/ /mar me yang mdun du'o/ /lha bshos kyang de bzhin du mdun du dbul bar bya'o/ /de ltar yang dag par mchod pa dang khyad par du yang yid kyis nan tan du bsams la/ zhal bsil byin te/ so rtsi dbul bar bya'o/ /de la dgong shegazar ni yu ba sor bcu drug pa la dkyus sor bzhi pa zabs su sor gnyis pa / de'i dbus su yang gru gsum pa ste/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba 'di'i dbus su yang mtshan ma bya ste/ stag dang sbrul dang seng ge rnams kyi gdong pa gang 'dod pas mtshan mar bya zhing mar 'dzag pa'i bu ga sor gcig 8—946

pa'o—/ /mchu ni rdo rje gdeng ba 'dar ⑨bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sor tshad tsam mo / /de bzhin du blugs gzar gyi yu ba ni sor bcu bzhi pa dkyus sor gsum pa/zabs sor gcig pa gru gsum pa de bzhin du mtshan mas byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /yu ba'i mthar ni rdo rje rtse gsum gdengs pas byen gyis rlabs pa'i pya mngon spyod kyi gzar bu dgang bar bya ste/ thog gis brgyab pa'i shing ngam lcags sam/ tsher ma rno ba can gyi shing rnams las bya'o/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par 'jig zhes bya ba'i don no/ /de ltar phyi rol gyi sbyin sreg bshad nas/ yang nang gi bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ sngags dang phyag rgya yang dag ldan/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi zas de bzhin/ /zhes bya ba gsungs te/ sngon du bstan pa'i rdzas rnams kyis/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i sbyor ba dang ldan pas bya'o/ /nyon mongs thams cad zhi don dang / /ting nge 'dzin ni rgyas bya'i phyir/ /srid gsum snying po'i thab khung du/ /las rnams thams cad rab bsgrub bya/ /rang bzhin gyis byung lte ba ru/ /gtum mo'i me ni bzang pos brgyan/ /rtsa ba'i rang bzhin he ru ka /rnal 'byor pa kun dgang bar bya/ /rang bzhin med pa'i sems kyis ni//'byung ba kun gyi sreg blugs bya/ /'di ni bla med sbyin sreg tu/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu gsungs/ /rang gis bdag nyid rang bzhin du/ /phyi yi dngos po shes par bya/ /de ltar yang gsungs pa/ 'od zer phreng bas 'khrigs shing drag /'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab 'bar ba/ /lte ba'i thab khung kun du gsungs//bhe ba me yi thab khung nyid/ /bud shing thams cad ye shes mes/ /'byin dang sdud par byed pa yin/ /las kyi rlung gis rab bskyod pas/ /lte ba'i dkyil du rab tu 'bar/ /dbang po kun las byung ba'i sems/ /bde ba bud shing du ni 38—947

'gyur/ /las dang skye ba las byung ba/ /nyon mongs zhi phyir sbyin sreg bya/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim gyis ni/ /'di yis myur du rgyas par 'gyur/ /bskal pa'i me dang rtogs mtshungs shing / /'od kyi snang bas legs gnas pa/ /rtsa brgyad rnams kyi 'bras bu ni/ /snying ga'i gnas su yang dag 'bar/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i 'dab ldan pa'i/ /pad+ma nyid kyi dbus su me/ /de yi dbus su me yi lha/ /mthe bo'i tshigs tshad tsam du blta/ /phyag gnyis me yi mdog can ma/ /lhan cig skyes dga' rab 'bar ba'i/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnan nas ni/ /'od zer 'bar bas rab gsal ba/ /dbyings ①kun la ni 'bar byed pa/ /thams cad rtsa ru song bar blta/ /blta ñtshab kun gyi bud shing ni/ /'dab ma'i mthar ni yang dag gsungs/ /yid kyis 1me tog mchod bya zhing / /yid kyis (5bdug pas bdug phyopar bya/ /yid kyi dri ni bde dang ldan/ /yid kyi mar me rab 'bar ba/ /gtor ma 'dus byas gang ba yi/ /yid nyid kyis ni mchod par bya/ /rkyang ma dgang gzar yang dag gsungs/ /ro bcud blugs gzar drugs gzar kha/ /kha yi pad+ma'i 'dab ma ste/ /sor gnyis tshad du rab rgyas pa'o/ /dbyug pa rdo rje rin chen mtha'/ /ji srid rang gi rdo rje 'bar/ /thod pa sreg rdzas snod yin te//thams cad rdzas ni sreg blugs byas/ /de ltar rim pa rab tu brjod/ /rtsa lnga la ni yang dag brten/ /lnga po yang dag sbyar bar bya/ /sa dang chu dang de bzhin me//rlung dang nam mkha' mnyam pa'o/ /chu shing me tog lta bu ni/ /lte ba'i dbus su yang dag gnas/ /rtag tu khyab byed gnas pa ste/ /mkhas pas kun tu bskor bar bya/ /'dab brgyad rtag tu steng du blta/ /ge sar dang ni ldan par gsungs//de yi dbus su rab brtan pa/ /rnam shes lhan cig skyes pa'i lha/ /rlung gi 8—948

—nam mkhar rab tu 'bar/ /de'i rdul phran rnam pa ru/ /mtshan nyid rab tu shes par bya/ /skra rtse brgya yi cha yis ni/ /'od zer rgyun mi 'chad par gnas/ /ar+gha byin bya rab 'bar ba'i/ /thig le ri mo yi ge med/ /sngon bzhin mtshan nyid yang dag ldan/ /sor mo lnga dang mnyam ldan pas/ /gang ba'i sbyin sreg rab tu gsungs/ /sreg drugs sbyin sreg sor mo gsum/ /sbyin sreg rim pa'i sbyor ba yis / /bdud rtsi'i yi ge yang dag ldan/ /bdud rtsi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni / /mchog gi de nyid yi ge gsum/ /bde chen bdud rtsi dgug pa yis/ /dmigs pa thams cad dga' bar gsungs/ /sbyin sreg gi ni rim pa yis/ /rgyun du 'bab cing 'bab 'gyur te/ /nyin dang mtshan du khu ba'i rgyun/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun bsdus nas/ /der ni sku mchog rab bzhugs pa/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg de brjod do/ /rgyas la byang chub sems dpa' dgug① /gzugs su lhag par mos par bya/ /shin tu nyon mongs zad pa'i phyir/ /khyad par du ni khro bo'i gzugs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rjes chags pas/ /bud med gzugs ni rnam bsam bya/ /sku gsung thugs la 'debs pa'i phyir/ /bud med phyag rgya rab tu gsungs/ /gru gsum me yi dkyil 'khor du/ /rang byung gi ni lhag pa'i lha/ /sreg rdzas snod la khyad par du/ /sngags pas las rnams thams cad pa/ /dpa' bo ⑪gnyis med snyoms 'jug pa/ /oṃ a baṃ hūṃ/ yi ge gnyis kyi sngags lus rngu/can/ /ha ha sed byas yang dag zlos/ /khu ba ji ltar 'byung ④'gyur ba/ /lhan cig skyes dga' rab tu 'bar/ /me yi dkyil 'khor 'od gsal ba/ /'jig dus me dang stobs mnyam la/ /ma lus pa kun sbyin sreg las—/ /lnga phung phyi nas me 'khor te/ /de yi thal ba'ang lus mi 'gyur/ /chos 8—949
